AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Lightsail instance with Amazon Linux 2023, nano bundle, and 8GB attached disk in first AZ, tagged with tutorial"
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "lambda.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "LightsailAttachDiskPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "lightsail:AttachDisk"
                  - "lightsail:DetachDisk"
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: "CloudWatchLogsPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
  AttachDiskFunction:
    Type: "AWS::Lambda::Function"
    Properties:
      Handler: "index.lambda_handler"
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: "python3.14"
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  lightsail = boto3.client('lightsail')
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  instance_name = props['InstanceName']
                  disk_name = props['DiskName']
                  disk_path = props['DiskPath']
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      lightsail.attach_disk(
                          diskName=disk_name,
                          instanceName=instance_name,
                          diskPath=disk_path
                      )
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          disk_info = lightsail.get_disk(diskName=disk_name)
                          if disk_info['disk']['isAttached']:
                              lightsail.detach_disk(diskName=disk_name)
                      except Exception:
                          pass
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      pass
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)})
  LightsailInstance:
    Type: "AWS::Lightsail::Instance"
    Properties:
      InstanceName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-instance"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      BlueprintId: "amazon_linux_2023"
      BundleId: "nano_2_0"
      Tags:
        - Key: "tutorial"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
  LightsailDisk:
    Type: "AWS::Lightsail::Disk"
    Properties:
      DiskName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-disk"
      SizeInGb: 8
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: "tutorial"
          Value: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
  DiskAttachment:
    Type: "Custom::DiskAttachment"
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt AttachDiskFunction.Arn
      InstanceName: !Ref LightsailInstance
      DiskName: !Ref LightsailDisk
      DiskPath: "/dev/xvdf"
Outputs:
  InstancePublicIp:
    Description: "Public IP of the Lightsail instance"
    Value: !GetAtt LightsailInstance.PublicIpAddress
  InstancePrivateIp:
    Description: "Private IP of the Lightsail instance"
    Value: !GetAtt LightsailInstance.PrivateIpAddress
  DiskName:
    Description: "Name of the attached disk"
    Value: !Ref LightsailDisk

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template to create a serverless workflow using Step Functions that sends custom events to a custom EventBridge event bus with a rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs for debugging.'
Parameters:
  EventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyCustomEventBus
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/events/my-custom-bus-logs
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to forward events to
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: SendCustomEventStateMachine
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine
  LogGroupRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period for the CloudWatch Logs log group in days
Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref EventBusName
  CloudWatchLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogGroupRetentionInDays
  LogGroupResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: EventBridgeToLogsPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
  EventRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        version:
          - '0'
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt CloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
          Id: CloudWatchLogsTarget
  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsEventBridgePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Ref StateMachineName
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Send custom events to custom EventBridge event bus",
              "StartAt": "SendEvent",
              "States": {
                "SendEvent": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "Entries": [
                      {
                        "EventBusName": "${EventBusName}",
                        "Source": "custom.source",
                        "DetailType": "CustomEvent",
                        "Detail": "{\"Message\": \"Hello from Step Functions\"}"
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - EventBusName: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Name
Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for AWS Cloud WAN with centralized outbound traffic inspection'
Parameters:
  GlobalNetworkName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MyGlobalNetwork'
    Description: Name for the global network
  CoreNetworkName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'MyCoreNetwork'
    Description: Name for the core network
  AsnRange:
    Type: String
    Default: '64512-65534'
    Description: ASN range for the core network
  EdgeLocation1:
    Type: String
    Default: 'us-east-1'
    Description: First edge location region
  EdgeLocation2:
    Type: String
    Default: 'us-west-2'
    Description: Second edge location region
  InspectionVpcCidrBlock1:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for inspection VPC 1
  InspectionVpcCidrBlock2:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for inspection VPC 2
  Subnet1Cidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR for subnet 1 in inspection VPC 1
  Subnet1Cidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: CIDR for subnet 2 in inspection VPC 1
  Subnet2Cidr1:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR for subnet 1 in inspection VPC 2
  Subnet2Cidr2:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.1.2.0/24'
    Description: CIDR for subnet 2 in inspection VPC 2
Conditions:
  UseUsEast1: !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', 'us-east-1']
  UseUsWest2: !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', 'us-west-2']
  UseEuWest1: !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', 'eu-west-1']
Resources:
  GlobalNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::GlobalNetwork
    Properties:
      Description: 'Global network for centralized outbound traffic inspection'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref GlobalNetworkName
  CoreNetwork:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::CoreNetwork
    Properties:
      GlobalNetworkId: !Ref GlobalNetwork
      Description: 'Core network for centralized outbound traffic inspection'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref CoreNetworkName
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2021.12'
        CoreNetworkConfiguration:
          AsnRanges:
            - !Ref AsnRange
          EdgeLocations:
            - Location: !Ref EdgeLocation1
            - Location: !Ref EdgeLocation2
        Segments:
          production:
            IsolateAttachments: true
            RequireAcceptanceToChange: false
          development:
            IsolateAttachments: false
            RequireAcceptanceToChange: false
          inspection:
            IsolateAttachments: true
            RequireAcceptanceToChange: false
        NetworkFunctionGroups:
          inspection-group:
            Segments:
              - inspection
            RequireAcceptanceToChange: false
        AttachmentPolicies:
          - RuleNumber: 100
            ConditionLogic: and
            Conditions:
              - Type: tag-exists
                Key: InspectionVPC
            Action:
              AssociationMethod: tag
              TagValueOfKey: domain
              RequireAcceptanceToChange: false
          - RuleNumber: 200
            ConditionLogic: or
            Conditions:
              - Type: tag-value
                Key: domain
                Value: production
            Action:
              AssociationMethod: tag
              TagValueOfKey: domain
          - RuleNumber: 300
            ConditionLogic: or
            Conditions:
              - Type: tag-value
                Key: domain
                Value: development
            Action:
              AssociationMethod: tag
              TagValueOfKey: domain
        SegmentActions:
          - Action: send-via
            Mode: single-hop
            Segment: production
            SendVia:
              - inspection-group
          - Action: send-via
            Mode: single-hop
            Segment: development
            SendVia:
              - inspection-group
  InspectionVPC1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref InspectionVpcCidrBlock1
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'InspectionVPC1'
        - Key: InspectionVPC
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
  InspectionSubnet1Az1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVPC1
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr1
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::If:
          - UseUsEast1
          - us-east-1a
          - Fn::If:
              - UseUsWest2
              - us-west-2a
              - Fn::If:
                  - UseEuWest1
                  - eu-west-1a
                  - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'InspectionSubnet1-AZ1'
  InspectionSubnet1Az2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVPC1
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr2
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::If:
          - UseUsEast1
          - us-east-1b
          - Fn::If:
              - UseUsWest2
              - us-west-2b
              - Fn::If:
                  - UseEuWest1
                  - eu-west-1b
                  - !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'InspectionSubnet1-AZ2'
  InspectionVPC2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref InspectionVpcCidrBlock2
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'InspectionVPC2'
        - Key: InspectionVPC
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
  InspectionSubnet2Az1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVPC2
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr1
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::If:
          - UseUsEast1
          - us-east-1a
          - Fn::If:
              - UseUsWest2
              - us-west-2a
              - Fn::If:
                  - UseEuWest1
                  - eu-west-1a
                  - !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'InspectionSubnet2-AZ1'
  InspectionSubnet2Az2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref InspectionVPC2
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr2

          - us-east-1b

              - us-west-2b
              - Fn::If:
                  - UseEuWest1
                  - eu-west-1b

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'InspectionSubnet2-AZ2'
  VpcAttachment1:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${InspectionVPC1}'
      SubnetArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${InspectionSubnet1Az1}'
        - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${InspectionSubnet1Az2}'
      Tags:
        - Key: InspectionVPC
          Value: 'true'
        - Key: domain
          Value: inspection
        - Key: Name
          Value: 'InspectionAttachment1'
  VpcAttachment2:
    Type: AWS::NetworkManager::VpcAttachment
    Properties:
      CoreNetworkId: !Ref CoreNetwork
      VpcArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${InspectionVPC2}'

        - !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${InspectionSubnet2Az2}'
      Tags:

Resources:
  CustomActionType:
    Type: AWS::CodePipeline::CustomActionType
    Properties:
      Category: Deploy
      Provider: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Version: '1'
      InputArtifactDetails:
        MinimumCount: 1
        MaximumCount: 1
      OutputArtifactDetails:
        MinimumCount: 0
        MaximumCount: 0
      ConfigurationProperties:
        - Name: Deploy-Bucket
          Description: 'The S3 bucket used for deployment artifacts.'
          Key: false
          Required: true
          Queryable: false
          Secret: false
          Type: String
        - Name: OpsWorks-Stack-ID
          Description: 'The OpsWorks stack ID.'
          Key: false
          Required: true
          Queryable: false
          Secret: false
          Type: String
        - Name: OpsWorks-App-ID
          Description: 'The OpsWorks app ID (key property).'
          Key: true
          Required: true
          Queryable: false
          Secret: false
          Type: String
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodePipelineCustomActionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - opsworks:CreateDeployment
                  - opsworks:DescribeDeployments
                  - opsworks:DescribeApps
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:PutJobSuccessResult
                  - codepipeline:PutJobFailureResult
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-custom-action'
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import json
          import logging

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: " + json.dumps(event))
              job_id = event['CodePipeline.job']['id']
              job_data = event['CodePipeline.job']['data']

              config = job_data['actionConfiguration']['configuration']
              deploy_bucket = config.get('Deploy-Bucket')
              opsworks_stack_id = config.get('OpsWorks-Stack-ID')
              opsworks_app_id = config.get('OpsWorks-App-ID')

              input_artifacts = job_data.get('inputArtifacts', [])
              if not input_artifacts:
                  put_job_failure(job_id, "No input artifact provided")
                  return

              artifact = input_artifacts[0]
              artifact_location = artifact['location']
              artifact_bucket = artifact_location['s3Location']['bucketName']
              artifact_key = artifact_location['s3Location']['objectKey']

              credentials = job_data['artifactCredentials']
              access_key = credentials['accessKeyId']
              secret_key = credentials['secretAccessKey']
              session_token = credentials['sessionToken']

              s3 = boto3.client('s3',
                                aws_access_key_id=access_key,
                                aws_secret_access_key=secret_key,
                                aws_session_token=session_token)

              try:
                  response = s3.get_object(Bucket=artifact_bucket, Key=artifact_key)
                  artifact_content = response['Body'].read()
                  s3_url = "s3://{}/{}".format(artifact_bucket, artifact_key)
              except Exception as e:
                  put_job_failure(job_id, "Failed to get artifact: " + str(e))
                  return

              opsworks = boto3.client('opsworks')
              try:
                  response = opsworks.create_deployment(
                      StackId=opsworks_stack_id,
                      AppId=opsworks_app_id,
                      Command={
                          'Name': 'deploy',
                          'Args': {}
                      },
                      Comment='Deploy from CodePipeline custom action',
                      CustomJson=json.dumps({})
                  )
                  put_job_success(job_id, "Deployment initiated successfully")
              except Exception as e:
                  put_job_failure(job_id, "OpsWorks deployment failed: " + str(e))

          def put_job_success(job_id, message):
              codepipeline = boto3.client('codepipeline')
              codepipeline.put_job_success_result(
                  jobId=job_id,
                  executionDetails={
                      'summary': message,
                      'externalExecutionId': job_id
                  }
              )

          def put_job_failure(job_id, message):
              codepipeline = boto3.client('codepipeline')
              codepipeline.put_job_failure_result(
                  jobId=job_id,
                  failureDetails={
                      'type': 'JobFailed',
                      'message': message
                  }
              )
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
Outputs:
  CustomActionTypeProvider:
    Description: 'Provider name of the custom action type.'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
  CustomActionTypeVersion:
    Description: 'Version of the custom action type.'
    Value: '1'
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the Lambda function implementing the custom action.'
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn

Description: 'Serverless workflow to monitor EC2 instance state changes and trigger Step Functions with placeholders for business logic'

Resources:

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/stepfunctions/ec2-state-change
      RetentionInDays: 7

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  Fn::Join:
                    - ''
                    - - !GetAtt StepFunctionsLogGroup.Arn
                      - ':log-stream:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt StepFunctionsLogGroup.Arn

  EC2StateChangeStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsLogGroup.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |-
        {
          "Comment": "EC2 Instance State Change Workflow",
          "StartAt": "ChooseState",
          "States": {
            "ChooseState": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "running",
                  "Next": "RunningPlaceholder"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "stopped",
                  "Next": "StoppedPlaceholder"
                },
                {
                  "Variable": "$.detail.state",
                  "StringEquals": "terminated",
                  "Next": "TerminatedPlaceholder"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "UnhandledState"
            },
            "RunningPlaceholder": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Business logic for running state",
              "End": true
            },
            "StoppedPlaceholder": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Business logic for stopped state",
              "End": true
            },
            "TerminatedPlaceholder": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Comment": "Business logic for terminated state",
              "End": true
            },
            "UnhandledState": {
              "Type": "Fail",
              "Cause": "Unrecognized EC2 instance state"
            }
          }
        }

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create S3 bucket, Glue database, and Glue crawler for AWS CloudTrail logs cataloging"

Parameters:
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Optional: Name of the S3 bucket to store CloudTrail logs. If empty, AWS generates a unique name."
    Default: ""

  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Glue database name (must end with -kk-admin-db)"
    AllowedPattern: "^.*-kk-admin-db$"
    Default: "cloudtrail-logs-kk-admin-db"

  CrawlerName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Glue crawler name"
    Default: "cloudtrail-crawler"

  TablePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "Prefix for tables created by the crawler"
    Default: "cloudtrail_"

Conditions:
  IsBucketNameProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BucketName, ""]]

Resources:
  S3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - IsBucketNameProvided
        - !Ref BucketName
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            Prefix: cloud-trail/AWSLogs/
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  S3BucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref S3Bucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:GetObjectVersion
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3Bucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3Bucket}"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                "s3:prefix": "cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3Bucket}"

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref DatabaseName
        Description: "Glue database for AWS CloudTrail logs"

  GlueRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "GlueCloudTrailS3Access"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3Bucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${S3Bucket}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                Resource: "*"

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    DependsOn:
      - GlueDatabase
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CrawlerName
      Role: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      Description: "Crawler for AWS CloudTrail logs stored in S3"
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub "s3://${S3Bucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/"
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: "UPDATE_IN_DATABASE"
        DeleteBehavior: "LOG"
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: "CRAWL_EVERYTHING"
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"},"Tables":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"MergeNewColumns"}}}'
      TablePrefix: !Ref TablePrefix
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 2 * * ? *)"

Outputs:
  S3BucketName:
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket storing CloudTrail logs"
    Value: !Ref S3Bucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-S3BucketName"

  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue database created"
    Value: !Ref DatabaseName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GlueDatabaseName"

  GlueCrawlerName:
    Description: "Name of the Glue crawler"
    Value: !Ref GlueCrawler
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GlueCrawlerName"

  IAMRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role used by the Glue crawler"
    Value: !GetAtt GlueRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IAMRoleArn"

    Type: String
    Default: DeployUser
    Description: Name for the IAM user
  GroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: DeployGroup
    Description: Name for the IAM group

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Cognito Identity Pool with unauthenticated access for chatbot using Lex, Translate, Comprehend, Cognito Sync, and Mobile Analytics'
Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: ChatbotIdentityPool
    Description: Name for the Cognito Identity Pool
Resources:
  ChatbotIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref ChatbotIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChatbotUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lex:PostContent
                  - lex:PostText
                  - translate:TranslateText
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectEntities
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectDominantLanguage
                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                  - cognito-sync:UpdateRecords
                  - cognito-sync:SubscribeToDataset
                  - cognito-sync:UnsubscribeFromDataset
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeDataset
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeIdentityPoolUsage
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeIdentityUsage
                  - cognito-sync:GetCognitoEvents
                  - cognito-sync:SetCognitoEvents
                  - cognito-sync:QueryRecords
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                  - mobileanalytics:GetReports
                  - mobileanalytics:GetFinancialReports
                Resource: '*'
  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref ChatbotIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn
Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: 'Cognito Identity Pool ID'
    Value: !Ref ChatbotIdentityPool

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Resources:

    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: retaildemostore-bus

  RetailDemoStoreLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/events/retaildemostore-${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 120

  CloudWatchLogsResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "RetailDemoStoreEventBusToCloudWatch-${AWS::StackName}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:CreateLogStream
            Resource: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreLogGroup.Arn
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreEventBus.Arn

  RetailDemoStoreCatchAllRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn:
      - CloudWatchLogsResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: retaildemostore-catch-all
      EventBusName: !Ref RetailDemoStoreEventBus
      EventPattern:
        account:
          - exists: true
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt RetailDemoStoreLogGroup.Arn
          Id: CloudWatchLogsTarget

  RetailDemoStoreArchive:
    Type: AWS::Events::Archive
    Properties:

  RetailDemoStoreSchemaDiscoverer:

    Properties:

      Value: !Ref RetailDemoStoreEventBus

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template to create an idempotency store DynamoDB table with TTL, Point-in-Time Recovery, and an IAM policy for Lambda/Step Functions access.
Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    Description: Prefix used for naming resources.
  TTLDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Number of days for TTL expiration (default 7).
Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PartitionKey
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SortKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PartitionKey
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: SortKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
        - Key: TTLDays
          Value: !Ref TTLDays
  IdempotencyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-policy"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
              - !Sub "${IdempotencyTable.Arn}/*"
Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
  PolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM managed policy for idempotency access.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyPolicy
  TTLDays:
    Description: Configured TTL duration in days.
    Value: !Ref TTLDays

Description: "Creates Cognito User Pool (KibanaUsers) and Identity Pool (KibanaIDPool) for Elasticsearch/Kibana authentication."

  ElasticsearchDomainArn:

    Description: ARN of the Amazon Elasticsearch Service domain for granting HTTP access to authenticated users.
    Default: "arn:aws:es:us-east-1:123456789012:domain/placeholder"
Resources:
  KibanaUsersUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: KibanaUsers
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
  KibanaUsersUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: KibanaUsersClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref KibanaUsersUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
  KibanaIDPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: KibanaIDPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref KibanaUsersUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt KibanaUsersUserPool.ProviderName
  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: KibanaAuthenticatedRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref KibanaIDPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KibanaESAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - es:ESHttpGet
                  - es:ESHttpPost
                  - es:ESHttpPut
                  - es:ESHttpDelete
                  - es:ESHttpHead
                  - es:ESHttpPatch
                Resource: !Ref ElasticsearchDomainArn
  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: KibanaUnauthenticatedRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref KibanaIDPool
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DenyAll
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Deny
                Action: "*"
                Resource: "*"
  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref KibanaIDPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: The client ID of the KibanaUsers User Pool Client

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table for the state machine
Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "StartAt": "PutItem",
              "States": {
                "PutItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Item": {
                      "id": {"S.$": "$.id"},
                      "description": {"S.$": "States.Format('Item with ID: {}', $.id)"}
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.putResult",
                  "Next": "GetItem"
                },
                "GetItem": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:getItem",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "TableName": "${TableName}",
                    "Key": {
                      "id": {"S.$": "$.id"}
                    }
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.getResult",
                  "End": true,
                  "OutputPath": "$.getResult.Item"
                }
              }
            }
          - TableName: !Ref TableName
Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Backend infrastructure for Ask Around Me realtime messaging application using AWS IoT and Cognito.

Resources:
  AskAroundMeIoTThing:
    Type: AWS::IoT::Thing
    Properties:
      ThingName: "askaroundme-realtime"

  AskAroundMeUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "askAroundMeUserPool"
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: false
          AttributeDataType: String
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

  AskAroundMeUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: "askAroundMeClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  AskAroundMeIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: "askAroundMeIdentityPool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt AskAroundMeUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPoolClient
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "askAroundMeAuthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AskAroundMeCognitoSyncPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                  - cognito-sync:UpdateRecords
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeDataset
                  - cognito-sync:SubscribeToDataset
                  - cognito-sync:UnsubscribeFromDataset
                  - cognito-sync:ListDatasets
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AskAroundMeIdentityPool}/*"
        - PolicyName: AskAroundMeIoTPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iot:Connect
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:client/askAroundMe-*"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    "iot:ClientId": "askAroundMe-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iot:Subscribe
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topicfilter/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iot:Receive
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topic/*"

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "askAroundMeUnauthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AskAroundMeCognitoSyncPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:ListRecords
                  - cognito-sync:UpdateRecords
                  - cognito-sync:DescribeDataset
                  - cognito-sync:SubscribeToDataset
                  - cognito-sync:UnsubscribeFromDataset
                  - cognito-sync:ListDatasets
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${AskAroundMeIdentityPool}/*"
        - PolicyName: AskAroundMeIoTPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iot:Connect
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:client/askAroundMe-*"
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    "iot:ClientId": "askAroundMe-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iot:Subscribe
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topicfilter/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iot:Receive
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iot:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:topic/*"

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeUserPoolClient
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito Identity Pool
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeIdentityPool
  AuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for authenticated users
    Value: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for unauthenticated users
    Value: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn
  IoTThingName:
    Description: Name of the IoT Thing
    Value: !Ref AskAroundMeIoTThing

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Chaos engineering workflow using Step Functions to test ECS service resilience by terminating an EC2 instance, waiting 300 seconds, then checking service health and sending SNS alert if unhealthy."

Parameters:
  AmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Description: "SSM parameter path for latest Amazon Linux 2 AMI ID. Default uses /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2"
    Default: "/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2"
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Description: "EC2 instance type."
    Default: t2.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t2.micro
      - t2.small
      - t2.medium
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC."
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: "CIDR block for the public subnet."
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet"

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-rt"

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for EC2 instance and ECS tasks"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sg"

  EC2Instance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref AmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-chaos-instance"

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cluster"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cluster"

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ecs-exec-role"

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-task"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "256"
      Memory: "512"
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: nginx
          Image: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:stable-alpine
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          Essential: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-task-def"

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnet
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ecs-service"

  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alert-topic"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sns-topic"

  TerminateLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateInstancePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-terminate-lambda-role"

  TerminateLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-terminate-instance"
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              instance_id = event['instanceId']
              ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              return {'status': 'terminated', 'instanceId': instance_id}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-terminate-lambda"

  CheckServiceHealthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CheckServiceHealthPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SNSTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-check-lambda-role"

  CheckServiceHealthLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-check-service-health"
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CheckServiceHealthLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, json
          def handler(event, context):
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              sns = boto3.client('sns')
              cluster = event['clusterName']
              service = event['serviceName']
              topic = event['topicArn']
              response = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              svc = response['services'][0]
              deployments = svc.get('deployments', [])
              if deployments:
                  running = deployments[0].get('runningCount', 0)
                  desired = deployments[0].get('desiredCount', 0)
                  if running < desired:
                      sns.publish(
                          TopicArn=topic,
                          Message=json.dumps({'cluster': cluster, 'service': service, 'status': 'UNHEALTHY', 'running': running, 'desired': desired}),
                          Subject=f"ECS Service {service} is unhealthy"
                      )
                      return {'status': 'unhealthy', 'alert_sent': True}
              return {'status': 'healthy', 'alert_sent': False}
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-check-lambda"

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateLambdaFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CheckServiceHealthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-stepfunctions-role"

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-chaos-workflow"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Chaos engineering workflow to terminate EC2 instance, wait, and check ECS service health",
              "StartAt": "Initialize",
              "States": {
                "Initialize": {
                  "Type": "Pass",
                  "Result": {
                    "instanceId": "${InstanceId}",
                    "clusterName": "${ClusterName}",
                    "serviceName": "${ServiceName}",
                    "topicArn": "${TopicArn}"
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.input",
                  "Next": "TerminateInstance"
                },
                "TerminateInstance": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${TerminateLambdaArn}",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "instanceId.$": "$.input.instanceId"
                  },
                  "ResultPath": "$.terminateResult",
                  "Next": "Wait"
                },
                "Wait": {
                  "Type": "Wait",
                  "Seconds": 300,
                  "Next": "CheckServiceHealth"
                },
                "CheckServiceHealth": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "${CheckLambdaArn}",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "clusterName.$": "$.input.clusterName",
                    "serviceName.$": "$.input.serviceName",
                    "topicArn.$": "$.input.topicArn"
                  },
                  "End": true
                }
              }
            }
          - InstanceId: !Ref EC2Instance
            ClusterName: !Ref ECSCluster
            ServiceName: !Ref ECSService
            TopicArn: !Ref SNSTopic
            TerminateLambdaArn: !GetAtt TerminateLambdaFunction.Arn
            CheckLambdaArn: !GetAtt CheckServiceHealthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-state-machine"

Outputs:
  InstanceId:
    Description: "ID of the EC2 instance to be terminated"
    Value: !Ref EC2Instance
  ClusterName:
    Description: "ECS cluster name"
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ServiceName:
    Description: "ECS service name"
    Value: !Ref ECSService
  TopicArn:
    Description: "SNS topic ARN for alerts"
    Value: !Ref SNSTopic
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Step Functions state machine"
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Creates IAM roles for a DevOps agent service and operator application with optional trust relationship conditions for aidevops.amazonaws.com, attaches managed policies, adds inline policy for service-linked role creation, configures DevOps Guru resource collection for monitoring, and outputs relevant identifiers.'

Parameters:
  SourceAccount:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Optional AWS account ID to restrict trust relationship. Leave empty to allow any account.'
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be empty or a 12-digit AWS account ID.'

  SourceArn:
    Type: String
    Description: 'Optional ARN to restrict trust relationship. Leave empty to allow any ARN.'
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws:.*:.*:.*:.*$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be empty or a valid ARN.'

Conditions:
  HasSourceAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceAccount, '']]
  HasSourceArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceArn, '']]
  HasBothConditions: !And [Condition: HasSourceAccount, Condition: HasSourceArn]

Resources:
  AgentRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'aidevops.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition: !If
              - HasBothConditions
              -
                StringEquals:
                  'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref SourceAccount
                ArnLike:
                  'aws:SourceArn': !Ref SourceArn
              - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudFormationReadOnlyAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: 'AllowCreateServiceLinkedRoles'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole'
                Resource: '*'

  OperatorRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'aidevops.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
            Condition: !If
              - HasBothConditions
              -
                StringEquals:
                  'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref SourceAccount
                ArnLike:
                  'aws:SourceArn': !Ref SourceArn
              - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'

  MonitoringResourceCollection:
    Type: 'AWS::DevOpsGuru::ResourceCollection'
    Properties:
      ResourceCollectionFilter:
        CloudFormation:
          StackNames:
            - '*'

Outputs:
  AgentSpaceId:
    Description: 'The ID of the DevOps agent space (CloudFormation stack ID).'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackId'

  AgentSpaceArn:
    Description: 'The ARN of the DevOps agent space (CloudFormation stack ARN).'
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stack/${AWS::StackName}/${AWS::StackId}'

  AgentSpaceName:
    Description: 'The name of the DevOps agent space (CloudFormation stack name).'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  OperatorUrl:
    Description: 'The URL for the operator console.'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/devops/home'

  AgentRoleArn:
    Description: 'The ARN of the agent IAM role.'
    Value: !GetAtt AgentRole.Arn

  OperatorRoleArn:
    Description: 'The ARN of the operator IAM role.'
    Value: !GetAtt OperatorRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Demo stack: SSM parameters, Secrets Manager secret, and Lambda function to read them."

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SSMAndSecretsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${AWS::StackName}-*"

  Param1:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/param1"
      Type: String
      Value: "value1"
      Description: "First parameter under stack path"

  Param2:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/param2"
      Type: String
      Value: "value2"
      Description: "Second parameter under stack path"

  Param3:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AWS::StackName}/param3"
      Type: String
      Value: "value3"
      Description: "Third parameter under stack path"

  DemoSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-demo-secret"
      Description: "Demo secret with generated password"
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"demo"}'
        GenerateStringKey: "password"
        PasswordLength: 16
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/'

  ParameterStoreDemo:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ['STACK_NAME']
              ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
              secretsmanager = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

              # Retrieve SSM parameters under the stack path
              print("--- SSM Parameters ---")
              try:
                  paginator = ssm.get_paginator('get_parameters_by_path')
                  for page in paginator.paginate(Path='/' + stack_name + '/', Recursive=False):
                      for param in page.get('Parameters', []):
                          print("Name: " + param['Name'] + ", Value: " + param['Value'])
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Error retrieving SSM parameters: " + str(e))

              # Retrieve secrets whose name starts with the stack name
              print("--- Secrets Manager Secrets ---")
              try:
                  paginator = secretsmanager.get_paginator('list_secrets')
                  for page in paginator.paginate(
                      Filters=[{'Key': 'name', 'Values': [stack_name]}]
                  ):
                      for secret in page.get('SecretList', []):
                          secret_name = secret['Name']
                          try:
                              response = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_name)
                              secret_string = response.get('SecretString', '')
                              print("Secret Name: " + secret_name + ", Value: " + secret_string[:100])
                          except Exception as e:
                              print("Error retrieving secret " + secret_name + ": " + str(e))
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Error listing secrets: " + str(e))

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,

      Role: !GetAtt ValidationHookLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs24.x

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates an SSM Document and Association to collect custom inventory of running database and caching processes on EC2 instances."
Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Linux instances."
  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Windows instances."
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(30 days)"
    Description: "Schedule expression for the SSM Association (e.g., rate(30 days) or cron expression)."
Resources:
  CustomInventoryDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: "Custom inventory collection for running database and caching processes."
        parameters:
          LinuxProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
            description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search on Linux."
          WindowsProcessKeywords:
            type: String
            default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
            description: "Comma-separated list of process keywords to search on Windows."
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: LinuxProcessCheck
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  set -e
                  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  KEYWORDS_CSV='{{ LinuxProcessKeywords }}'
                  python3 -c '
                  import subprocess, json, sys, os
                  keywords = sys.argv[1].split(",")
                  instance_id = sys.argv[2]
                  output = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "aux"]).decode().splitlines()
                  processes = []
                  for line in output[1:]:
                      parts = line.split(None, 10)
                      if len(parts) < 11:
                          continue
                      user, pid, cpu, mem, vsz, rss, tty, stat, start, time, cmd = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4], parts[5], parts[6], parts[7], parts[8], parts[9], parts[10]
                      cmd_lower = cmd.lower()
                      for kw in keywords:
                          kw_lower = kw.strip().lower()
                          if kw_lower and kw_lower in cmd_lower:
                              processes.append({"ProcessKeyword": kw.strip(), "PID": pid, "CommandLine": cmd})
                              break
                  inventory_dir = "/var/lib/amazon/ssm/" + instance_id + "/inventory/custom"
                  os.makedirs(inventory_dir, exist_ok=True)
                  with open(os.path.join(inventory_dir, "custom-processes.json"), "w") as f:
                      json.dump(processes, f)
                  ' "$KEYWORDS_CSV" "$INSTANCE_ID"
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: WindowsProcessCheck
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $instanceId = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id')
                  $keywords = "{{ WindowsProcessKeywords }}".Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() }
                  $processes = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process | Where-Object {
                      $cmd = $_.CommandLine
                      $matched = $false
                      foreach ($kw in $keywords) {
                          if ($cmd -match [regex]::Escape($kw)) { $matched = $true; break }
                      }
                      $matched
                  } | Select-Object @{N='ProcessKeyword';E={$_.Name}}, @{N='PID';E={$_.ProcessId}}, @{N='CommandLine';E={$_.CommandLine}}
                  $json = $processes | ConvertTo-Json
                  $inventoryDir = "C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\$instanceId\inventory\custom"
                  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $inventoryDir
                  Set-Content -Path "$inventoryDir\custom-processes.json" -Value $json
  CustomInventoryAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
      DocumentVersion: "$DEFAULT"
      Parameters:
        LinuxProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsProcessKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords
      Targets:
        - Key: "InstanceIds"
          Values:
            - "*"
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: "Name of the custom SSM Document"
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
  AssociationId:
    Description: "ID of the SSM Association"
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryAssociation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Colorteller demo using VPC Lattice with two target groups, weighted routing, and Cloud Map service discovery'

    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet1'
  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet2'
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC Lattice endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 9080
          ToPort: 9080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::HttpNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller
      NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
  VpcLatticeServiceNetwork:
    Type: AWS::VpcLattice::ServiceNetwork
    Properties:
      Name: colorgateway
      AuthType: NONE
  VpcLatticeServiceNetworkVpcAssociation:
    Type: AWS::VpcLattice::ServiceNetworkVpcAssociation
    Properties:
      ServiceNetworkIdentifier: !Ref VpcLatticeServiceNetwork
      VpcIdentifier: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
  TargetGroupBlue:
    Type: AWS::VpcLattice::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-blue'
      Type: INSTANCE
      Config:
        Port: 9080
        Protocol: HTTP
        VpcIdentifier: !Ref VPC
        HealthCheck:
          Enabled: true
          HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 5
          HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 2
          HealthyThresholdCount: 2
          UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
          Path: /ping
          Port: 9080
          Protocol: HTTP
  TargetGroupGreen:
    Type: AWS::VpcLattice::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-green'
      Type: INSTANCE
      Config:
        Port: 9080
        Protocol: HTTP
        VpcIdentifier: !Ref VPC
        HealthCheck:
          Enabled: true
          HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 5
          HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 2
          HealthyThresholdCount: 2
          UnhealthyThresholdCount: 2
          Path: /ping
          Port: 9080
          Protocol: HTTP
  VpcLatticeService:
    Type: AWS::VpcLattice::Service
    Properties:
      Name: colorteller
      AuthType: NONE
  VpcLatticeServiceNetworkServiceAssociation:
    Type: AWS::VpcLattice::ServiceNetworkServiceAssociation
    Properties:
      ServiceNetworkIdentifier: !Ref VpcLatticeServiceNetwork
      ServiceIdentifier: !Ref VpcLatticeService
  VpcLatticeListener:
    Type: AWS::VpcLattice::Listener
    Properties:
      ServiceIdentifier: !Ref VpcLatticeService
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 9080
      DefaultAction:
