AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for serverless content moderation API using Rekognition"
Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: Name of the API Gateway stage
Resources:
  ContentModerationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: "*"
  ContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt ContentModerationLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import boto3
          import os
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                  url = body.get('url')
                  if not url:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing URL in request body'})
                      }
                  allowed_extensions = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
                  if not url.lower().endswith(allowed_extensions):
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, png allowed.'})
                      }
                  try:
                      req = urllib.request.Request(url, method='GET')
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
                          image_data = response.read()
                          if len(image_data) > 5 * 1024 * 1024:
                              return {
                                  'statusCode': 413,
                                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                                  'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Image size exceeds 5MB limit.'})
                              }
                  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': e.code,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': f'Failed to fetch image: HTTP {e.code}'})
                      }
                  except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 502,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': f'Failed to fetch image: {e.reason}'})
                      }
                  client = boto3.client('rekognition')
                  try:
                      response = client.detect_moderation_labels(
                          Image={'Bytes': image_data},
                          MinConfidence=60
                      )
                      labels = response.get('ModerationLabels', [])
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'labels': labels})
                      }
                  except Exception as e:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 500,
                          'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': f'Rekognition error: {str(e)}'})
                      }
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 400,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})
                  }
  LambdaApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ContentModerationFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/POST/*"
  ContentModerationApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: ContentModeration
      Description: API for content moderation using Rekognition
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  ContentModerationResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt ContentModerationApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: moderate
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
  ContentModerationMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ContentModerationResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ContentModerationFunction.Arn}/invocations"
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
  ContentModerationDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ContentModerationMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: URL of the content moderation API endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${ContentModerationApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/moderate"
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ContentModerationFunction.Arn

                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ClosureFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import time

          org = boto3.client('organizations')
          tagging = boto3.client('resourcegroupstaggingapi')

          def handler(event, context):
              accounts = []
              paginator = tagging.get_paginator('get_resources')
              for page in paginator.paginate(TagFilters=[{'Key': 'organizations:account-closure', 'Values': ['REQUESTED']}]):
                  for resource in page.get('ResourceTagMappingList', []):
                      arn = resource['ResourceARN']
                      parts = arn.split('/')
                      if len(parts) >= 3:
                          accounts.append(parts[-1])

              processed = []
              errors = []
              for aid in accounts:
                  try:
                      account = org.describe_account(AccountId=aid)['Account']
                      if account['Status'] == 'ACTIVE':
                          org.close_account(AccountId=aid)
                          org.tag_resource(ResourceId=aid, Tags=[{'Key': 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'Value': ''}])
                          processed.append({'accountId': aid, 'status': 'CLOSED'})
                      else:
                          processed.append({'accountId': aid, 'status': account['Status']})
                  except org.exceptions.AccountNotFoundException:
                      errors.append({'accountId': aid, 'error': 'NotFound'})
                  except org.exceptions.AccessDeniedException:
                      errors.append({'accountId': aid, 'error': 'AccessDenied'})
                  except org.exceptions.TooManyRequestsException:
                      time.sleep(2)
                      try:
                          account = org.describe_account(AccountId=aid)['Account']
                          if account['Status'] == 'ACTIVE':
                              org.close_account(AccountId=aid)
                              org.tag_resource(ResourceId=aid, Tags=[{'Key': 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'Value': ''}])
                              processed.append({'accountId': aid, 'status': 'CLOSED'})
                          else:
                              processed.append({'accountId': aid, 'status': account['Status']})
                      except Exception as e:
                          errors.append({'accountId': aid, 'error': str(e)})
                  except Exception as e:
                      errors.append({'accountId': aid, 'error': str(e)})

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'processed': processed,
                  'errors': errors,
                  'totalAccounts': len(accounts)
              }

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt ClosureFunction.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                Resource: '*'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ExecutionLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "Comment": "Close accounts tagged with organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED",
              "StartAt": "InvokeClosureLambda",
              "States": {
                "InvokeClosureLambda": {
                  "Type": "Task",
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke",
                  "Parameters": {
                    "FunctionName": "${ClosureFunctionArn}",
                    "Payload.$": "$"
                  },
                  "Retry": [
                    {
                      "ErrorEquals": [
                        "Lambda.ServiceException",
                        "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException"
                      ],
                      "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                      "MaxAttempts": 3,
                      "BackoffRate": 2
                    }
                  ],
                  "Catch": [
                    {
                      "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                      "ResultPath": "$.error",
                      "Next": "HandleError"
                    }
                  ],
                  "Next": "Success"
                },
                "HandleError": {
                  "Type": "Fail",
                  "Cause": "Lambda invocation failed",
                  "Error": "ClosureError"
                },
                "Success": {
                  "Type": "Succeed"
                }
              }
            }
          - ClosureFunctionArn: !GetAtt ClosureFunction.Arn

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn
          Id: TargetStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for StudyBuddy Cognito authentication infrastructure"

Parameters:
  FrontendDomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: "The domain name of the frontend application (e.g., app.studybuddy.com)"
    AllowedPattern: "^([a-zA-Z0-9-]+\\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}$"
    Default: "app.studybuddy.com"
  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: "Google OAuth client ID"
    Default: "your-google-client-id"
  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: "Google OAuth client secret"
    Default: "your-google-client-secret"
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: "StudyBuddyUserPool"
    Description: "Name for the Cognito user pool"
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "studybuddy"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$"
    Description: "Prefix for the Cognito Hosted UI domain. A short random suffix will be appended to ensure global uniqueness."

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  PostAuthenticationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PostAuth"
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('Post Authentication event', JSON.stringify(event));
            return event;
          };

  PostConfirmationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PostConfirm"
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('Post Confirmation event', JSON.stringify(event));
            return event;
          };

  PreSignUpLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PreSignUp"
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            console.log('Pre Sign Up event', JSON.stringify(event));
            return event;
          };

  PostAuthenticationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthenticationLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"

  PostConfirmationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostConfirmationLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"

  PreSignUpPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PreSignUpLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationLambda.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationLambda.Arn
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpLambda.Arn
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolIdentityProviderGoogle
    Properties:
      ClientName: "StudyBuddyFrontend"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${FrontendDomainName}/callback"
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub "https://${FrontendDomainName}/logout"
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub
        - "${Prefix}-${Suffix}"
        - Prefix: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix
          Suffix: !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - "-"
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - "/"
                  - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  GoogleOAuthSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/studybuddy/google-oauth-${AWS::StackName}"
      Description: "Google OAuth client ID and secret for StudyBuddy"
      SecretString:
        Fn::Sub: '{"client_id":"${GoogleClientId}","client_secret":"${GoogleClientSecret}"}'

  UserPoolIdentityProviderGoogle:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: "profile email openid"
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
      IdpIdentifiers:
        - "Google"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "ID of the Cognito user pool"
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: "ID of the app client"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  CognitoDomain:
    Description: "Cognito Hosted UI domain"
    Value: !Sub
      - "https://${Prefix}-${Suffix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      - Prefix: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix
        Suffix: !Select
          - 0
          - !Split
            - "-"
            - !Select
              - 2
              - !Split
                - "/"
                - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
  GoogleSecretArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Secrets Manager secret containing Google OAuth credentials"
    Value: !Ref GoogleOAuthSecret

  ControlIdS3Public:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the control ID for S3 public access findings
    Default: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/dummy"
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/.*$
  ControlIdConfig:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the control ID for AWS Config regional coverage
    Default: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/dummy"
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/.*$
  ControlIdCIS1:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of a CIS benchmark control ID
    Default: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/dummy"
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/.*$
  ControlIdCIS2:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of another CIS benchmark control ID
    Default: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/dummy"
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/.*$
  PublicBucketARN1:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of an intentionally public S3 bucket
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:::nonexistent-bucket"
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws:s3:::[\w.-]+$
  PublicBucketARN2:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of another intentionally public S3 bucket (optional, set to "none" if not used)
    Default: "none"
    AllowedPattern: ^arn:aws:s3:::[\w.-]+|none$
  EBSEncryptionAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Account ID for which the EBS default encryption finding should be suppressed
    Default: "000000000000"
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
  UnusedCredentialAccount1:
    Type: String
    Description: First account ID for unused credential findings suppression
    Default: "000000000000"
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}$
  UnusedCredentialAccount2:
    Type: String
    Description: Second account ID for unused credential findings suppression (optional, set to "none")
    Default: "none"
    AllowedPattern: ^\d{12}|none$
  GuardDutyFindingType:
    Type: String
    Description: GuardDuty finding type to suppress
    Default: "UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/InstanceCredentialExfiltration.OutsideAWS"
Conditions:
  HasSecondBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PublicBucketARN2, "none"]]
  HasSecondUnusedAccount: !Not [!Equals [!Ref UnusedCredentialAccount2, "none"]]
Resources:
  EnableSecurityHub:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::Hub
    Properties: {}
  SuppressIAMFindings:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressIAMFindingsExcludingUsers
      Description: Suppresses IAM findings for all users except the two excluded ones
      RuleOrder: 1
      Criteria:
        ResourceType:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "AwsIamUser"
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ExcludedIAMUserARN1
          - Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ExcludedIAMUserARN2
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "This IAM finding is accepted as non-actionable (excluded users may still need attention)."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressCISFindingsSubAccount:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressCISFindingsSubAccount
      Description: Suppresses all CIS benchmark findings for the specified sub-account
      RuleOrder: 2
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CISSubAccountId
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: PREFIX
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "This CIS finding is reviewed and accepted for the designated sub-account."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressBroadFSBPCIS:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressBroadFSBPCISFindings
      Description: Suppresses selected FSBP and CIS findings organization-wide
      RuleOrder: 3
      Criteria:
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ControlIdSG
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ControlIdS3Public
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ControlIdConfig
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ControlIdCIS1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref ControlIdCIS2
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "This finding is related to security groups, S3 public access, or AWS Config and is accepted as expected or non-actionable."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressPublicBucketFindings1:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressPublicBucketFindings1
      Description: Suppresses public access findings for the first intentionally public bucket
      RuleOrder: 4
      Criteria:
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref PublicBucketARN1
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "This S3 bucket is intentionally public."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressPublicBucketFindings2:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Condition: HasSecondBucket
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressPublicBucketFindings2
      Description: Suppresses public access findings for the second intentionally public bucket
      RuleOrder: 5
      Criteria:
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref PublicBucketARN2
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "This S3 bucket is intentionally public."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressEBSEncryptionFinding:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressEBSEncryptionFinding
      Description: Suppresses EBS default encryption finding for a specific account
      RuleOrder: 6
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref EBSEncryptionAccountId
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/rule/EC2.14"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "EBS default encryption is not required for this account."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings1:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings1
      Description: Suppresses unused credential findings for the first account
      RuleOrder: 7
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref UnusedCredentialAccount1
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/rule/IAM.1"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/rule/IAM.8"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/rule/1.3"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/rule/1.4"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "These credentials are used for infrequent automation and are intentionally not rotated."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings2:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Condition: HasSecondUnusedAccount
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings2
      Description: Suppresses unused credential findings for the second account
      RuleOrder: 8
      Criteria:
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref UnusedCredentialAccount2
        GeneratorId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/rule/IAM.1"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/aws-foundational-security-best-practices/v/1.0.0/rule/IAM.8"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/rule/1.3"
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: "arn:aws:securityhub:::ruleset/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v/1.2.0/rule/1.4"
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "These credentials are used for infrequent automation and are intentionally not rotated."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
  SuppressGuardDutyFinding:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    DependsOn: EnableSecurityHub
    Properties:
      RuleName: SuppressGuardDutyFinding
      Description: Suppresses a specific GuardDuty finding type for expected Bedrock API activity
      RuleOrder: 9
      Criteria:
        Type:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref GuardDutyFindingType
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: "This GuardDuty finding is expected due to cross-account Bedrock API activity."
              UpdatedBy: "SecurityHubAutomationRule"
Outputs:
  SuppressIAMFindingsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressIAMFindings.RuleArn
  SuppressCISFindingsSubAccountRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CIS sub-account suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressCISFindingsSubAccount.RuleArn
  SuppressBroadFSBPCISRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the broad FSBP/CIS suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressBroadFSBPCIS.RuleArn
  SuppressPublicBucketFindings1RuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the first public bucket suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressPublicBucketFindings1.RuleArn
  SuppressPublicBucketFindings2RuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the second public bucket suppression rule (if created)
    Value: !If [HasSecondBucket, !GetAtt SuppressPublicBucketFindings2.RuleArn, "N/A"]
  SuppressEBSEncryptionFindingRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EBS encryption suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressEBSEncryptionFinding.RuleArn
  SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings1RuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the first unused credential suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings1.RuleArn
  SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings2RuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the second unused credential suppression rule (if created)
    Value: !If [HasSecondUnusedAccount, !GetAtt SuppressUnusedCredentialFindings2.RuleArn, "N/A"]
  SuppressGuardDutyFindingRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the GuardDuty finding suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressGuardDutyFinding.RuleArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for bac-mcp-tool Lambda and Bedrock AgentCore Gateway role

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBedrockPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: LambdaCostExplorerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                  - ce:GetCostForecast
                  - ce:GetDimensionValues
                  - ce:GetReservationUtilization
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization
                  - ce:GetTags
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: LambdaS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: LambdaLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: LambdaXRayPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GatewayLambdaInvokePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GatewayBedrockAgentCorePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:CreateAgent
                  - bedrock:UpdateAgent
                  - bedrock:DeleteAgent
                  - bedrock:GetAgent
                  - bedrock:ListAgents
                  - bedrock:InvokeAgent
                  - bedrock:CreateAgentActionGroup
                  - bedrock:UpdateAgentActionGroup
                  - bedrock:DeleteAgentActionGroup
                  - bedrock:GetAgentActionGroup
                  - bedrock:ListAgentActionGroups
                  - bedrock:CreateAgentAlias
                  - bedrock:UpdateAgentAlias
                  - bedrock:DeleteAgentAlias
                  - bedrock:GetAgentAlias
                  - bedrock:ListAgentAliases
                  - bedrock:AssociateAgentKnowledgeBase
                  - bedrock:DisassociateAgentKnowledgeBase
                  - bedrock:ListAgentKnowledgeBases
                  - bedrock:UpdateAgentKnowledgeBase
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GatewayPassRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/*'
        - PolicyName: GatewayS3Policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GatewayLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps('Hello from bac-mcp-tool')}
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 900
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayRole.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for EC2 Image Builder pipeline to produce custom Amazon Linux 2023 ARM-based AMI hardened with CIS Level 1 and pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility."

Parameters:
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of the parent CIS hardened AL2023 ARM image (e.g., arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:123456789012:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/1.0.0/1)"
  OrganizationArn:
    Type: String
    Description: "Full ARN of the AWS Organization (e.g., arn:aws:organizations::123456789012:organization/o-xxxxxx)"
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: "Dev AWS account ID for AMI sharing"
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: "Prod AWS account ID for AMI sharing"
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: "al2023-eb-harden-pipeline"
    Description: "Name of the Image Builder pipeline"
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: "t4g.micro"
    AllowedValues:
      - t4g.nano
      - t4g.micro
      - t4g.small
      - t4g.medium
      - t4g.large
    Description: "ARM instance type for building the image"
  LogBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "imagebuilder-logs"
    Description: "Base name for S3 log bucket (a random suffix will be appended)"

Resources:
  # IAM role for Image Builder service to manage resources
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderServiceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServiceCustomPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateVolume
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DeleteVolume
                  - ec2:AttachVolume
                  - ec2:DetachVolume
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:CreateKeyPair
                  - ec2:DeleteKeyPair
                  - ec2:ImportKeyPair
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - inspector2:*
                  - imagebuilder:*
                Resource: "*"

  # IAM role for EC2 instance profile used during image build
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderInstanceCustomPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # Custom component to pre-configure for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
  EBPreConfigComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-eb-preconfig"
      Platform: "Linux"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      Description: "Component to pre-configure the AMI for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility"
      Data: |
        name: EBPreConfiguration
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - phase: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallDocker
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: InstallAwsCli
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y aws-cli
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: SetupEBEnvironment
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - chmod 755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - echo 'export EB_CONFIG_DIR="/opt/elasticbeanstalk"' >> /etc/profile.d/eb_config.sh
                    - echo 'export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin' >> /etc/profile.d/eb_config.sh
                    - chmod +x /etc/profile.d/eb_config.sh

  # Image Recipe using parent CIS hardened AL2023 ARM image
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-recipe"
      Version: "1.0.0"
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref EBPreConfigComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: "/tmp"

  # Infrastructure Configuration
  InfraConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-infra"
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LogBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: "/imagebuilder-logs/"
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-build-instance"

  # Distribution Configuration with launch permissions
  DistConfig:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-dist"
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "al2023-eb-hardened-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: "CIS Level 1 hardened AL2023 ARM AMI pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk"
            AmiTags:
              Environment: Production
              Compliance: CIS
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Ref OrganizationArn
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId

  # Lifecycle Policy to delete images after 6 months (180 days)
  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-lifecycle"
      Description: "Automatically delete images older than 180 days"
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: "AMI"
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !Sub "${PipelineName}-recipe"
            SemanticVersion: "1.0.0"
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: "AGE"
            Value: 180
            Unit: "DAYS"
            RetainAtLeast: 1
      Status: ENABLED

  # Security Group for build instance
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 22
          ToPort: 22
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  # VPC for build infrastructure
  BuildVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${PipelineName}-vpc"

  # Internet Gateway for public subnet
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${PipelineName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Route Table for public subnet
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Maths MCP server placeholder'})
              }

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      Description: Maths MCP API
      EndpointConfiguration:

  HealthCheckMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:

      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  Authorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoAuthorizer
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref Authorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{ "statusCode": 200 }'
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - HealthCheckMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*'

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Base URL of the Maths MCP API
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Amazon Verified Permissions policy store for Bookstore application with Cedar-based access control
Parameters:
  ForbiddenAdminUserId:
    Type: String
    Description: User ID of the specific admin to forbid from viewing books
    Default: admin-forbidden@example.com
  PermittedUserId:
    Type: String
    Description: User ID of the specific user allowed to view a specific book
    Default: specific-user@example.com
  PermittedBookId:
    Type: String
    Description: Book ID of the specific book a specific user is allowed to view
    Default: specific-book-id
  SsmParameterPath:
    Type: String
    Description: Path for the SSM parameter to store the policy store ID
    Default: /bookstore/policy-store-id
Resources:
  PolicyStore:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::PolicyStore
    Properties:
      ValidationSettings:
        Mode: STRICT
      Schema:
        CedarJson: >-
          {
            "Bookstore": {
              "entityTypes": {
                "Role": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {}
                  }
                },
                "User": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "yearsAsMember": { "type": "Long" },
                      "role": { "type": "Entity", "name": "Role" }
                    }
                  }
                },
                "Book": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "owningUser": { "type": "Entity", "name": "User" }
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "actions": {
                "View": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": ["User"],
                    "resourceTypes": ["Book"]
                  },
                  "memberOf": []
                },
                "ViewWithPremiumOffers": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": ["User"],
                    "resourceTypes": ["Book"]
                  },
                  "memberOf": []
                }
              }
            }
          }
  AdminViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref PolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in Admin role to view any book
          Statement: |-
            permit (
                principal is Bookstore::User,
                action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
                resource is Bookstore::Book
            )
            when {
                principal.role == Bookstore::Role::"Admin"
            };
  ForbidSpecificAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref PolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid a specific admin from viewing books, overriding general admin permission
          Statement:
            Fn::Sub:
              - |-
                forbid (
                    principal is Bookstore::User,
                    action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
                    resource is Bookstore::Book
                )
                when {
                    principal == Bookstore::User::"${ForbiddenAdminUserId}"
                };
              - ForbiddenAdminUserId: !Ref ForbiddenAdminUserId
  PublisherViewOwnPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref PolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in Publisher role to view only books they own
          Statement: |-
            permit (
                principal is Bookstore::User,
                action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
                resource is Bookstore::Book
            )
            when {
                principal.role == Bookstore::Role::"Publisher" &&
                resource.owningUser == principal
            };
  SpecificUserViewSpecificBookPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref PolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit a specific user to view a specific book
          Statement:
            Fn::Sub:
              - |-
                permit (
                    principal == Bookstore::User::"${PermittedUserId}",
                    action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
                    resource == Bookstore::Book::"${PermittedBookId}"
                );
              - PermittedUserId: !Ref PermittedUserId
                PermittedBookId: !Ref PermittedBookId
  CustomerPremiumOffersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref PolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in Customer role to view premium offers if they have been a member for 2 or more years
          Statement: |-
            permit (
                principal is Bookstore::User,
                action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers",
                resource is Bookstore::Book
            )
            when {
                principal.role == Bookstore::Role::"Customer" &&
                principal.yearsAsMember >= 2
            };
  ForbidCustomerPremiumOffersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref PolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid customers with less than 2 years of membership from viewing premium offers
          Statement: |-
            forbid (
                principal is Bookstore::User,
                action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers",
                resource is Bookstore::Book
            )
            when {
                principal.role == Bookstore::Role::"Customer" &&
                principal.yearsAsMember < 2
            };
  RegionForbidPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref PolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid View and ViewWithPremiumOffers actions when the request context region is not US
          Statement: |-
            forbid (
                principal is Bookstore::User,
                action in [Bookstore::Action::"View", Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers"],
                resource is Bookstore::Book
            )
            when {
                context.region != "US"
            };
  PolicyStoreIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref SsmParameterPath
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref PolicyStore
      Description: Policy store ID for the Bookstore application
      Tier: Standard
Outputs:
  PolicyStoreId:
    Description: ID of the created Amazon Verified Permissions policy store
    Value: !Ref PolicyStore
  PolicyStoreIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM Parameter name containing the policy store ID
    Value: !Ref SsmParameterPath

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for nih-grants Cognito authentication infrastructure
Resources:
  NihGrantsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: nih-grants-user-pool
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig: {}
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      EmailVerificationMessage: Your verification code is {####}
      EmailVerificationSubject: Your verification code
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 11
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
  NihGrantsWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-web-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      UserPoolId: !Ref NihGrantsUserPool
  NihGrantsGeneralClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: nih-grants-general-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      UserPoolId: !Ref NihGrantsUserPool
  NihGrantsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: nih-grants-identity-pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref NihGrantsWebClient
          ProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${NihGrantsUserPool}
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
        - ClientId: !Ref NihGrantsGeneralClient
          ProviderName: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${NihGrantsUserPool}
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
  NihGrantsAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-authenticated-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref NihGrantsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-authenticated-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:s3:::nih-grants-context-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'kms:RequestAlias': alias/nih-grants-s3-key
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*/POST/@connections/*
  NihGrantsUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: nih-grants-unauthenticated-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref NihGrantsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: nih-grants-unauthenticated-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Deny
                Action: '*'
                Resource: '*'
  NihGrantsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref NihGrantsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt NihGrantsAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt NihGrantsUnauthenticatedRole.Arn
      RoleMappings:
        NihGrantsWebMapping:
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: AuthenticatedRole
          IdentityProvider: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${NihGrantsUserPool}:${NihGrantsWebClient}
        NihGrantsGeneralMapping:
          Type: Token
          AmbiguousRoleResolution: AuthenticatedRole
          IdentityProvider: !Sub cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${NihGrantsUserPool}:${NihGrantsGeneralClient}

      ValidateRequestParameters: false
  EmailResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt EmailApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: email
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaSESPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ses:SendEmail
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/EmailSubmissionFunction:*'
  EmailFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: EmailSubmissionFunction
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: nodejs24.x
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          const ses = new AWS.SES();

          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            try {
              const body = JSON.parse(event.body);
              const params = {
                Source: body.from,
                Destination: {
                  ToAddresses: body.to,
                  CcAddresses: body.cc || [],
                  BccAddresses: body.bcc || []
                },
                Message: {
                  Subject: {
                    Data: body.subject || 'No Subject',
                    Charset: 'UTF-8'
                  },
                  Body: {
                    Text: { Data: body.text, Charset: 'UTF-8' },
                    Html: { Data: body.html, Charset: 'UTF-8' }
                  }
                }
              };
              const result = await ses.sendEmail(params).promise();
              return {
                statusCode: 200,
                headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ messageId: result.MessageId })
              };
            } catch (error) {
              return {
                statusCode: 400,
                headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ error: error.message })
              };
            }
          };
  ApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref EmailFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${EmailApi}/*/POST/email'
  EmailMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayPermission
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      ResourceId: !Ref EmailResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref EmailRequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref EmailModel
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: !Ref EmptyResponseModel
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: !Ref EmptyResponseModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EmailFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  EmailApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: EmailMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
  EmailApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref EmailApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref EmailApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
  EmailApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiKeyName
      Description: 'API Key for Email Submission API'
      Enabled: true
  EmailUsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    DependsOn: EmailApiStage
    Properties:
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref EmailApi
          Stage: !Ref StageName
      Throttle:
        BurstLimit: 1000
        RateLimit: 500
      Quota:
        Limit: 10000
        Period: MONTH
  EmailUsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref EmailApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref EmailUsagePlan
Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: 'API Gateway endpoint URL for the email submission endpoint'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${EmailApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/email'
  ApiKeyId:
    Description: 'ID of the API key (value available in API Gateway console)'
    Value: !Ref EmailApiKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Nested stack to conditionally subscribe multiple endpoints to an existing SNS topic"
Parameters:
  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:placeholder-topic"
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic to which subscriptions will be created (required)"
  Email:
    Type: String
    Default: "example@example.com"
    Description: "Email address for email subscription (leave as default to skip)"
  SqsQueueArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:placeholder-queue"
    Description: "ARN of the SQS queue for SQS subscription (leave as default to skip)"
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Default: "arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:placeholder-function"
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda function for Lambda subscription (leave as default to skip)"
  HttpsEndpointUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: "https://placeholder.example.com"
    Description: "HTTPS endpoint URL for HTTPS subscription (leave as default to skip)"
Conditions:
  HasValidTopicArn:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: SnsTopicArn
          - "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:placeholder-topic"
  HasEmail:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasValidTopicArn
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - Ref: Email
              - "example@example.com"
  HasSqs:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasValidTopicArn
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - Ref: SqsQueueArn
              - "arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:placeholder-queue"
  HasLambda:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasValidTopicArn
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - Ref: LambdaFunctionArn
              - "arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:placeholder-function"
  HasHttps:
    Fn::And:
      - Condition: HasValidTopicArn
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - Ref: HttpsEndpointUrl
              - "https://placeholder.example.com"
Resources:
  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn:
        Ref: SnsTopicArn
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint:
        Ref: Email
  SqsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasSqs
    Properties:
      TopicArn:
        Ref: SnsTopicArn
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint:
        Ref: SqsQueueArn
  LambdaSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasLambda
    Properties:
      TopicArn:
        Ref: SnsTopicArn
      Protocol: lambda
      Endpoint:
        Ref: LambdaFunctionArn
  HttpsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasHttps
    Properties:
      TopicArn:
        Ref: SnsTopicArn
      Protocol: https
      Endpoint:
        Ref: HttpsEndpointUrl
      DeliveryPolicy:
        healthyRetryPolicy:
          minDelayTarget: 1
          maxDelayTarget: 60
          numRetries: 5
          numMaxDelayRetries: 2
          numNoDelayRetries: 0
          numMinDelayRetries: 0
          backoffFunction: exponential
        throttlePolicy:
          maxReceivesPerSecond: 10
Outputs:
  EmailSubscriptionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the email subscription if created"
    Value:
      Fn::If:
        - HasEmail
        - Ref: EmailSubscription
        - ""
  SqsSubscriptionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the SQS subscription if created"
    Value:
      Fn::If:
        - HasSqs
        - Ref: SqsSubscription
        - ""
  LambdaSubscriptionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda subscription if created"
    Value:
      Fn::If:
        - HasLambda
        - Ref: LambdaSubscription
        - ""
  HttpsSubscriptionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the HTTPS subscription if created"
    Value:
      Fn::If:
        - HasHttps
        - Ref: HttpsSubscription
        - ""
