AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to build a custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI using EC2 Image Builder for a bastion-style server image with configurable EBS root volume size, MongoDB 8.0 tools, Python/Synapse client, .NET SDK, and SSM Agent. Creates a self-contained VPC with public and private subnets, NAT Gateway, IAM roles, and Image Builder resources. Distributes the AMI to an AWS Organization."

Parameters:
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: "Size of the EBS root volume in GB for the bastion AMI."
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1.0.0"
    Description: "Version string for the built image."
  OrganizationArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "The ARN of the AWS Organization (e.g., arn:aws:organizations::123456789012:organization/o-abcdefghij) to share the AMI with all accounts in the organization. Leave empty if no sharing is required."
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC."
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the public subnet."
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the private subnet."
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of the parent Amazon Linux 2023 Image Builder image. Must exist in the target region. Example: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/2023.10.4. Find valid ARNs in the Image Builder console or via AWS CLI."

Conditions:
  ShareWithOrganization: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationArn, ""]]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet"

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet"

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NAT"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRT"

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for Image Builder build instance"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-BuildSG"

  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceConnect
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-BuildInstanceRole"

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribePlacementGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:GetLaunchTemplateData
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:StartImagePipelineExecution
                  - imagebuilder:GetImagePipeline
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageRecipes
                  - imagebuilder:ListInfrastructureConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:ListDistributionConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:ListImagePipelines
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::ec2imagebuilder-*/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ImageBuilderServiceRole"

  BastionBuildComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-component"
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: "Installs SSM Agent, MongoDB 8.0 tools, Python/Synapse client, and .NET SDK on Amazon Linux 2023"
      ChangeDescription: "Initial version"
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - "Amazon Linux 2023"
      Data: |
        name: BastionBuildComponent
        description: Build component for bastion host AMI
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y amazon-ssm-agent || true
                    - sudo systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent || true
              - name: AddMongoDBRepo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo << 'MONGOREPO'
                      [mongodb-org-8.0]
                      name=MongoDB Repository
                      baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/
                      gpgcheck=1
                      enabled=1
                      gpgkey=https://www.mongodb.org/static/pgp/server-8.0.asc
                      MONGOREPO
              - name: InstallMongoDBTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y mongodb-database-tools mongosh
              - name: InstallPythonAndSynapse
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo yum install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - sudo pip3 install synapseclient
              - name: InstallDotNetSDK
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - sudo rpm -Uvh https://packages.microsoft.com/config/rhel/9/packages-microsoft-prod.rpm || true
                    - sudo yum install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0

  BastionImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-recipe"
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref BastionBuildComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: "/dev/xvda"
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Recipe"

  BastionInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-infra-config"
      Description: "Infrastructure configuration for bastion AMI build"
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-InfraConfig"

  BastionDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config"
      Description: "Distribution configuration sharing AMI with the organization"
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub "bastion-ami-${ImageVersion}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: "Bastion AMI built with MongoDB, Python/Synapse, .NET SDK, and SSM Agent"
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub "Bastion-${ImageVersion}"
              Environment: "Bastion"
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              Fn::If:
                - ShareWithOrganization
                - OrganizationArns:
                    - !Ref OrganizationArn
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DistConfig"

  BastionImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bastion-pipeline"
      Description: "Pipeline to build bastion AMI"
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref BastionImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref BastionInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref BastionDistributionConfiguration
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 0 ? * SUN *)"
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Pipeline"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "ID of the created VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: "ID of the public subnet"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: "ID of the private subnet"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  ImageBuilderPipelineArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Image Builder pipeline"
    Value: !Ref BastionImagePipeline
  ImageBuilderComponentArn:
    Description: "ARN of the build component"
    Value: !Ref BastionBuildComponent
  ImageBuilderRecipeArn:
    Description: "ARN of the image recipe"
    Value: !Ref BastionImageRecipe
  ImageBuilderInfraConfigArn:
    Description: "ARN of the infrastructure configuration"
    Value: !Ref BastionInfrastructureConfiguration
  ImageBuilderDistConfigArn:
    Description: "ARN of the distribution configuration"
    Value: !Ref BastionDistributionConfiguration
  ImageBuilderServiceRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Image Builder service role"
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn

Description: 'Plot Palette DynamoDB Tables - Core Data Infrastructure'

    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production

        - IndexName: user-id-index

      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS

        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema

        }
        type Query {

          subscription: Subscription
        }

    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource

Description: "Creates six AWS Budgets for service-specific cost tracking with optional account scoping and email alerts"
Parameters:

    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{12})?$
    Description: "Optional AWS account ID (12 digits) for the first linked account scoped to CloudWatch budget. Leave empty for no account filter."
  CloudWatchLinkedAccount2:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{12})?$

  S3SecurityLoggingLinkedAccount:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{12})?$
    Description: "Optional AWS account ID (12 digits) for the linked account scoped to S3 security logging budget. Leave empty for no account filter."

  HasCloudWatchAccount2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CloudWatchLinkedAccount2, ""]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for SLO monitoring dashboard and CloudWatch alarms for FSx for ONTAP event-driven pipeline."

Parameters:
  EnableSloMonitoring:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: "Enable deployment of SLO alarms and dashboard."
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "fsxn-s3ap"
    Description: "Prefix used for resource naming."
  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns"
    Description: "Namespace for SLO metrics."
  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: "FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary"
    Description: "Namespace for synthetic canary metrics."
  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: "P99 threshold for event ingestion latency in seconds."
  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    Description: "Average threshold for processing success rate in percent."
  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Maximum threshold for FPolicy reconnect time in seconds."
  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: "Maximum threshold for replay completion time in seconds."
  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional SNS topic ARN to forward alarm notifications."
  AWSRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: "us-east-1"
    Description: "AWS region for the dashboard and alarms."

Conditions:
  EnableCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableSloMonitoring, "true"]
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, ""]]

Resources:
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableCondition
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency-SLO"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when P99 event ingestion latency exceeds threshold over three consecutive 5-minute periods."
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Seconds
      OKActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      AlarmActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      InsufficientDataActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableCondition
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate-SLO"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average processing success rate drops below threshold over three consecutive 5-minute periods."
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Percent
      OKActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      AlarmActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      InsufficientDataActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableCondition
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-FPolicyReconnectTime-SLO"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when maximum FPolicy reconnect time exceeds threshold over three consecutive 5-minute periods."
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Seconds
      OKActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      AlarmActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      InsufficientDataActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableCondition
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-ReplayCompletionTime-SLO"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when maximum replay completion time exceeds threshold over three consecutive 5-minute periods."
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

      Unit: Seconds
      OKActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      AlarmActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      InsufficientDataActions: !If [HasSnsTopic, [!Ref SnsTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

  SloDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Self-service Cognito User Pool for JWT testing with AgentCore Gateway and MCP server - Fixed dependencies"
Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/callback"
    Description: "Comma-delimited list of callback URLs for the public web client"
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/logout"
    Description: "Comma-delimited list of logout URLs for the public web client"
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "test-jwt-auth"
    Description: "Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. Must be globally unique."
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: "TestJWTUserPool"
    Description: "Name of the Cognito user pool"
  EmailVerificationSubject:
    Type: String
    Default: "Your verification code"
    Description: "Subject line for the email verification message"
  EmailVerificationMessage:
    Type: String
    Default: "Your verification code is {####}"
    Description: "Body of the email verification message (use {####} for the code)"
Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: true
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: !Ref EmailVerificationSubject
        EmailMessage: !Ref EmailVerificationMessage
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: "api"
      Name: "API Resource Server"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "mcp"
          ScopeDescription: "Access to MCP server operations"
        - ScopeName: "gateway"
          ScopeDescription: "Access to Gateway operations"
  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: "PublicWebClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
    DependsOn:
      - ResourceServer
  GatewayClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: "GatewayM2MClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/gateway
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
    DependsOn:
      - ResourceServer
  MCPClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: "MCPM2MClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/mcp
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
    DependsOn:
      - ResourceServer
Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "ID of the Cognito user pool"
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Cognito user pool"
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolDomainURL:
    Description: "Hosted UI domain URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  WebClientId:
    Description: "Client ID for the public web client"
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  GatewayClientId:
    Description: "Client ID for the gateway machine-to-machine client"
    Value: !Ref GatewayClient
  GatewayClientSecret:
    Description: "Client secret for the gateway machine-to-machine client"
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayClient.ClientSecret
  MCPClientId:
    Description: "Client ID for the MCP machine-to-machine client"
    Value: !Ref MCPClient
  MCPClientSecret:
    Description: "Client secret for the MCP machine-to-machine client"
    Value: !GetAtt MCPClient.ClientSecret
  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: "Identifier of the resource server"
    Value: "api"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandUserPool
    Description: Name for the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyWebClient
    Description: Name for the app client (machine-to-machine)
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://example.com/callback'
    Description: List of allowed callback URLs for the app client
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'https://example.com/logout'
    Description: List of allowed logout URLs for the app client
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mypool
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]+$'
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito domain (must be lowercase alphanumeric)
  SampleBackendEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: 'https://httpbin.org/post'
    Description: Public backend endpoint for the API Gateway proxy

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for custom encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridge
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-custom-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - AttributeDataType: String
          Name: email
          Required: true

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Join
        - ''
        - - !Ref DomainPrefix
          - '-'
          - !Select
            - 2
            - !Split
              - '/'
              - !Ref 'AWS::StackId'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: petstore-api.example.com
      Name: PetStore API Resource Server
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: domestic.read
          ScopeDescription: Read domestic data
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      GenerateSecret: true
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  ApiGatewayLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLoggingRole.Arn

  ApiGatewayAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/${AWS::StackName}-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoUserPoolAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  ApiGatewayMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiGatewayAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Ref SampleBackendEndpoint
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        TimeoutInMillis: 29000
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: /
          HttpMethod: POST
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          MetricsEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '$context.requestId $context.identity.sourceIp $context.path $context.httpMethod'

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ApiEndpointUrl:
    Description: URL of the deployed API Gateway endpoint (prod stage)
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod'
  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the machine-to-machine app client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  UserPoolDomainOAuthTokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint for the user pool domain
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for AWS Backup infrastructure with encrypted vaults, tag-based backup selections, and Service Catalog TagOptions"
Parameters:
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: "backup-key"
    Description: "Alias for the KMS key used to encrypt backup vaults"
  DailyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    Description: "Retention period in days for daily backups"
  WeeklyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 56
    Description: "Retention period in days for weekly backups"
  MonthlyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: "Retention period in days for monthly backups"
  DailyScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 5 * * ? *)"
    Description: "Schedule expression for daily backups (default: 5 AM UTC every day)"
  WeeklyScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)"
    Description: "Schedule expression for weekly backups (default: 5 AM UTC every Sunday)"
  MonthlyScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "cron(0 5 1 * ? *)"
    Description: "Schedule expression for monthly backups (default: 5 AM UTC on the 1st of every month)"
  BackupTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "backup"
    Description: "Tag key used for backup selections"
  DailyTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "daily"
    Description: "Tag value for daily backup selection"
  WeeklyTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "weekly"
    Description: "Tag value for weekly backup selection"
  MonthlyTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "monthly"
    Description: "Tag value for monthly backup selection"
Resources:
  BackupKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting AWS Backup vaults"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow AWS Backup Service to Use Key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "backup.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:CreateGrant"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow Backup Service Role to Use Key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Ref KMSKeyAlias
  BackupKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${KMSKeyAlias}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BackupKMSKey
  BackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "backup.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "AWSBackupServiceRole"
  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-daily-backup-vault"
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-weekly-backup-vault"
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-monthly-backup-vault"
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  DailyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-daily-backup-plan"
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: "daily-rule"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: !Ref DailyScheduleExpression
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 120
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref DailyRetentionDays
      BackupPlanTags:
        backup: "daily"
  WeeklyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-weekly-backup-plan"
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: "weekly-rule"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: !Ref WeeklyScheduleExpression
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 120
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref WeeklyRetentionDays
      BackupPlanTags:
        backup: "weekly"
  MonthlyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-monthly-backup-plan"
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: "monthly-rule"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: !Ref MonthlyScheduleExpression
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 120
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref MonthlyRetentionDays
      BackupPlanTags:
        backup: "monthly"
  DailyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: "daily-backup-selection"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: "stringequals"
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: !Ref DailyTagValue
        Resources:
          - "*"
  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: "weekly-backup-selection"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: "stringequals"
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: !Ref WeeklyTagValue
        Resources:
          - "*"
  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: "monthly-backup-selection"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: "stringequals"
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: !Ref MonthlyTagValue
        Resources:
          - "*"
  DailyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: !Ref DailyTagValue
      Active: true
  WeeklyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: !Ref WeeklyTagValue
      Active: true
  MonthlyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: !Ref MonthlyTagValue
      Active: true
Outputs:
  BackupKMSKeyArn:
    Description: "ARN of the KMS key used for encrypting backup vaults"
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKMSKey.Arn
  BackupServiceRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role used by AWS Backup"
    Value: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
  DailyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: "ARN of the daily backup vault"
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  WeeklyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: "ARN of the weekly backup vault"
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  MonthlyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: "ARN of the monthly backup vault"
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
  DailyBackupPlanId:
    Description: "ID of the daily backup plan"
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
  WeeklyBackupPlanId:
    Description: "ID of the weekly backup plan"
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
  MonthlyBackupPlanId:
    Description: "ID of the monthly backup plan"
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
  DailyTagOptionId:
    Description: "Service Catalog TagOption ID for backup=daily"
    Value: !Ref DailyTagOption
  WeeklyTagOptionId:
    Description: "Service Catalog TagOption ID for backup=weekly"
    Value: !Ref WeeklyTagOption
  MonthlyTagOptionId:
    Description: "Service Catalog TagOption ID for backup=monthly"
    Value: !Ref MonthlyTagOption

      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:

        - !Ref SquarespaceIP2

        - !Ref SquarespaceIP4

  WwwCNAMERecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet

      Type: CNAME
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:

        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationValue}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZenDeskVerificationToken}"'

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

        - !Join [" ", ["5", !Ref GSuiteMXServer2]]
        - !Join [" ", ["10", !Ref GSuiteMXServer3]]
        - !Join [" ", ["15", !Ref GSuiteMXServer4]]
        - !Join [" ", ["20", !Ref GSuiteMXServer5]]

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

      Type: TXT
      TTL: 300

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment identifier used to construct resource names.

Resources:
  BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "BasicLambdaExecution-${Environment}"
      Description: Provides basic Lambda execution permissions to write logs to CloudWatch.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*

  LambdaSQSDynamoDBPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "LambdaSQSDynamoDB-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows Lambda to receive messages from SQS and write items to DynamoDB.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}"

  LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNS-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows Lambda to read from DynamoDB Streams and publish to SNS.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}"

  APIGatewaySQSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "APIGatewaySQS-${Environment}"
      Description: Allows API Gateway to send messages to the SQS queue.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}"

  LambdaRoleSQSDynamoDB:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "LambdaRoleSQSDynamoDB-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref LambdaSQSDynamoDBPolicy
      Path: /

  LambdaRoleDynamoDBStreamSNS:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "LambdaRoleDynamoDBStreamSNS-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BasicLambdaExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref LambdaDynamoDBStreamSNSPolicy
      Path: /

  APIGatewayRoleSQS:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "APIGatewayRoleSQS-${Environment}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref APIGatewaySQSPolicy
      Path: /

Outputs:
  LambdaRoleSQSDynamoDBArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for Lambda that reads from SQS and writes to DynamoDB.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaRoleSQSDynamoDB.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LambdaRoleSQSDynamoDBArn"

  LambdaRoleDynamoDBStreamSNSArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for Lambda that reads from DynamoDB Streams and publishes to SNS.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaRoleDynamoDBStreamSNS.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LambdaRoleDynamoDBStreamSNSArn"

    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewayRoleSQS.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-APIGatewayRoleSQSArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create a VPC with public and private subnets, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, and route tables for outbound internet access from private resources."
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
    Type: String
    Default: "172.18.0.0/16"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR block"
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Description: "CIDR block for the public subnet"
    Type: String
    Default: "172.18.0.0/22"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR block"
  PrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Description: "CIDR block for the private subnet"
    Type: String
    Default: "172.18.32.0/21"
    AllowedPattern: "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid CIDR block"
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: "Environment name for resource tagging"
    Type: String
    Default: "Test"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet"
  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCIDR
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet"
  ElasticIP:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP"
  NATGateway:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::NatGateway"
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-Gateway"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicRT"
  PublicRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRT"
  PrivateRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
Outputs:
  VPCID:
    Description: "ID of the VPC"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPCID"
  PublicSubnetID:
    Description: "ID of the public subnet"
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnetID"
  PrivateSubnetID:
    Description: "ID of the private subnet"
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnetID"
  NATGatewayID:
    Description: "ID of the NAT Gateway"
    Value: !Ref NATGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGatewayID"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template for Amazon Athena named queries analyzing AppStream 2.0 usage data, with Glue database and table'
Parameters:
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket containing AppStream 2.0 usage data (e.g., appstream-usage-data)
    Default: your-s3-bucket-name
  S3Prefix:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 prefix (folder path) for the AppStream usage data files
    Default: appstream-usage/
  AthenaWorkGroup:
    Type: String
    Description: Athena workgroup for the named queries
    Default: primary
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Glue database to create
    Default: appstream_usage
  GlueTableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Glue table to create
    Default: appstream_sessions
Resources:
  AppStreamUsageDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
        Description: Database for AppStream 2.0 usage analytics
  AppStreamUsageTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn:
      - AppStreamUsageDatabase
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
      TableInput:
        Name: !Ref GlueTableName
        Description: Table for AppStream 2.0 session usage data stored as CSV in S3
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          skip.header.line.count: '1'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub s3://${S3BucketName}/${S3Prefix}
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','
              quoteChar: '"'
              escapeChar: '\\'
          Columns:
            - Name: session_id
              Type: string
            - Name: user_id
              Type: string
            - Name: stack_name
              Type: string
            - Name: fleet_name
              Type: string
            - Name: application
              Type: string
            - Name: session_start_time
              Type: string
            - Name: session_end_time
              Type: string
            - Name: session_duration_minutes
              Type: double
            - Name: session_state
              Type: string
            - Name: ip_address
              Type: string
            - Name: operating_system
              Type: string
            - Name: client_version
              Type: string
  AverageSessionLengthPerStackComparison:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    DependsOn:
      - AppStreamUsageTable
    Properties:
      Name: average_session_length_per_stack_comparison
      Description: Compares average session length per AppStream stack between current and previous month
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub >
        WITH current_month AS (
          SELECT stack_name,
                 AVG(session_duration_minutes) AS avg_session_length_current,
                 COUNT(session_id) AS session_count_current
          FROM "${GlueDatabaseName}"."${GlueTableName}"
          WHERE year(date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = year(current_date)
            AND month(date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = month(current_date)
          GROUP BY stack_name
        ),
        previous_month AS (
          SELECT stack_name,
                 AVG(session_duration_minutes) AS avg_session_length_previous,
                 COUNT(session_id) AS session_count_previous
          FROM "${GlueDatabaseName}"."${GlueTableName}"
          WHERE year(date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = year(date_add('month', -1, current_date))
            AND month(date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = month(date_add('month', -1, current_date))
          GROUP BY stack_name
        )
        SELECT coalesce(c.stack_name, p.stack_name) AS stack_name,
               c.avg_session_length_current,
               p.avg_session_length_previous,
               c.session_count_current,
               p.session_count_previous,
               (c.avg_session_length_current - p.avg_session_length_previous) AS length_difference_minutes
        FROM current_month c
        FULL OUTER JOIN previous_month p ON c.stack_name = p.stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
  DailySessionCounts:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    DependsOn:
      - AppStreamUsageTable
    Properties:
      Name: daily_session_counts
      Description: Counts total sessions and unique users per day
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT date(date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS session_date,
               count(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_sessions,
               count(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM "${GlueDatabaseName}"."${GlueTableName}"
        GROUP BY date(date_parse(session_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d'))
        ORDER BY session_date DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
  AllSessionDetails:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    DependsOn:
      - AppStreamUsageTable
    Properties:
      Name: all_session_details
      Description: Retrieves all session details ordered by start time descending
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT session_id,
               user_id,
               stack_name,
               fleet_name,
               application,
               session_start_time,
               session_end_time,
               session_duration_minutes,
               session_state,
               ip_address,
               operating_system,
               client_version
        FROM "${GlueDatabaseName}"."${GlueTableName}"
        ORDER BY session_start_time DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
  StreamingHoursPerUser:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    DependsOn:
      - AppStreamUsageTable
    Properties:
      Name: streaming_hours_per_user
      Description: Calculates total streaming hours, session count, and average session length per user
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT user_id,
               round(sum(session_duration_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS total_streaming_hours,
               count(session_id) AS total_sessions,
               round(avg(session_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM "${GlueDatabaseName}"."${GlueTableName}"
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY total_streaming_hours DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
  UniqueUsersPerApplication:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    DependsOn:
      - AppStreamUsageTable
    Properties:
      Name: unique_users_per_application
      Description: Lists unique users, total sessions, and average session length per application
      Database: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub >
        SELECT application,
               count(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users,
               count(session_id) AS total_sessions,
               round(avg(session_duration_minutes), 2) AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM "${GlueDatabaseName}"."${GlueTableName}"
        WHERE application IS NOT NULL AND application != ''
        GROUP BY application
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC
      WorkGroup: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
Outputs:
  DatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database created for AppStream usage data
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the Glue table created for AppStream session data
    Value: !Ref GlueTableName
  AthenaWorkGroupName:
    Description: Athena workgroup used for the named queries
    Value: !Ref AthenaWorkGroup
  NamedQueryIds:
    Description: List of Athena named query IDs created for AppStream usage analysis
    Value: !Join
      - ', '
      - - !Ref AverageSessionLengthPerStackComparison
        - !Ref DailySessionCounts
        - !Ref AllSessionDetails
        - !Ref StreamingHoursPerUser
        - !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplication
  S3DataLocation:
    Description: S3 location expected for AppStream usage data files
    Value: !Sub s3://${S3BucketName}/${S3Prefix}

Description: "Three-tier VPC with public, private application, and private database subnets across three Availability Zones, including an Internet Gateway and a single NAT Gateway."

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn:
      - VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGW"

  # Public Subnets (AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  # Private Application Subnets (AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
  PrivateAppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateAppSubnet1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateAppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateAppSubnet2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateAppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.5.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateAppSubnet3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  # Private Database Subnets (AZ1, AZ2, AZ3)
  PrivateDbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.6.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateDbSubnet1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDb

  PrivateDbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.7.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateDbSubnet2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDb

  PrivateDbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.8.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateDbSubnet3"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDb

  # Route Tables
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicRT"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: Public

  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateAppRT"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateApp

  PrivateDbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateDbRT"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: PrivateDb

  # Routes
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateAppRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateDbRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "Public Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
  PrivateAppSubnetIds:
    Description: "Private Application Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateAppSubnet1, !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2, !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3]]
  PrivateDbSubnetIds:
    Description: "Private Database Subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateDbSubnet1, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet2, !Ref PrivateDbSubnet3]]
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: "NAT Gateway ID"
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for Puppet Quick Start VPC infrastructure with Route53 private hosted zone.

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /16 to /28 CIDR (between /16 and /28 for VPC)

  SubnetCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid /19 to /28 CIDR

  PuppetIP:
    Description: IP address for puppet.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address

  LinuxAgentIP:
    Description: IP address for linuxagent.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address

  WindowsAgentIP:
    Description: IP address for windowsagent.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '1'
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetPublicSubnet

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetPublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private hosted zone for example.com associated with VPC

  PuppetRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetIP

  LinuxAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIP

  WindowsAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PrivateHostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIP

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VpcId

  SubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-SubnetId

    Default: "10.0.102.0/24"

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
  TaskRoleArn:

Resources:

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:

    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
  NatGatewayEIP:

    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat"
  PublicRouteTable:

      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt"
  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"
  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}.local"
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Description: Private namespace for ECS services
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg"
  SelfReferenceIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: -1
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroup
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-exec-role"
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 7
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      Cpu: !Ref CPU
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - HasCustomTaskRole
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - SelfReferenceIngress
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref SecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          Port: !Ref ContainerPort
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: EcsService
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub "service/${ECSCluster}/${ServiceName}"
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in"
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1
  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-CPU-high"
      AlarmDescription: "Scale out when CPU >= 70%"
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy
  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-CPU-low"
      AlarmDescription: "Scale in when CPU <= 20%"
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  CloudMapNamespaceId:
    Description: Cloud Map namespace ID
    Value: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
  ServiceName:
    Description: ECS service name
    Value: !Ref ServiceName
