AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  SubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.94.10.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet
  InternalCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    Description: Allowed HTTPS inbound source CIDR
  OCIBackboneCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR for outbound HTTPS
  CreateVPN:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "Yes"
      - "No"
    Default: "No"
    Description: Whether to create VPN resources for OCI interconnect
  CustomerGatewayIP:
    Type: String
    Default: "203.0.113.1"
    Description: Public IP of the customer gateway (required if CreateVPN=Yes)
  OCIStaticRoutes:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    Description: Static routes to advertise over VPN (required if CreateVPN=Yes)
  TransitGatewayRouteCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    Description: CIDR to route via the Transit Gateway VPN attachment
  VPCLogGroupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention days for VPC flow logs CloudWatch log group
Conditions:
  CreateVPNCondition:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref CreateVPN
      - "Yes"
Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow logs encryption
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-VPC
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-IGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-Private-Subnet
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-Private-RT
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for OCI hybrid interconnect
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-SG
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: Transit gateway for OCI hybrid interconnect
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-TGW
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-TGW-RT
  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-Hybrid-TGW-VPC-Attach
  TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
  VPCFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
  VPCFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flow-logs/${VPC}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref VPCLogGroupRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VPCFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogRole.Arn
  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: 65000
      IpAddress: !Ref CustomerGatewayIP
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-CGW
  VPNConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: OCI-VPN
  VPNStaticRoutes:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    DependsOn: VPNConnection
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref OCIStaticRoutes]
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection
  TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    DependsOn: VPNConnection
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VPNConnection
  TransitGatewayRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    DependsOn: VPNConnection
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteCIDR
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref VPNConnection
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: Private Subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: Transit Gateway Route Table ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Log Group for Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref VPCFlowLogGroup
  KMSKeyId:
    Description: KMS Key ID
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
  VPNConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVPNCondition
    Description: VPN Connection ID (if created)
    Value: !Ref VPNConnection

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline"
Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: "S3 bucket where Glue job scripts are stored (must already exist)"
    Default: "quicksight-admin-console-scripts"
  ScriptKeyPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "S3 key prefix for scripts (must end with '/')"
    Default: "scripts/"
  DataPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "S3 key prefix for output data (must end with '/')"
    Default: "data/"
  CloudTrailLogsPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "S3 key prefix for CloudTrail logs (must end with '/')"
    Default: "cloudtrail-logs/"

Resources:
  QuickSightAdminConsoleBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: "QuickSight Admin Console Bucket"

  QuickSightAdminConsoleBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref QuickSightAdminConsoleBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: quicksight.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::quicksight-admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}/*"

  QuickSightAdminConsoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "QuickSightAdminConsoleRole-${AWS::AccountId}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - quicksight.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightFullAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:*
                Resource: "*"
        - PolicyName: AssumeRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/Glue*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation*"

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:

        Description: "Database for QuickSight admin console data"

  CloudTrailLogsTable:

      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase

        TableType: "EXTERNAL_TABLE"
        Parameters:
          classification: "cloudtrail"

          OutputFormat: "org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat"
          SerdeInfo:

          Columns:
            - Name: "eventversion"

            - Name: "useridentity"

            - Name: "eventtime"

            - Name: "eventsource"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "eventname"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "awsregion"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "sourceipaddress"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "useragent"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "errorcode"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "errormessage"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "requestparameters"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "responseelements"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "additionaleventdata"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "requestid"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "eventid"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "resources"
              Type: "array<struct<arn:string,accountid:string,type:string>>"
            - Name: "eventtype"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "apiversion"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "readonly"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "recipientaccountid"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "serviceeventdetails"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "sharedeventid"
              Type: "string"
            - Name: "vpcendpointid"

  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-group-membership-job-${AWS::AccountId}"
      Description: "Processes group membership data"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminConsoleRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: "pythonshell"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}group_membership.py"
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
      Tags:
        Name: "quicksight-group-membership-job"

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-object-access-job-${AWS::AccountId}"
      Description: "Processes object access data"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminConsoleRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: "pythonshell"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}object_access.py"
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
      Tags:
        Name: "quicksight-object-access-job"

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-folder-assets-job-${AWS::AccountId}"
      Description: "Processes folder assets data"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminConsoleRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: "pythonshell"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}folder_assets.py"
        PythonVersion: "3.9"
      GlueVersion: "3.0"
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 60
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-language": "python"
      Tags:
        Name: "quicksight-folder-assets-job"

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "quicksight-folder-lookup-job-${AWS::AccountId}"
      Description: "Performs folder lookup operations"
      Role: !GetAtt QuickSightAdminConsoleRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: "glueetl"
        ScriptLocation: !Sub "s3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}folder_lookup.py"
        PythonVersion: "3"
      GlueVersion: "5.0"
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      WorkerType: "G.1X"
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      DefaultArguments:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: imagebuilder-chef-bucket
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket containing the Chef recipe (must be globally unique)
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$
  RecipeKey:
    Type: String
    Default: recipes/chef-recipe.tar.gz
    Description: S3 key of the Chef recipe archive
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Region where the AMI will be distributed
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyImagePipeline
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyCustomComponent
  ImageRecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyImageRecipe
  InfrastructureConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyInfrastructureConfig
  DistributionConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyDistributionConfig
  LifecyclePolicyName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyLifecyclePolicy
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
      - m5.large
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 25
    MinValue: 10
    MaxValue: 100
  RootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp2
      - gp3
      - io1
      - io2
      - st1
      - sc1
  RetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
Resources:
  S3Bucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref BucketName
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  ImageBuilderExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderServiceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${BucketName}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ImageBuilderRole"
  InstanceProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2ImageBuilderInstanceProfilePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${BucketName}/*"
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-InstanceProfileRole"
  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceProfileRole
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-build-instance-profile"
  CustomComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Custom component to update SSM agent, download and execute Chef recipe, and collect metadata
      Data:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            name: CustomChefComponent
            description: Custom component for Chef recipe execution
            schemaVersion: 1.0
            phases:
              - name: build
                steps:
                  - action: ExecuteBash
                    name: UpdateSSMAgent
                    inputs:
                      commands:
                        - sudo yum install -y amazon-ssm-agent
                        - sudo systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
                  - action: ExecuteBash
                    name: InstallChef
                    inputs:
                      commands:
                        - curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | sudo bash
                  - action: ExecuteBash
                    name: DownloadChefRecipe
                    inputs:
                      commands:
                        - aws s3 cp s3://${BucketName}/${RecipeKey} /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz
                  - action: ExecuteBash
                    name: ExtractAndRunChef
                    inputs:
                      commands:
                        - mkdir -p /tmp/chef-recipe
                        - tar -xzf /tmp/chef-recipe.tar.gz -C /tmp/chef-recipe
                        - sudo chef-client --local-mode --runlist 'recipe[my_cookbook]'
                  - action: ExecuteBash
                    name: CollectMetadata
                    inputs:
                      commands:
                        - uname -a > /tmp/metadata.txt
                        - aws s3 cp /tmp/metadata.txt s3://${BucketName}/metadata/$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S).txt
          - BucketName: !Ref BucketName
            RecipeKey: !Ref RecipeKey
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ImageRecipeName
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref CustomComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
      Tags:
        CreatedBy: ImageBuilder
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref InfrastructureConfigName
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for Image Builder pipeline
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref BucketName
          S3KeyPrefix: logs/
      ResourceTags:
        CreatedBy: ImageBuilder
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DistributionConfigName
      Description: Distribution configuration for AMI sharing
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: "CustomChefAMI-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}"
            Description: AMI built with Chef recipe
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      Description: Daily pipeline to build custom AMI with Chef recipe
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 0 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref LifecyclePolicyName
      Description: Lifecycle policy to deprecate AMIs after 30 days
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
          Filter:
            age: !Ref RetentionDays
            tagValues:
              - key: CreatedBy
                value: ImageBuilder
      ResourceSelection:
        tagValues:
          - key: CreatedBy
            value: ImageBuilder
Outputs:
  S3BucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket containing Chef recipe
    Value: !Ref BucketName
  CustomComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of custom component
    Value: !Ref CustomComponent
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  InstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt InstanceProfile.Arn

Conditions:
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table

          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: GSI_Test

          Projection:

  AlarmTopic:

        - Name: TableName

      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  SystemErrorsAlarm:

        - Name: TableName

      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'PII Classification Scanner for S3 Access Point using Comprehend, DynamoDB, and optional SNS'

Mappings:
  Dummy:
    Vpc:
      VpcId: 'vpc-00000000'
      SecurityGroupId: 'sg-00000000'

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing S3 Access Point to scan
  AccessPointNetworkOrigin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - Internet
      - VPC
    Default: Internet
    Description: Network origin of the Access Point (Internet or VPC). If VPC, provide VPC parameters.
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: VPC ID (required if AccessPointNetworkOrigin is VPC)
  SubnetIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated list of Subnet IDs for Lambda deployment (required if AccessPointNetworkOrigin is VPC)
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Security Group ID for Lambda (required if AccessPointNetworkOrigin is VPC)
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-separated list of Route Table IDs for VPC endpoints (required if CreateEndpoints is true)
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create VPC endpoints for S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, SNS (only if VPC origin and not already present)
  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: ARN of an existing SNS topic for notifications (optional)
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Lambda function memory in MB
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Lambda function timeout in seconds
  LanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    AllowedValues:
      - en
      - es
      - fr
      - de
      - it
      - pt
      - ja
      - ko
      - zh
      - ar
    Description: Language code for Comprehend DetectPiiEntities
  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000
    Description: Maximum number of files to scan per invocation
  LambdaCodeS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: my-lambda-code-bucket
    Description: S3 bucket containing the Lambda function code zip
  LambdaCodeS3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: scanner-lambda.zip
    Description: S3 key for the Lambda function code zip

Conditions:
  IsVpcOrigin: !Equals [!Ref AccessPointNetworkOrigin, 'VPC']
  HasVpcParameters: !And
    - !Condition IsVpcOrigin
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SubnetIds, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, '']]
  CreateEndpointsFlag: !And
    - !Condition IsVpcOrigin
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, 'true']
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RouteTableIds, '']]
  HasSnsTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, '']]

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'PIIReport-${AWS::StackName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ScanTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ScanTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReportTable'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPointAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Ref AccessPointArn
                  - !Sub '${AccessPointArn}/object/*'
        - PolicyName: ComprehendAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: SNSAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Fn::If:
                  - HasSnsTopic
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action: sns:Publish
                    Resource: !Ref SnsTopicArn
                  - Effect: Deny
                    Action: sns:Publish
                    Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: VPCAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PII-Scanner'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref LambdaCodeS3Bucket
        S3Key: !Ref LambdaCodeS3Key
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      VpcConfig:
        Fn::If:
          - HasVpcParameters
          - VpcId: !Ref VpcId
            SubnetIds: !Split [',', !Ref SubnetIds]
            SecurityGroupIds:
              - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ReportTable
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref LanguageCode
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref AccessPointArn
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !If [HasSnsTopic, !Ref SnsTopicArn, '']

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsFlag
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateEndpointsFlag
        - !Ref VpcId
        - !FindInMap [Dummy, Vpc, VpcId]
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split [',', !Ref RouteTableIds]

  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsFlag
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateEndpointsFlag
        - !Ref VpcId
        - !FindInMap [Dummy, Vpc, VpcId]
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Split [',', !Ref RouteTableIds]

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsFlag
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateEndpointsFlag
        - !Ref VpcId
        - !FindInMap [Dummy, Vpc, VpcId]
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Split [',', !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !If
          - CreateEndpointsFlag
          - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          - !FindInMap [Dummy, Vpc, SecurityGroupId]
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SNSInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpointsFlag
    Properties:
      VpcId: !If
        - CreateEndpointsFlag
        - !Ref VpcId
        - !FindInMap [Dummy, Vpc, VpcId]
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds: !Split [',', !Ref SubnetIds]
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !If
          - CreateEndpointsFlag
          - !Ref SecurityGroupId
          - !FindInMap [Dummy, Vpc, SecurityGroupId]
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII Scanner Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB report table
    Value: !Ref ReportTable
  ExampleCliCommand:
    Description: Example AWS CLI command to invoke the scanner
    Value: !Sub |
      aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction} --payload '{"accessPointArn": "${AccessPointArn}", "prefix": ""}' response.json

    Type: AWS::Glue::Table

            - Name: outcode

          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Location: !Sub "${S3BucketPath}/rdf/route_rdf_nopfx/"
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          rdf-type: "true"
          stripUriPrefix: "true"
          querymode: sparql
          sparqlQuery: "SELECT ?src ?dst WHERE { ?route <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontology/objectProperty/hasSource> ?src ; <http://www.semanticweb.org/air-routes/ontology/objectProperty/hasDestination> ?dst . } LIMIT 10"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Cognito authentication setups for PiBot project: main web app and IoT trusted user provisioning"

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiBot
    Description: "Prefix for resource names to avoid conflicts"

Resources:
  MainWebAppUserPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPool"
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}MainWebAppUserPool"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

  MainWebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}MainWebAppClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: "ENABLED"

  MainWebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}MainWebAppIdentityPool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref MainWebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt MainWebAppUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  MainWebAppAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}MainWebAppAuthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": "authenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}MainWebAppAuthenticatedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "iot:Connect"
                  - "iot:Publish"
                  - "iot:Subscribe"
                  - "iot:Receive"
                  - "iot:GetThingShadow"
                  - "iot:UpdateThingShadow"
                  - "iot:DeleteThingShadow"
                  - "iot:ListThings"
                  - "iot:DescribeThing"
                  - "iot:ListThingPrincipals"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "kinesisvideo:PutMedia"
                  - "kinesisvideo:GetMedia"
                  - "kinesisvideo:GetMediaForFragmentList"
                  - "kinesisvideo:ListStreams"
                  - "kinesisvideo:DescribeStream"
                  - "kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "rekognition:DetectLabels"
                  - "rekognition:DetectFaces"
                  - "rekognition:RecognizeCelebrities"
                  - "rekognition:CompareFaces"
                  - "rekognition:IndexFaces"
                  - "rekognition:SearchFacesByImage"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "cognito-identity:GetId"
                  - "cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken"
                  - "cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity"
                  - "cognito-sync:ListDatasets"
                  - "cognito-sync:DescribeDataset"
                  - "cognito-sync:SubscribeToDataset"
                  - "cognito-sync:UnsubscribeFromDataset"
                  - "cognito-sync:UpdateRecords"
                  - "cognito-sync:QueryRecords"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "mobileanalytics:PutEvents"
                  - "mobileanalytics:GetReports"
                  - "mobileanalytics:GetFinancialReports"
                Resource: "*"

  MainWebAppUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}MainWebAppUnauthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": "unauthenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}MainWebAppUnauthenticatedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "iot:Connect"
                  - "iot:Subscribe"
                  - "iot:Receive"
                  - "iot:GetThingShadow"
                  - "iot:ListThings"
                  - "iot:DescribeThing"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "kinesisvideo:GetMedia"
                  - "kinesisvideo:GetMediaForFragmentList"
                  - "kinesisvideo:ListStreams"
                  - "kinesisvideo:DescribeStream"
                  - "kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "rekognition:DetectLabels"
                  - "rekognition:DetectFaces"
                  - "rekognition:RecognizeCelebrities"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "cognito-identity:GetId"
                  - "cognito-identity:GetOpenIdToken"
                  - "cognito-sync:SubscribeToDataset"
                  - "cognito-sync:ListDatasets"
                  - "cognito-sync:DescribeDataset"
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "mobileanalytics:PutEvents"
                Resource: "*"

  MainWebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainWebAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAppAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainWebAppUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPool"
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}ProvisioningUserPool"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}ProvisioningClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: "ENABLED"

  ProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool"
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}ProvisioningIdentityPool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt ProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: false

  ProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}ProvisioningAuthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Federated: "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref ProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": "authenticated"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}ProvisioningAuthenticatedPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate"
                  - "iot:RegisterThing"
                  - "iot:DescribeCertificate"
                  - "iot:AttachPolicy"
                  - "iot:AttachThingPrincipal"
                  - "iot:DetachPolicy"
                  - "iot:DetachThingPrincipal"
                  - "iot:ListThings"
                  - "iot:DescribeThing"
                  - "iot:ListPolicies"
                  - "iot:ListPolicyPrincipals"
                  - "iot:ListThingPrincipals"
                  - "iot:CreatePolicy"
                  - "iot:CreateThing"
                  - "iot:DeleteThing"
                  - "iot:UpdateThing"
                Resource: "*"

  ProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}ProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"

        - PolicyName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}ProvisioningUnauthenticatedPolicy"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Route 53 hosted zone and DNS records for radiotopia.fm

Parameters:
  ApexIPAddresses:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Static IP addresses for apex A records (e.g., '1.2.3.4,5.6.7.8')
    Default: '1.2.3.4,5.6.7.8'
  WebsiteHostingDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: CNAME target for www subdomain (e.g., 'hosting.example.com')
    Default: 'hosting.example.com'
  MediaCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain for media.radiotopia.fm
    Default: 'd123.cloudfront.net'
  TowerCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain for tower.radiotopia.fm
    Default: 'd456.cloudfront.net'
  V1CloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain for v1.radiotopia.fm
    Default: 'd789.cloudfront.net'
  PlusCloudFrontDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain for plus.radiotopia.fm
    Default: 'd012.cloudfront.net'
  FeedProxyDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: CNAME target for podcast feed subdomain
    Default: 'feedproxy.example.com'
  SpecialEventIP:
    Type: String
    Description: IPv4 address for specialevent.radiotopia.fm A record
    Default: '203.0.113.1'
  MXValue:
    Type: String
    Description: MX record value (e.g., '10 mail.example.com')
    Default: '10 mail.example.com'
  SPFPolicy:
    Type: String
    Description: SPF policy string (e.g., 'v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com ~all')
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:_spf.example.com ~all'
  DMARCPolicy:
    Type: String
    Description: DMARC policy string (e.g., 'v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com')
    Default: 'v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com'
  DomainToken1:
    Type: String
    Description: First domain ownership verification token (e.g., 'ms=abcd1234')
    Default: 'ms=abcd1234'
  DomainToken2:
    Type: String
    Description: Second domain ownership verification token (e.g., 'google-site-verification=xyz')
    Default: 'google-site-verification=xyz'
  ZendeskCNAMEValue:
    Type: String
    Description: CNAME target for Zendesk verification
    Default: 'zendesk.com'
  MailChimpTXTValue:
    Type: String
    Description: TXT value for MailChimp verification
    Default: 'mailchimp-verification=abc123'
  SquarespaceTXTValue:
    Type: String
    Description: TXT value for Squarespace verification
    Default: 'squarespace-verification=def456'
  CampaignMonitorTXTValue:
    Type: String
    Description: TXT value for Campaign Monitor verification
    Default: 'cm-verification=ghi789'
  GoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Description: Google Workspace domain verification TXT
    Default: 'google-site-verification=xyz123'
  GoogleWorkspaceDKIMTXT:
    Type: String
    Description: Google Workspace DKIM TXT for google._domainkey
    Default: 'v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQC...'

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::HostedZone'
    Properties:
      Name: radiotopia.fm

  # Combined apex TXT record: SPF, domain tokens, and Google Workspace verification
  ApexTXTRecord:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: 'radiotopia.fm.'
      Type: TXT
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SPFPolicy}"'
        - !Sub '"${DomainToken1}"'
        - !Sub '"${DomainToken2}"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleWorkspaceVerificationTXT}"'
      TTL: 300

  # DMARC TXT record
  DMARCRecord:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: '_dmarc.radiotopia.fm.'
      Type: TXT
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${DMARCPolicy}"'
      TTL: 300

  # MX record
  MXRecord:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: 'radiotopia.fm.'
      Type: MX
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref MXValue
      TTL: 300

  # Apex A records (multiple IPs)
  ApexARecord:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: 'radiotopia.fm.'
      Type: A
      ResourceRecords: !Ref ApexIPAddresses
      TTL: 300

  # www CNAME
  WWWCName:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: 'www.radiotopia.fm.'
      Type: CNAME
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WebsiteHostingDomain
      TTL: 300

  # Media subdomain alias A and AAAA
  MediaAliasA:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: 'media.radiotopia.fm.'
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploys Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP integration supporting protein variant effect prediction. Requires existing Lambda ARN, Cognito discovery URL, and client ID as input parameters. Creates SSM parameters to store these values for dynamic resolution.
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used as prefix for resource names and SSM parameter paths
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP-based protein variant effect prediction
    Description: Description for the AgentCore Gateway
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name for the gateway. Auto-generated from ProjectName if left blank
  LambdaArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing Lambda function for protein variant prediction (e.g., arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:my-function)
  CognitoDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: String
    Description: Cognito issuer URL for JWT validation (e.g., https://cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/us-east-1_AbCdEfGhI)
  CognitoClientId:
    Type: String
    Description: Cognito client ID for JWT validation (e.g., 1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j)
Conditions:
  IsGatewayNameEmpty:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: GatewayName
      - ''
Resources:
  BedrockAgentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName:
            Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-bedrock-agentcore-lambda-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  Ref: LambdaArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value:
            Ref: ProjectName
        - Key: Service
          Value: Bedrock-AgentCore
  BedrockAgentRoleArnParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/bedrock-agentcore-role-arn
      Type: String
      Value:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - BedrockAgentRole
          - Arn
      Description: ARN of the IAM role for Bedrock AgentCore service
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  LambdaArnParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/lambda/arn
      Type: String
      Value:
        Ref: LambdaArn
      Description: ARN of the Lambda function for protein variant prediction
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Value:
        Ref: CognitoDiscoveryUrl
      Description: Cognito issuer URL for JWT validation
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  CognitoClientIdParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/cognito/client-id
      Type: String
      Value:
        Ref: CognitoClientId
      Description: Cognito client ID for JWT validation
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::If:
          - IsGatewayNameEmpty
          - Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway
          - Ref: GatewayName
      Description:
        Ref: GatewayDescription
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins:
          - '*'
        AllowMethods:
          - POST
          - OPTIONS
        AllowHeaders:
          - content-type
          - authorization
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  AgentCoreGatewayStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: AgentCoreGateway
      StageName: $default
      AutoDeploy: true
      Description: Default stage for the AgentCore Gateway
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  AgentCoreGatewayAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: AgentCoreGateway
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource:
        - $request.header.Authorization
      JwtConfiguration:
        Issuer:
          Ref: CognitoDiscoveryUrl
        Audience:
          - Ref: CognitoClientId
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: ${ProjectName}-cognito-jwt-authorizer
  AgentCoreGatewayIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: AgentCoreGateway
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri:
        Fn::Sub: arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaArn}/invocations
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'
      TimeoutInMillis: 30000
      Description: Integration with the protein variant prediction Lambda function
  AgentCoreGatewayRouteInvoke:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: AgentCoreGateway
      RouteKey: POST /invoke_endpoint
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId:
        Ref: AgentCoreGatewayAuthorizer
      Target:
        Fn::Sub: integrations/${AgentCoreGatewayIntegration}
  AgentCoreGatewayRouteResults:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId:
        Ref: AgentCoreGateway
      RouteKey: POST /get_results
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId:
        Ref: AgentCoreGatewayAuthorizer
      Target:
        Fn::Sub: integrations/${AgentCoreGatewayIntegration}
  McpToolSchemaParam:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/mcp/tool-schema
      Type: String
      Value: >-
        {"tools":[{"name":"invoke_endpoint","description":"Submit protein sequences for variant effect prediction","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sequences":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"sequence":{"type":"string"},"variants":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["id","sequence","variants"]}}},"required":["sequences"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"job_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string"},"submitted_count":{"type":"integer"}}}},{"name":"get_results","description":"Retrieve results for a submitted prediction job","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"job_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["job_id"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"job_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string"},"results":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"predicted_effect":{"type":"string"},"score":{"type":"number"}}}}}}}]}
      Description: MCP inline tool schema for invoke_endpoint and get_results operations
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
Outputs:
  GatewayEndpoint:
    Description: The base URL of the AgentCore Gateway for MCP integration
    Value:
      Fn::Sub: https://${AgentCoreGateway}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
  BedrockAgentRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for Bedrock AgentCore service to invoke the Lambda function
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
        - BedrockAgentRole
        - Arn
  McpToolSchemaParameterPath:
    Description: SSM parameter path containing the MCP inline tool schema
    Value:
      Fn::Sub: /${ProjectName}/mcp/tool-schema
  GatewayAuthorizerId:
    Description: ID of the JWT authorizer configured on the gateway
    Value:
      Ref: AgentCoreGatewayAuthorizer

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: An environment name that will be prefixed to resource names
    Type: String
    Default: "PrivateVPC"

  VpcCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"

  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet (used for NAT Gateway)
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet (ALB AZ1)
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet (ALB AZ2)
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"

  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the third private subnet (Lambda)
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"

  EnableNATGateway:
    Description: Enable NAT Gateway for internet egress from private subnets
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

Conditions:
  CreateNATGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNATGateway, "true"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1-ALB-AZ1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2-ALB-AZ2"

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet3-Lambda"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicRouteTable"

  PublicRoute:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable"

  PrivateRoute:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  NATGateway:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt ElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NATGateway"

  ElasticIP:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting artifact storage bucket
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ArtifactBucketKey"

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${EnvironmentName}-artifact-bucket-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-artifactbucket-${AWS::Region}"
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: "aws:kms"
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KMSKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-ArtifactBucket"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"

  PublicSubnetId:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Description: Public subnet ID (for NAT Gateway)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId"

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet ID for ALB AZ1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id"

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet ID for ALB AZ2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id"

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private subnet ID for Lambda
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet3Id"

  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key for artifact bucket encryption
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KMSKeyArn"

  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the artifact storage bucket
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ArtifactBucketName"

  NATGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateNATGateway
    Description: NAT Gateway ID (if created)
    Value: !Ref NATGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-NATGatewayId"

    Default: GetApi

        Statement:

            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:

          "States": {

              "Next": "Step2"
            },
            "Step2": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution

                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

        Statement:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Audit SQS queue with KMS encryption, optional DLQ, alarms, and SNS notifications"

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Default: dev
    Description: "Environment name (dev disables DLQ)"
  MessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 345600
    Description: "Message retention period in seconds (default 4 days)"
  VisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Visibility timeout in seconds for the audit queue"
  DLQMessageRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1209600
    Description: "Message retention period for DLQ in seconds (default 14 days)"
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: "admin@example.com"
    Description: "Email address for alarm notifications"

Conditions:
  CreateDLQ:
    Fn::Or:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref Environment
          - "test"
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref Environment
          - "prod"

Resources:
  AuditQueueKMSKey:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Key"
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for encrypting SQS audit messages in ${Environment}"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  AuditQueueKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Alias"
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/audit-queue-${Environment}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKMSKey

  AuditQueue:
    Type: "AWS::SQS::Queue"
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "audit-queue-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditQueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref MessageRetentionPeriod
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy:
        Fn::If:
          - CreateDLQ
          -
            deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
            maxReceiveCount: 5
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Type: "AWS::SQS::Queue"
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub "audit-queue-dlq-${Environment}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditQueueKMSKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !Ref DLQMessageRetentionPeriod

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: "AWS::SNS::Topic"
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "audit-alarms-${Environment}"
      Subscription:
        - Protocol: email
          Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  OldMessageAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "audit-queue-old-messages-${Environment}"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when oldest message exceeds 1 hour"
      Namespace: "AWS/SQS"
      MetricName: "ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage"
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 3600
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DLQActivityAlarm:
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "audit-queue-dlq-activity-${Environment}"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when messages are sent to DLQ"
      Namespace: "AWS/SQS"
      MetricName: "NumberOfMessagesSent"
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueURL:
    Description: "URL of the audit SQS queue"
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
  AuditQueueARN:
    Description: "ARN of the audit SQS queue"
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
  DeadLetterQueueURL:
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Description: "URL of the dead letter queue"
    Value: !Ref DeadLetterQueue
  DeadLetterQueueARN:
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Description: "ARN of the dead letter queue"
    Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
  AlarmTopicARN:
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic for alarms"
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:

    Default: TemplateGatewayPool

    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient

    Default: researchapp
Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true

        - Name: email

          Mutable: true

        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain

      Domain: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
  ResourceServer:

    Properties:

      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
  CustomerGroup:

    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - researchapp/read
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
  MachineClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

  AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction:

      Code:

            const cognito = new AWS.CognitoIdentityServiceProvider();

              Username: event.userName

  SSMUserPoolId:

    Properties:

  SSMMachineClientId:

      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineClient
  SSMMachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/MachineClientSecret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineClient.ClientSecret
  SSMOAuthScopes:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/OAuthScopes
      Type: String
      Value: researchapp/read
  SSMDiscoveryUrl:

    Properties:

  SSMTokenUrl:

Description: "CloudFormation template for CryptoTickerAPI - GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data using AWS AppSync, DynamoDB, and CoinGecko API"

Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: "APIDataTable"
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "hk"
          AttributeType: "S"
        - AttributeName: "sk"
          AttributeType: "S"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "hk"
          KeyType: "HASH"
        - AttributeName: "sk"
          KeyType: "RANGE"
      BillingMode: "PAY_PER_REQUEST"
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi"
    Properties:
      Name: "CryptoTickerAPI"
      AuthenticationType: "API_KEY"

  Schema:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema"
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          priceUSD: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
          priceHistory(limit: Int = 25, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }
        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord!]!
          nextToken: String
        }
        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String!
          priceUSD: Float!
          timestamp: AWSDateTime!
        }
        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  ApiKey:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::ApiKey"
    DependsOn: Schema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: "Default API Key for CryptoTickerAPI"

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

  DynamoDBDataSource:

    Properties:

      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"

  HTTPDataSource:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::DataSource"
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: "HTTPDataSource"
      Type: "HTTP"
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: "https://api.coingecko.com"

  FetchFromCoinGeckoFunction:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration"
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      DataSourceName: "HTTPDataSource"
      Name: "FetchFromCoinGecko"
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/api/v3/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            },
            "headers": {
              "Content-Type": "application/json"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if ($ctx.result.statusCode == 200)
          #set($body = $util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))
          #set($priceData = $body.get($ctx.args.ticker))
          #if ($priceData && $priceData.usd)
            $util.toJson({
              "ticker": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "priceUSD": $priceData.usd,
              "timestamp": "$util.time.nowISO8601()"
            })
          #else
            $util.appendError("Ticker not found in CoinGecko response")
            $util.toJson(null)
          #end
        #else
          $util.appendError("HTTP request failed with status " + $ctx.result.statusCode)
          $util.toJson(null)
        #end

  StoreInDynamoDBFunction:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration"
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      DataSourceName: "DynamoDBDataSource"
      Name: "StoreInDynamoDB"
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": { "S": "$ctx.prev.result.ticker" },
            "sk": { "S": "$ctx.prev.result.timestamp" }
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": { "S": "$ctx.prev.result.ticker" },
            "priceUSD": { "N": "$ctx.prev.result.priceUSD" },
            "timestamp": { "S": "$ctx.prev.result.timestamp" }
          },
          "returnValues": "ALL_NEW"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({
          "ticker": "$ctx.result.attributes.ticker.S",
          "priceUSD": $util.toNumber($ctx.result.attributes.priceUSD.N),
          "timestamp": "$ctx.result.attributes.timestamp.S"
        })

  QueryTickerResolver:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::Resolver"
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: "Query"
      FieldName: "ticker"
      Kind: "PIPELINE"
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchFromCoinGeckoFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StoreInDynamoDBFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  TickerInfoPriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: "AWS::AppSync::Resolver"
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: "TickerInfo"
      FieldName: "priceHistory"

      Kind: "UNIT"
      RequestMappingTemplate: |

          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": { "S": "$ctx.source.ticker" }
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.args.nextToken)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($items = [])
        #foreach($item in $ctx.result.items)
          #set($mappedItem = {
            "ticker": $item.ticker.S,
            "priceUSD": $util.toNumber($item.priceUSD.N),
            "timestamp": $item.timestamp.S
          })
          $util.qr($items.add($mappedItem))
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "items": $items,
          "nextToken": $ctx.result.nextToken
        })
