AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints and optional VOD workflows"
Parameters:
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "S3 bucket name for live-to-VOD archive storage. If provided, origin endpoints will have Origination set to DENY and a MediaPackage IAM role will be created with access to this bucket."
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "S3 bucket name for VOD source content. If provided, VOD packaging resources will be provisioned."
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: "Output type for VOD packaging configurations when VodSourceBucket is provided."
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: "Manifest name for the HLS origin endpoint."
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 60
    Description: "Segment duration in seconds for the HLS origin endpoint."
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 604800
    Description: "Startover window in seconds for the origin endpoints."
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: LiveStream
    Description: "Prefix for resource naming."
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: "Environment tag value."
  CustomTagKey1:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom tag key 1."
  CustomTagValue1:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom tag value 1."
  CustomTagKey2:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom tag key 2."
  CustomTagValue2:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom tag value 2."
Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, ""]]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, ""]]
  CreateMediaPackageRole: !Or [!Condition HasArchiveBucket, !Condition HasVodSourceBucket]
  CreateVodResources: !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
  CreateVodHlsConfig: !And
    - !Condition CreateVodResources
    - !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]]
  CreateVodDashConfig: !And
    - !Condition CreateVodResources
    - !Or [!Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH], !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]]
  HasCustomTag1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey1, ""]]
  HasCustomTag2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey2, ""]]
Resources:
  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateMediaPackageRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - mediapackage.amazonaws.com
                - mediapackage-vod.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasArchiveBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*"
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}"
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
              - !If
                - HasVodSourceBucket
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:ListBucket
                  Resource:
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*"
                    - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}"
                - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-MediaPackageRole"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Ref LogicalNamePrefix
      Description: !Sub "MediaPackage live streaming channel for ${LogicalNamePrefix}"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-Channel"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-HlsEndpoint"
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-HlsEndpoint"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-DashEndpoint"
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        Profile: NONE
        StreamSelection:
          MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
          MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
        PeriodTriggers:
          - ADS
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-DashEndpoint"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: CreateVodResources
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-PackagingGroup"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-PackagingGroup"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  VodHlsPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodHlsConfig
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-HlsPackagingConfig"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage:
        HlsManifests:
          - AdMarkers: NONE
            ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
            ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 60
            RepeatExtXKey: false
            StreamSelection:
              MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
              MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
              StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-HlsPackagingConfig"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  VodDashPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodDashConfig
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-DashPackagingConfig"
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      DashPackage:
        DashManifests:
          - ManifestLayout: FULL
            ManifestName: !Sub "${ManifestName}-dash"
            MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
            Profile: NONE
            StreamSelection:
              MaxVideoBitsPerSecond: 2147483647
              MinVideoBitsPerSecond: 0
              StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
        PeriodTriggers:
          - ADS
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${LogicalNamePrefix}-DashPackagingConfig"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey1
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue1
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey2
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
Outputs:
  MediaPackageChannelId:
    Description: "MediaPackage channel ID"
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
  HlsOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: "HLS origin endpoint URL"
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url
  DashOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: "DASH origin endpoint URL"
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url
  MediaPackageRoleArn:
    Description: "IAM Role ARN for MediaPackage bucket access"
    Condition: CreateMediaPackageRole
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageRole.Arn
  VodPackagingGroupId:
    Description: "VOD Packaging Group ID"
    Condition: CreateVodResources
    Value: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
  VodHlsPackagingConfigurationId:
    Description: "VOD HLS Packaging Configuration ID"
    Condition: CreateVodHlsConfig
    Value: !Ref VodHlsPackagingConfiguration
  VodDashPackagingConfigurationId:
    Description: "VOD DASH Packaging Configuration ID"
    Condition: CreateVodDashConfig
    Value: !Ref VodDashPackagingConfiguration

          - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for a DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, point-in-time recovery, optional KMS encryption, and optional CloudWatch alarms for throttling and errors."

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyTable
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Name of the partition (hash) key.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the partition key (S, N, or B).
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Name of the sort (range) key. Leave empty to omit.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the sort key (S, N, or B). Used only if SortKeyName is provided.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: Billing mode for the table.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Read capacity units for provisioned mode (ignored for on-demand).
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Write capacity units for provisioned mode (ignored for on-demand).
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery for the table.
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key for server-side encryption. Leave empty to use default AWS-managed key or no encryption.
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttling and error rates. Requires SnsTopicArn.
  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ARN of an SNS topic for alarm notifications. Required if EnableAlarms is true.

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, ""]]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  HasKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, ""]]
  HasAlarms: !And [!Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, "true"], !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, ""]]]
  EnablePITR: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, "true"]

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - Fn::If:
            - HasSortKey
            - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
              AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - Fn::If:
            - HasSortKey
            - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
              KeyType: RANGE
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        Fn::If:
          - IsProvisioned
          - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
            WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        Fn::If:
          - EnablePITR
          - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      SSESpecification:
        Fn::If:
          - HasKmsKey
          - SSEEnabled: true
            KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKeyArn
            SSEType: KMS
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-ReadThrottle"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when read throttling occurs"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-WriteThrottle"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when write throttling occurs"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-SystemErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when system errors occur"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${TableName}-UserErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when user errors occur"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn

Outputs:
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'EC2 Image Builder pipeline for Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86 and arm64) with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, SSM sudo access, public and organization sharing.'

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1.0.0'
    Description: 'Version for the output AMI (e.g., 1.0.0)'
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: 'Root volume size in GB'
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-aaaaaaaaaa'
    Description: 'AWS Organization ID to share AMIs with (e.g., o-xxxxxx)'
  BaseImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '2023.7.20241201'
    Description: 'Version of the parent Amazon Linux 2023 managed image (e.g., 2023.7.20241201)'
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the VPC used for build instances'
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for the subnet used for build instances'

Resources:
  # VPC for build instances
  BuildVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-vpc'

  # Subnet for build instances
  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-subnet'

  # Security group for build instances (outbound only)
  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: 'Security group for Image Builder build instances'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-sg'

  # IAM role for build instance
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2ImageBuilderBuild
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:AttachVolume
                  - ec2:DetachVolume
                Resource: '*'

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  # IAM role for Image Builder service
  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - imagebuilder:*
                Resource: '*'

  # Combined component for software installation and testing
  SoftwareAndTestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software-test-component'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: 'Linux'
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstallationAndTest
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, enable SSM sudo, and test
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ssm-user
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker-compose-plugin
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSSMUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker compose version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - "python3 -c \"import synapseclient; import pandas; import pysftp; print('All imports successful')\""

  # Image Recipe for x86
  ImageRecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/${BaseImageVersion}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareAndTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: '/tmp'

  # Image Recipe for arm64
  ImageRecipeArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/${BaseImageVersion}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareAndTestComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
      WorkingDirectory: '/tmp'

  # Shared Infrastructure Configuration
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      Description: 'Shared infrastructure configuration for Image Builder pipelines'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - t4g.medium
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Distribution Configuration (shared across pipelines)
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dist-config'
      Description: 'Distribution configuration with public launch and organization sharing'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: 'Custom AMI with Docker and Python packages'
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'

  # Pipeline for x86
  PipelineX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-x86'
      Description: 'Pipeline to build x86 AMI'
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # Pipeline for arm64
  PipelineArm64:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-arm64'
      Description: 'Pipeline to build arm64 AMI'
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  PipelineX86Arn:
    Description: 'ARN of the x86 Image Builder pipeline'
    Value: !Ref PipelineX86
  PipelineArm64Arn:
    Description: 'ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline'
    Value: !Ref PipelineArm64
  ImageRecipeX86Arn:
    Description: 'ARN of the x86 image recipe'
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeX86
  ImageRecipeArm64Arn:
    Description: 'ARN of the arm64 image recipe'
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipeArm64
  BuildVpcId:
    Description: 'VPC ID used for build instances'
    Value: !Ref BuildVPC
  BuildSubnetId:
    Description: 'Subnet ID used for build instances'
    Value: !Ref BuildSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo - Cognito User Pool with seeded test users
Resources:
  AgentOpsUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
        - phone_number
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      SmsConfiguration:
        SnsCallerArn: !GetAtt SmsRole.Arn
        ExternalId: agentops-demo
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: phone_number
          Required: false
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_LINK
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
  SmsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SnsPublish
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: "*"
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: agentops-demo
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
  AgentOpsUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:role
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:role
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
  SeederLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUserManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt AgentOpsUserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
  UserSeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: agentops-user-seeder
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SeederLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
                      cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

                      users = [
                          ('alice@demo.local', 'team-alpha', 'member'),
                          ('bob@demo.local', 'team-alpha', 'member'),
                          ('charlie@demo.local', 'team-alpha', 'team_admin'),
                          ('dave@demo.local', 'team-beta', 'member'),
                          ('eve@demo.local', 'team-beta', 'team_admin'),
                          ('admin@demo.local', 'admin', 'admin'),
                      ]

                      password = 'Demo1234!'

                      for email, group, role in users:
                          try:
                              cognito.admin_create_user(
                                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                                  Username=email,
                                  UserAttributes=[
                                      {'Name': 'email', 'Value': email},
                                      {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                                      {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': role},
                                  ],
                                  MessageAction='SUPPRESS'
                              )
                          except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                              pass

                          cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              Password=password,
                              Permanent=True
                          )

                          cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=email,
                              GroupName=group
                          )

                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Message': 'Users seeded successfully'}, physicalResourceId=user_pool_id)
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Message': 'No action taken for delete'}, physicalResourceId=event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'none'))
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Message': str(e)}, physicalResourceId=event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'none'))
  UserSeeder:
    Type: Custom::UserSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
      - AdminGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt UserSeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt AgentOpsUserPool.Arn
  ClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref AgentOpsUserPoolClient
  Region:
    Description: AWS region where resources are deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function used to seed users
    Value: !GetAtt UserSeederFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CloudFormation template to create CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and a dashboard for AWS Client VPN usage reporting.'

Parameters:

      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /.*"authentication-type":"(?<auth_type>[^"]+)".*/
        | stats count() by auth_type
        | sort count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/DistinctUsers'
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /.*"username":"(?<username>[^"]+)".*/
        | stats count_distinct(username) as distinct_users
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/ConnectionDurations'
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /.*"connection-duration":"(?<duration>[^"]+)".*/
        | stats avg(duration) as avg_duration_ms by endpoint
        | sort avg_duration_ms desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName

  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${FolderPath}-client-vpn-usage'
      DashboardBody:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "widgets": [
                {
                  "type": "logExplorer",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 0,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "query": "${TotalUsageQueryArn}",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",
                    "view": "table",
                    "time": {
                      "type": "relative",
                      "value": 3600
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "logExplorer",
                  "x": 12,
                  "y": 0,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "query": "${AuthTypeQueryArn}",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Usage per Authentication Type",
                    "view": "table",
                    "time": {
                      "type": "relative",
                      "value": 3600
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "logExplorer",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 6,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "query": "${DistinctUsersQueryArn}",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Distinct Users",
                    "view": "table",
                    "time": {
                      "type": "relative",
                      "value": 3600
                    }
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "logExplorer",
                  "x": 12,
                  "y": 6,
                  "width": 12,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "query": "${ConnectionDurationsQueryArn}",
                    "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                    "title": "Average Connection Duration per Endpoint",
                    "view": "table",
                    "time": {
                      "type": "relative",
                      "value": 3600
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - TotalUsageQueryArn:
              Fn::Join:
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:logs:'
                  - !Ref AWS::Region
                  - ':'
                  - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                  - ':query-definition:'
                  - !GetAtt TotalUsagePerEndpointQuery.QueryDefinitionId
            AuthTypeQueryArn:
              Fn::Join:
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:logs:'
                  - !Ref AWS::Region
                  - ':'
                  - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                  - ':query-definition:'
                  - !GetAtt UsagePerAuthTypeQuery.QueryDefinitionId
            DistinctUsersQueryArn:
              Fn::Join:
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:logs:'
                  - !Ref AWS::Region
                  - ':'
                  - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                  - ':query-definition:'
                  - !GetAtt DistinctUsersQuery.QueryDefinitionId
            ConnectionDurationsQueryArn:
              Fn::Join:
                - ''
                - - 'arn:aws:logs:'
                  - !Ref AWS::Region
                  - ':'
                  - !Ref AWS::AccountId
                  - ':query-definition:'
                  - !GetAtt ConnectionDurationsQuery.QueryDefinitionId

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Description: 'Name of the CloudWatch dashboard created.'
    Value: !Ref ClientVpnUsageDashboard
  TotalUsageQueryId:
    Description: 'Query ID for Total Usage per Endpoint.'
    Value: !Ref TotalUsagePerEndpointQuery
  UsagePerAuthTypeQueryId:
    Description: 'Query ID for Usage per Authentication Type.'
    Value: !Ref UsagePerAuthTypeQuery
  DistinctUsersQueryId:
    Description: 'Query ID for Distinct Users.'
    Value: !Ref DistinctUsersQuery
  ConnectionDurationsQueryId:
    Description: 'Query ID for Connection Durations.'
    Value: !Ref ConnectionDurationsQuery

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "AnyCompany Hotel Cognito User Pool with advanced security, admin-only creation, SPA and admin clients, groups, M2M OAuth2 client, and domain."

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: "Environment name used in resource naming."

Resources:
  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-userpool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: guest_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
        - Name: property_id
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
        - Name: region
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false

  SPAUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${Environment}-spa-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  AdminUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${Environment}-admin-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      GenerateSecret: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: "Administrators with full access."

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: "General managers."

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: "Regional managers."

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: "Revenue managers."

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: "Front desk staff."

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: "Housekeeping staff."

  M2MResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-api"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Identifier: !Sub "https://${Environment}-api.anycompanyhotel.com"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: "Read access to hotel data"
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: "Write access to hotel data"
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: "Admin access to hotel data"

  M2MUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${Environment}-m2m-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub "${M2MResourceServer}/read"
        - !Sub "${M2MResourceServer}/write"
        - !Sub "${M2MResourceServer}/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "${Environment}-anycompany-hotel-${AWS::AccountId}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt CognitoUserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn"
  SPAUserPoolClientId:
    Description: "SPA Client ID (public, no secret)"
    Value: !Ref SPAUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SPAClientId"
  AdminUserPoolClientId:
    Description: "Admin Client ID (server-side, with secret)"
    Value: !Ref AdminUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AdminClientId"
  AdminUserPoolClientSecret:
    Description: "Admin Client Secret"
    Value: !GetAtt AdminUserPoolClient.ClientSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AdminClientSecret"
  M2MUserPoolClientId:
    Description: "M2M OAuth2 Client ID (client_credentials)"
    Value: !Ref M2MUserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-M2MClientId"
  M2MUserPoolClientSecret:
    Description: "M2M OAuth2 Client Secret"
    Value: !GetAtt M2MUserPoolClient.ClientSecret
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-M2MClientSecret"
  UserPoolDomainURL:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool Domain URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DomainURL"
  ResourceServerIdentifier:
    Description: "Resource Server Identifier (audience)"
    Value: !Ref M2MResourceServer
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ResourceServerIdentifier"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Hospitality Insights Cognito User Pool (Prod) - v4"

Parameters:
  LoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "OIDC issuer URL for federated identity provider (e.g., https://accounts.google.com). Leave empty to disable SSO."
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Name of the federated identity provider (e.g., Google). Leave empty to disable SSO."
  OIDCClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "OIDC client ID provided by the identity provider. Required if SSO is enabled."
  OIDCClientSecret:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    NoEcho: true
    Description: "OIDC client secret provided by the identity provider. Required if SSO is enabled."
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Custom domain prefix for Cognito hosted UI (e.g., 'myapp' for myapp.auth.region.amazoncognito.com). Leave empty to use default domain."
  SessionTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    MinValue: 3600
    MaxValue: 2592000
    Description: "Refresh token validity in seconds (default 24 hours)."
  CallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: "https://hospitality-insights.com/callback"
    Description: "Callback URL for OAuth2 authorization code flow."
  LogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: "https://hospitality-insights.com/logout"
    Description: "Logout URL for OAuth2."

Conditions:
  SSOEnabled:
    Fn::And:
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - !Ref LoginURL
              - ""
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - !Ref SSOProviderName
              - ""
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - !Ref OIDCClientId
              - ""
  DomainEnabled:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref DomainPrefix
          - ""

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUpdateUserAttributes
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"
      RoleName: "hospitality-insights-prod-lambda-role"

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: "hospitality-insights-prod-post-auth"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']

              client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {
                          'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                          'Value': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
                      }
                  ]
              )
              return event
      Description: "Updates custom:last_login attribute on user after authentication"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: prod
        - Key: Application
          Value: hospitality-insights

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthLambda
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: hospitality-insights-prod-user-pool
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
          AttributeDataType: String
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          DeveloperOnlyAttribute: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: hospitality-insights-prod-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: !Ref SessionTimeout
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: seconds
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Fn::If:
            - SSOEnabled
            - !Ref SSOProviderName
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref CallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref LogoutURL
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile

  UserPoolDomain:
    Condition: DomainEnabled
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  IdentityProvider:
    Condition: SSOEnabled
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        username: sub
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref OIDCClientId
        client_secret: !Ref OIDCClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: "openid email profile"
        attributes_request_method: GET
        oidc_issuer: !Ref LoginURL
        authorize_url: !Sub "${LoginURL}/authorize"
        token_url: !Sub "${LoginURL}/token"
        attributes_url: !Sub "${LoginURL}/userinfo"
        jwks_uri: !Sub "${LoginURL}/.well-known/jwks"
      IdpIdentifiers:
        - !Ref SSOProviderName

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: "Administrators with full access"
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: "Regular application users"
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: "Power users with elevated privileges"
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "The ID of the Cognito User Pool"
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: "The ID of the Cognito User Pool Client"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId"

  UserPoolProviderURL:
    Description: "The Cognito User Pool provider URL (issuer)"
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderURL
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolProviderURL"

  DomainName:
    Condition: DomainEnabled
    Description: "Custom domain for Cognito hosted UI"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolDomain
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DomainName"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for managing client connections and session state with DynamoDB
Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Stage name for the WebSocket API
Resources:
  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-sessions
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebSocketSessionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*
  ConnectLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, time, os
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              connectionId = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              ttl = int(time.time()) + 3600
              table.put_item(Item={'connectionId': connectionId, 'ttl': ttl})
              return {'statusCode': 200}
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionsTable
  DefaultLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
          def handler(event, context):
              connectionId = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              domain = event['requestContext']['domainName']
              stage = event['requestContext']['stage']
              endpoint = f'https://{domain}/{stage}'
              client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint)
              table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
              body = event.get('body', '')
              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(ConnectionId=connectionId, Data=body)
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'GoneException':
                      table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connectionId})
              return {'statusCode': 200}
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionsTable
  DisconnectLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3, os
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              connectionId = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connectionId})
              return {'statusCode': 200}
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionsTable
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-websocket
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${ConnectIntegration}
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DefaultIntegration}
  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ConnectLambda.Arn}/invocations
  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DefaultLambda.Arn}/invocations
  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DisconnectLambda.Arn}/invocations
  ConnectLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$connect
  DefaultLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$default
  DisconnectLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectLambda
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$disconnect
  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - ConnectIntegration
      - DefaultIntegration
      - DisconnectIntegration

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for AWS FIS experiment template targeting chaos engineering across TGW route tables, subnet route tables, S3 buckets, and DynamoDB global tables"

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Description: "The AWS region to block network traffic to"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]{1}$"
    ConstraintDescription: "Must be a valid AWS region code (e.g., us-west-2)"
  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Duration in seconds for the experiment (default 20 minutes = 1200 seconds)"
    Default: 1200
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 86400
  ChaosAllowedTagValue:
    Type: String
    Description: "Value of the ChaosAllowed tag to target resources"
    Default: "true"

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting FIS experiment CloudWatch logs"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow FIS to use the key for logging"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain

  KmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/fis-experiment-logs-${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/fis/${AWS::StackName}-experiment-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  FisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "fis-experiment-role-${AWS::StackName}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref FisPolicy

  FisPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "fis-experiment-policy-${AWS::StackName}"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "DisruptConnectivity"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ec2:DisruptTransitGatewayRouteTableConnectivity"
              - "ec2:DisruptRouteTableConnectivity"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "PauseS3Replication"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "s3:PauseReplication"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "PauseDynamoDBReplication"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "dynamodb:PauseGlobalTableReplication"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "DescribeResources"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables"
              - "ec2:DescribeTransitGateways"
              - "ec2:DescribeRouteTables"
              - "ec2:DescribeSubnets"
              - "s3:ListAllMyBuckets"
              - "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration"
              - "s3:GetBucketTagging"
              - "dynamodb:ListGlobalTables"
              - "dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable"
              - "dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "CloudWatchLogs"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "logs:CreateLogStream"
              - "logs:PutLogEvents"
              - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
            Resource: !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn
          - Sid: "KMSPermissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
            Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Chaos engineering experiment blocking traffic to ${TargetRegion} and pausing cross-region replication for ${ExperimentDuration} seconds"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Targets:
        TransitGatewayRouteTables:
          ResourceType: "aws:ec2:transit-gateway-route-table"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosAllowedTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
        SubnetRouteTables:
          ResourceType: "aws:ec2:route-table"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosAllowedTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
        S3Buckets:
          ResourceType: "aws:s3:bucket"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosAllowedTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
        DynamoDBTables:
          ResourceType: "aws:dynamodb:global-table"
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: !Ref ChaosAllowedTagValue
          SelectionMode: "ALL"
      Actions:
        BlockTGW:
          ActionId: "aws:ec2:disrupt-transit-gateway-route-table-connectivity"
          Description: !Sub "Block network traffic from local region to ${TargetRegion} via Transit Gateway route tables"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
            targetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            TransitGatewayRouteTables: TransitGatewayRouteTables
        BlockSubnet:
          ActionId: "aws:ec2:disrupt-route-table-connectivity"
          Description: !Sub "Block network traffic from local region to ${TargetRegion} via subnet route tables"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
            targetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            SubnetRouteTables: SubnetRouteTables
        PauseS3:
          ActionId: "aws:s3:pause-replication"
          Description: "Pause S3 cross-region replication"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
          Targets:
            Buckets: S3Buckets
        PauseDDB:
          ActionId: "aws:dynamodb:pause-global-table-replication"
          Description: "Pause DynamoDB global table replication"
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
          Targets:
            GlobalTables: DynamoDBTables
      LogConfiguration:
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn
          LogSchemaVersion: 2

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: "ID of the FIS experiment template"
    Value: !Ref ExperimentTemplate
  FisRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the IAM role used by FIS"
    Value: !GetAtt FisRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch log group"
    Value: !Ref FisLogGroup
  KmsKeyId:
    Description: "ID of the KMS key used for log encryption"
    Value: !Ref KmsKey

    Description: "CIDR block for public subnet in AZ2"
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String

    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet in AZ1"
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    Description: "CIDR block for private subnet in AZ2"
  K8sClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: "my-eks-cluster"
    Description: "Name of the EKS cluster for subnet tagging (optional)"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"
        - Key: !Sub "kubernetes.io/cluster/${K8sClusterName}"

  InternetGateway:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
        - Key: !Sub "kubernetes.io/cluster/${K8sClusterName}"
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"
        - Key: !Sub "kubernetes.io/cluster/${K8sClusterName}"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

        - Key: Name

    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Properties:

            Action:

              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogKey"

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::LogGroup"
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-FlowLogGroup"

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "VPCFlowLogsPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "kms:Encrypt"
                  - "kms:Decrypt"
                  - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                  - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                  - "kms:DescribeKey"

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  VPCFlowLog:

      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC

      TrafficType: "ALL"
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 600
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCFlowLog"

    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPCId"
  PublicSubnet1Id:
