AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: identity pool
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: OrderFlowers
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
    Default: false
  LiveChatApiId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  LiveChatStage:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
Conditions:
  UseLexV2:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref LexV2BotId
          - ''
  ForceCognitoLoginTrue:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref ForceCognitoLogin
      - 'true'
  EnableLiveChat:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat
      - 'true'
  EnableLiveChatAndNotForceCognito:
    Fn::And:
      - !Condition EnableLiveChat
      - Fn::Not:
          - !Condition ForceCognitoLoginTrue
  NotForceCognitoLogin:
    Fn::Not:
      - !Condition ForceCognitoLoginTrue
Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName
  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-authenticated-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexAndPollyPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  Fn::If:
                    - UseLexV2
                    - - lex:RecognizeText
                      - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    - - lex:PostText
                      - lex:PostContent
                Resource:
                  Fn::If:
                    - UseLexV2
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: '*'
        - Fn::If:
            - EnableLiveChat
            -
              PolicyName: LiveChatPolicy
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: 2012-10-17
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action: execute-api:Invoke
                    Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${LiveChatApiId}/${LiveChatStage}/*/POST/livechat'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-unauthenticated-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - Fn::If:
            - NotForceCognitoLogin
            -
              PolicyName: LexPolicy
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: 2012-10-17
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      Fn::If:
                        - UseLexV2
                        - - lex:RecognizeText
                          - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                        - - lex:PostText
                          - lex:PostContent
                    Resource:
                      Fn::If:
                        - UseLexV2
                        - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}'
                        - !Sub 'arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot:${LexV1BotName}'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - Fn::If:
            - EnableLiveChatAndNotForceCognito
            -
              PolicyName: LiveChatPolicy
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: 2012-10-17
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action: execute-api:Invoke
                    Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${LiveChatApiId}/${LiveChatStage}/*/POST/livechat'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn
Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Route 53 hosted zone and DNS records for passengerlist.org'
Parameters:
  HostedZoneName:
    Type: String
    Default: passengerlist.org
  RootCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_ROOT.cloudfront.net'
  WwwCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_WWW.cloudfront.net'
  DeparturesCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_DEPARTURES.cloudfront.net'
  JoinCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_JOIN.cloudfront.net'
  AthenaCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_ATHENA.cloudfront.net'
  FeedCloudFrontDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_FEED.cloudfront.net'
  SpfTxtValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all'
  SiteVerificationTxtValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_SITE_VERIFICATION'
  DmarcTxtValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@passengerlist.org'
  MxPriority1:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
  MxTarget1:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
  MxPriority2:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
  MxTarget2:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
  MxPriority3:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
  MxTarget3:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
  MxPriority4:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
  MxTarget4:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
  MxPriority5:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
  MxTarget5:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM'
  ZendeskMailCnameName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'mail'
  ZendeskMailCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: 'zendesk.com'
  DkimCname1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: 'google._domainkey'
  DkimCname1Value:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REPLACE_ME_DKIM1'
  DkimCname2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: 'dkim._domainkey'
  DkimCname2Value:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  SquarespaceCnameName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'www2'
  SquarespaceCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: 'verify.squarespace.com'
  AcmValidationRootName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationRootValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationWwwName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationWwwValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationDeparturesName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationDeparturesValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationJoinName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationJoinValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationAthenaName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationAthenaValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationFeedName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  AcmValidationFeedValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasDkim2:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - ''
          - !Ref DkimCname2Value
  HasAcmRoot:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - ''
          - !Ref AcmValidationRootName
  HasAcmWww:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - ''
          - !Ref AcmValidationWwwName
  HasAcmDepartures:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - ''
          - !Ref AcmValidationDeparturesName
  HasAcmJoin:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - ''
          - !Ref AcmValidationJoinName
  HasAcmAthena:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - ''
          - !Ref AcmValidationAthenaName
  HasAcmFeed:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - ''
          - !Ref AcmValidationFeedName

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::HostedZone'
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref HostedZoneName

  # Consolidated unconditional records – combined TXT and MX into single records
  MainRecordSetGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup'
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Comment: 'Unconditional DNS records for passengerlist.org'
      RecordSets:
        # Combined TXT record for root domain (SPF and site verification)
        - Name: !Sub '${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'TXT'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"${SpfTxtValue}"'
            - !Sub '"${SiteVerificationTxtValue}"'
          TTL: '3600'

        # Combined MX record for root domain (all five priorities)
        - Name: !Sub '${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'MX'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '${MxPriority1} ${MxTarget1}'
            - !Sub '${MxPriority2} ${MxTarget2}'
            - !Sub '${MxPriority3} ${MxTarget3}'
            - !Sub '${MxPriority4} ${MxTarget4}'
            - !Sub '${MxPriority5} ${MxTarget5}'
          TTL: '3600'

        # Alias A and AAAA records for root domain
        - Name: !Sub '${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'A'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref RootCloudFrontDomainName
        - Name: !Sub '${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'AAAA'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref RootCloudFrontDomainName

        # Alias records for subdomains
        - Name: !Sub 'www.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'A'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref WwwCloudFrontDomainName
        - Name: !Sub 'www.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'AAAA'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref WwwCloudFrontDomainName

        - Name: !Sub 'departures.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'A'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref DeparturesCloudFrontDomainName
        - Name: !Sub 'departures.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'AAAA'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref DeparturesCloudFrontDomainName

        - Name: !Sub 'join.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'A'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref JoinCloudFrontDomainName
        - Name: !Sub 'join.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'AAAA'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref JoinCloudFrontDomainName

        - Name: !Sub 'athena.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'A'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref AthenaCloudFrontDomainName
        - Name: !Sub 'athena.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'AAAA'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref AthenaCloudFrontDomainName

        - Name: !Sub 'feed.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'A'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref FeedCloudFrontDomainName
        - Name: !Sub 'feed.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'AAAA'
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: 'Z2FDTNDATAQYW2'
            DNSName: !Ref FeedCloudFrontDomainName

        # DMARC TXT record (separate subdomain)
        - Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'TXT'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"${DmarcTxtValue}"'
          TTL: '3600'

        # CNAME records (unconditional)
        - Name: !Sub '${ZendeskMailCnameName}.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'CNAME'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref ZendeskMailCnameTarget
          TTL: '3600'
        - Name: !Sub '${DkimCname1Name}.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'CNAME'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref DkimCname1Value
          TTL: '3600'
        - Name: !Sub '${SquarespaceCnameName}.${HostedZoneName}.'
          Type: 'CNAME'
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref SquarespaceCnameTarget
          TTL: '3600'

  # Conditional DKIM CNAME 2
  DkimCname2:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Condition: HasDkim2
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DkimCname2Name}.${HostedZoneName}.'
      Type: 'CNAME'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref DkimCname2Value
      TTL: '3600'

  # ACM validation CNAMEs (conditional)
  AcmValidationRoot:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Condition: HasAcmRoot
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref AcmValidationRootName
      Type: 'CNAME'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmValidationRootValue
      TTL: '60'

  AcmValidationWww:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Condition: HasAcmWww
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref AcmValidationWwwName
      Type: 'CNAME'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmValidationWwwValue
      TTL: '60'

  AcmValidationDepartures:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Condition: HasAcmDepartures
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref AcmValidationDeparturesName
      Type: 'CNAME'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmValidationDeparturesValue
      TTL: '60'

  AcmValidationJoin:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Condition: HasAcmJoin
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref AcmValidationJoinName
      Type: 'CNAME'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmValidationJoinValue
      TTL: '60'

  AcmValidationAthena:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Condition: HasAcmAthena
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref AcmValidationAthenaName
      Type: 'CNAME'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmValidationAthenaValue
      TTL: '60'

  AcmValidationFeed:
    Type: 'AWS::Route53::RecordSet'
    Condition: HasAcmFeed
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref AcmValidationFeedName
      Type: 'CNAME'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref AcmValidationFeedValue
      TTL: '60'

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: Route 53 hosted zone ID
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
  NameServers:
    Description: Name servers for the hosted zone
    Value: !Join [', ', !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup"
                  - "cognito-idp:AdminListGroupsForUser"
                Resource: "arn:aws:cognito-idp:*:*:userpool/*"
        - PolicyName: "LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: "AWS::Lambda::Function"
    Properties:
      FunctionName: "AutoAddCustomerGroup"
      Description: "Automatically adds new user sign-ups to the customer group"
      Runtime: "python3.11"
      Handler: "index.lambda_handler"
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event['userPoolId']
              username = event['userName']
              client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
              try:
                  client.admin_add_user_to_group(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      GroupName='customer'
                  )
                  print(f"Successfully added user {username} to customer group")
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error adding user to group: {str(e)}")
                  raise e
              return event

  LambdaPermission:
    Type: "AWS::Lambda::Permission"
    Properties:
      Action: "lambda:InvokeFunction"
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: "cognito-idp.amazonaws.com"

  CognitoUserPool:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPool"
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "CustomerSupportUserPool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - "email"
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - "email"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      Schema:
        - Name: "email"
          AttributeDataType: "String"
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: "verified_email"
            Priority: 1
      EmailVerificationMessage: "Your verification code from Customer Support: {####}"
      EmailVerificationSubject: "Verify your email for Customer Support"
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      LambdaConfig:
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn

  CognitoUserPoolGroupAdmin:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupName: "admin"
      Description: "Administrator group"
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  CognitoUserPoolGroupCustomer:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupName: "customer"
      Description: "Customer support group"
      Precedence: 5
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  CognitoResourceServer:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer"
    Properties:
      Identifier: "customersupport-api"
      Name: "CustomerSupport API"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "read"
          ScopeDescription: "Read access to customer support resources"

  CognitoUserPoolClientWeb:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    DependsOn:
      - CognitoResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: "CustomerSupportWebClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - "ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH"
        - "ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH"
        - "ALLOW_CUSTOM_AUTH"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - "COGNITO"
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - "code"
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - "openid"
        - "email"
        - "customersupport-api/read"
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: "ENABLED"
      ReadAttributes:
        - "email"
      WriteAttributes:
        - "email"
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: "minutes"
        IdToken: "minutes"
        RefreshToken: "days"
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  CognitoUserPoolClientM2M:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient"
    DependsOn:
      - CognitoResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: "CustomerSupportM2MClient"
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - "COGNITO"
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - "client_credentials"
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - "customersupport-api/read"
      GenerateSecret: true
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: "ENABLED"
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: "minutes"
        RefreshToken: "days"
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  CognitoDomain:
    Type: "AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain"
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref CognitoUserPool

  SSMParameterUserPoolId:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/userpool-id"
      Type: "String"
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPool
      Description: "Cognito User Pool ID for customer support"

  SSMParameterWebClientId:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/web-client-id"
      Type: "String"
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientWeb
      Description: "Web application client ID"

  SSMParameterM2MClientId:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/m2m-client-id"
      Type: "String"
      Value: !Ref CognitoUserPoolClientM2M
      Description: "Machine-to-machine client ID"

  SSMParameterOAuthScope:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/oauth-scope"
      Type: "String"
      Value: "customersupport-api/read"
      Description: "OAuth scope for customer support API"

  SSMParameterDomain:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:
      Name: "/app/customersupport/agentcore/domain"
      Type: "String"
      Value: !Sub "https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: "Cognito hosted UI domain"

  SSMParameterDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:

      Type: "String"

      Description: "OAuth token endpoint"

  SSMParameterAuthorizeEndpoint:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter"
    Properties:

      Type: "String"
      Value: !Sub "https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize"
      Description: "OAuth authorize endpoint"

Outputs:

  Domain:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for DR standby VPC with EC2 health-check instance, flow logs, and encrypted EBS."
Parameters:
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: "AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>"
    Default: "/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64"
    Description: "SSM parameter path for latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI"
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.82.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.82.10.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the private subnet"
  AllowedInternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/8"
    Description: "Internal network range allowed for HTTP/HTTPS access"
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Retention days for flow log log group"
Resources:
  DRKMSKey:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Key"
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for DR standby VPC flow logs and EBS encryption"
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable full access for root user"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs and VPC Flow Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - "logs.amazonaws.com"
                - "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"
  DRKMSAlias:
    Type: "AWS::KMS::Alias"
    Properties:
      AliasName: "alias/dr-standby-kms-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DRKMSKey

  DRVPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "DR-Standby-VPC"
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRIGW:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::InternetGateway"
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "DR-Standby-IGW"
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref DRIGW

  DRRouteTable:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::RouteTable"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "DR-Standby-RouteTable"
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRDefaultRoute:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Route"
    DependsOn: DRVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DRRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref DRIGW

  DRSubnet:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "DR-Standby-PrivateSubnet"
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation"
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DRSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref DRRouteTable

  DRIAMRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "ec2.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRIAMInstanceProfile:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile"
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref DRIAMRole

  DRSecurityGroup:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for DR standby EC2 instance"
      VpcId: !Ref DRVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedInternalCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedInternalCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedInternalCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "DR-Standby-SG"
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DREC2Instance:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Instance"
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: "t3.micro"
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref DRIAMInstanceProfile
      SubnetId: !Ref DRSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DRSecurityGroup
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: "/dev/xvda"
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeType: "gp3"
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: "required"
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: |
          #!/bin/bash
          mkdir -p /var/www/html
          echo "OK" > /var/www/html/index.html
          nohup python3 -m http.server 80 --directory /var/www/html &
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "DR-Standby-EC2"
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRElasticIP:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIP"
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: "Name"
          Value: "DR-Standby-EIP"
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DREIPAssociation:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::EIPAssociation"
    Properties:
      InstanceId: !Ref DREC2Instance
      AllocationId: !GetAtt DRElasticIP.AllocationId

  DRFlowLogRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "flow-logs-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRFlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: "AWS::Logs::LogGroup"
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "/aws/vpc/flow-logs/dr-standby"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt DRKMSKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

  DRFlowLog:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::FlowLog"
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref DRVPC
      ResourceType: "VPC"
      TrafficType: "ALL"
      LogDestinationType: "cloud-watch-logs"
      LogGroupName: !Ref DRFlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt DRFlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: "DR-Standby"
        - Key: "ManagedBy"
          Value: "CloudFormation"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref DRVPC
  SubnetId:
    Description: "Private Subnet ID"
    Value: !Ref DRSubnet
  InstanceId:
    Description: "EC2 Instance ID"
    Value: !Ref DREC2Instance
  ElasticIP:
    Description: "Elastic IP address for health check endpoint"
    Value: !Ref DRElasticIP
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: "CloudWatch Log Group for VPC Flow Logs"
    Value: !Ref DRFlowLogLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Simple VPC setup for learning purposes with optional resources controlled by boolean parameters."

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "SimpleApp1"
    Description: "Prefix for resource names."

  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC."

  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the public subnet."

  SourceIPRange:
    Type: String
    Default: "0.0.0.0/0"
    Description: "Allowed source IP range for HTTP and HTTPS traffic to the security group."

  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to create an Internet Gateway."

  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to create a public subnet."

  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to create a route table."

  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: "Whether to create a security group."

Conditions:
  CreateIGW: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, "true"]
  CreateSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, "true"]
  CreateRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, "true"]
  CreateSG: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, "true"]
  CreateRoute: !And
    - !Condition CreateIGW
    - !Condition CreateRouteTable
  AssociateSubnet: !And
    - !Condition CreateSubnet
    - !Condition CreateRouteTable

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateIGW
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateIGW
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-PublicSubnet"

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-RouteTable"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateRoute
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: AssociateSubnet
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateSG
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group allowing HTTP and HTTPS traffic"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
          Description: "Allow HTTP traffic"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SourceIPRange
          Description: "Allow HTTPS traffic"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-SecurityGroup"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Landing Zone Hub VPC with Transit Gateway, NAT Gateways, VPC Endpoints, and Flow Logs

Parameters:
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Prefix for resource names and tags
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ1
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR for public subnet in AZ2
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ1
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR for private subnet in AZ2
  TransitGatewayASN:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Private ASN for the Transit Gateway (64512-65534)
  FlowLogRetention:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: Retention days for flow logs CloudWatch Log Group

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-nat-gw-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-nat-gw-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  PublicRouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  PrivateRouteToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayASN
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-tgw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-tgw-attach
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-flow-log-role
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/${EnvironmentPrefix}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetention
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-flow-log-group
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-flow-log
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentPrefix}-endpoint-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'

            Resource: '*'

        - Key: Name

        - Key: Environment

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Student Services Agent Infrastructure - Bedrock AgentCore, Cognito, IAM"
Resources:
  BaseManagedPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: StudentServicesBasePolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock/agentcore/*"
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParameterHistory
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*"

  StudentServicesAgentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: StudentServicesAgentRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                sts:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:agent/*"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy

  StudentServicesGatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudentServicesGatewayPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
          RequireUppercase: false

  StudentServicesGatewayDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Domain: !Sub "ss-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}"

  StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudentServicesGatewayUserPool
      Identifier: "student-services-gateway"
      Name: "Student Services Gateway"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Log-Based Monitoring Controls"
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: "/aws/cloudtrail/cis-benchmark-monitoring"
    Description: "Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail events"
  SnsTopicName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CIS-Benchmark-Alarm-Topic"
    Description: "Name of the SNS topic for alarm notifications"
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: "alias/cis-benchmark-key"
    Description: "Alias for the KMS customer managed key"
Resources:
  CisBenchmarkKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting CloudWatch Logs and SNS topic for CIS Benchmark monitoring"
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: "KeyPolicyForCISMonitoring"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn":
                  Fn::Sub: "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupName}"
          - Sid: "Allow SNS to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "sns.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
            Resource: "*"
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: "Purpose"
          Value: "CIS Benchmark Monitoring"
  CisBenchmarkKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName:
        Ref: KmsKeyAlias
      TargetKeyId:
        Ref: CisBenchmarkKmsKey
  CisBenchmarkSnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName:
        Ref: SnsTopicName
      KmsMasterKeyId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - CisBenchmarkKmsKey
          - Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: "Purpose"
          Value: "CIS Benchmark Alarm Notifications"
  CisBenchmarkSnsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - Ref: CisBenchmarkSnsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Publish"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "cloudwatch.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sns:Publish"
            Resource:
              Ref: CisBenchmarkSnsTopic
  CisBenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      KmsKeyId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - CisBenchmarkKmsKey
          - Arn
      RetentionInDays: 365
      Tags:
        - Key: "Purpose"
          Value: "CIS Benchmark CloudTrail Monitoring"
  MetricFilterUnauthorizedApiCalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "UnauthorizedApiCalls"
  MetricFilterConsoleSignInWithoutMfa:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success") && ($.userIdentity.type = "IAMUser") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "ConsoleSignInWithoutMfa"
  MetricFilterRootAccountUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.userIdentity.type = "Root") && ($.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS) && ($.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "RootAccountUsage"
  MetricFilterIamPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "iam.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "DeleteGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "AttachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachGroupPolicy")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "IamPolicyChanges"
  MetricFilterCloudTrailConfigChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "CreateTrail") || ($.eventName = "UpdateTrail") || ($.eventName = "DeleteTrail") || ($.eventName = "StartLogging") || ($.eventName = "StopLogging") || ($.eventName = "UpdateGlobalSettings") || ($.eventName = "PutInsightSelectors") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "CloudTrailConfigChanges"
  MetricFilterConsoleLoginFailures:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Failure") && ($.userIdentity.type = "IAMUser") && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "ConsoleLoginFailures"
  MetricFilterKmsKeyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "DisableKey") || ($.eventName = "ScheduleKeyDeletion")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "KmsKeyChanges"
  MetricFilterS3BucketPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "PutBucketAcl") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketCors") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketLifecycle") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketReplication") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketCors") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketLifecycle") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketReplication")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "S3BucketPolicyChanges"
  MetricFilterConfigChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "config.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "StopConfigurationRecorder") || ($.eventName = "DeleteDeliveryChannel") || ($.eventName = "PutDeliveryChannel") || ($.eventName = "PutConfigurationRecorder")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "1"
          MetricNamespace: "CISBenchmark"
          MetricName: "ConfigChanges"
  MetricFilterSecurityGroupChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Ref: LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "ec2.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress") || ($.eventName = "AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress") || ($.eventName = "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress") || ($.eventName = "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress") || ($.eventName = "CreateSecurityGroup") || ($.eventName = "DeleteSecurityGroup")) }'
      MetricTransformations:

    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Security Hub Automation for AWS Control Tower: Automatically enables Security Hub across the organization, delegates admin to the audit account, and onboards new accounts as members.'

Parameters:
  AuditAccountIdPath:
    Type: String
    Default: '/superwerker/audit-account-id'
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the audit account ID
  LogArchiveAccountIdPath:
    Type: String
    Default: '/superwerker/log-archive-account-id'
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing the log archive account ID
  ControlTowerExecutionRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'AWSControlTowerExecution'
    Description: Name of the cross-account IAM role created by Control Tower in each managed account
  SecurityHubRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: 'us-east-1'
    Description: AWS Region where Security Hub will be enabled
  SSMAutomationRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'SecurityHubAutomationRole'
    Description: Name of the IAM role created for SSM automation execution

Resources:
  # IAM role for SSM Automation to execute cross-account operations
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SSMAutomationRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonSSMAutomationRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${AuditAccountIdPath}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${LogArchiveAccountIdPath}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:ListMembers
                  - securityhub:ListInvitations
                  - securityhub:AcceptInvitation
                  - securityhub:UpdateOrganizationConfiguration
                  - securityhub:BatchEnableStandards
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/${ControlTowerExecutionRoleName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListAWSServiceAccessForOrganization
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                Resource: '*'

  # IAM role for EventBridge to start SSM automations
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: 'SecurityHubEventBridgeRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeToSSMPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

  # SSM Automation Document: Initial setup when landing zone is ready
  SetupDelegatedAdminDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: SSMAutomationRole
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: 'SecurityHubSetupDelegatedAdmin'
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Enable Security Hub, register delegated administrator in audit account, enable in log archive account'
            assumeRole: 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${RoleName}'
            parameters:
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'ARN of the role to assume for automation execution'
                default: 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${RoleName}'
            mainSteps:
              - name: GetConfiguration
                action: aws:executeScript
                inputs:
                  InputPayload:
                    auditAccountIdPath: ${AuditAccountIdPath}
                    logArchiveAccountIdPath: ${LogArchiveAccountIdPath}
                  Script: |
                    import boto3
                    def handler(event, context):
                        ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
                        audit = ssm.get_parameter(Name=event['auditAccountIdPath'])['Parameter']['Value']
                        log = ssm.get_parameter(Name=event['logArchiveAccountIdPath'])['Parameter']['Value']
                        return {'AuditAccountId': audit, 'LogArchiveAccountId': log}
                  Runtime: python3.8
                  Handler: handler
                outputs:
                  - Name: AuditAccountId
                    Selector: $.Payload.AuditAccountId
                    Type: String
                  - Name: LogArchiveAccountId
                    Selector: $.Payload.LogArchiveAccountId
                    Type: String
                timeoutSeconds: 30
              - name: SetupDelegatedAdmin
                action: aws:executeScript
                inputs:
                  InputPayload:
                    auditAccountId: '{{ GetConfiguration.AuditAccountId }}'
                    logArchiveAccountId: '{{ GetConfiguration.LogArchiveAccountId }}'
                    controlTowerRoleName: ${ControlTowerExecutionRoleName}
                    region: ${SecurityHubRegion}
                  Script: |
                    import boto3
                    import json
                    def assume_role(account_id, role_name, region):
                        sts = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region)
                        role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/{role_name}'
                        response = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubSetup')
                        return response['Credentials']
                    def get_client(service, creds, region):
                        return boto3.client(service,
                            aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                            aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                            aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                            region_name=region)
                    def handler(event, context):
                        audit = event['auditAccountId']
                        log_archive = event['logArchiveAccountId']
                        role_name = event['controlTowerRoleName']
                        region = event['region']
                        result = {'Status': 'Success', 'Actions': []}
                        sh_mgmt = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region)
                        try:
                            sh_mgmt.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=False)
                            result['Actions'].append('Enabled Security Hub in management account')
                        except Exception as e:
                            if 'already' in str(e).lower():
                                result['Actions'].append('Security Hub already enabled in management account')
                            else:
                                raise
                        try:
                            sh_mgmt.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit)
                            result['Actions'].append('Registered delegated admin: ' + audit)
                        except Exception as e:
                            if 'already' in str(e).lower() or 'exists' in str(e).lower():
                                result['Actions'].append('Delegated admin already registered')
                            else:
                                raise
                        creds = assume_role(audit, role_name, region)
                        sh_audit = get_client('securityhub', creds, region)
                        try:
                            sh_audit.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=False)
                            result['Actions'].append('Enabled Security Hub in audit account')
                        except Exception as e:
                            if 'already' in str(e).lower():
                                result['Actions'].append('Security Hub already enabled in audit account')
                            else:
                                raise
                        creds = assume_role(log_archive, role_name, region)
                        sh_log = get_client('securityhub', creds, region)
                        try:
                            sh_log.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=False)
                            result['Actions'].append('Enabled Security Hub in log archive account')
                        except Exception as e:
                            if 'already' in str(e).lower():
                                result['Actions'].append('Security Hub already enabled in log archive account')
                            else:
                                raise
                        creds = assume_role(audit, role_name, region)
                        sh_audit = get_client('securityhub', creds, region)
                        members = sh_audit.list_members()
                        member_ids = [m['AccountId'] for m in members.get('Members', [])]
                        if log_archive not in member_ids:
                            sh_audit.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': log_archive}])
                            sh_audit.invite_members(AccountIds=[log_archive])
                            result['Actions'].append('Created member and invited log archive account')
                        else:
                            result['Actions'].append('Log archive account is already a member')
                        creds = assume_role(log_archive, role_name, region)
                        sh_log = get_client('securityhub', creds, region)
                        invitations = sh_log.list_invitations()
                        accepted = False
                        for inv in invitations.get('Invitations', []):
                            if inv['AccountId'] == audit:
                                sh_log.accept_invitation(MasterId=inv['AccountId'], InvitationId=inv['InvitationId'])
                                result['Actions'].append('Accepted invitation in log archive account')
                                accepted = True
                                break
                        if not accepted:
                            result['Actions'].append('No pending invitation found for log archive account')
                        return result
                  Runtime: python3.8
                  Handler: handler
                timeoutSeconds: 180
                outputs:
                  - Name: SetupResult
                    Selector: $.Payload
                    Type: StringMap
          - RoleName: !Ref SSMAutomationRoleName
            AuditAccountIdPath: !Ref AuditAccountIdPath
            LogArchiveAccountIdPath: !Ref LogArchiveAccountIdPath
            ControlTowerExecutionRoleName: !Ref ControlTowerExecutionRoleName
            SecurityHubRegion: !Ref SecurityHubRegion

  # SSM Automation Document: Onboard new account to Security Hub
  OnboardNewAccountDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: SSMAutomationRole
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: 'SecurityHubOnboardNewAccount'
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            schemaVersion: '0.3'
            description: 'Enable Security Hub in a newly provisioned account and add it as a member'
            assumeRole: 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${RoleName}'
            parameters:
              AutomationAssumeRole:
                type: String
                description: 'ARN of the role to assume for automation execution'
                default: 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${RoleName}'
              NewAccountId:
                type: String
                description: 'Account ID of the newly provisioned account'
            mainSteps:
              - name: GetAuditAccountId
                action: aws:executeScript
                inputs:
                  InputPayload:
                    auditAccountIdPath: ${AuditAccountIdPath}
                  Script: |
                    import boto3
                    def handler(event, context):
                        ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
                        audit = ssm.get_parameter(Name=event['auditAccountIdPath'])['Parameter']['Value']
                        return {'AuditAccountId': audit}
                  Runtime: python3.8
                  Handler: handler
                outputs:
                  - Name: AuditAccountId
                    Selector: $.Payload.AuditAccountId
                    Type: String
                timeoutSeconds: 30
              - name: OnboardAccount
                action: aws:executeScript
                inputs:
                  InputPayload:
                    newAccountId: '{{ NewAccountId }}'
                    auditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.AuditAccountId }}'
                    controlTowerRoleName: ${ControlTowerExecutionRoleName}
                    region: ${SecurityHubRegion}
                  Script: |
                    import boto3
                    def assume_role(account_id, role_name, region):
                        sts = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region)
                        role_arn = f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/{role_name}'
                        response = sts.assume_role(RoleArn=role_arn, RoleSessionName='SecurityHubOnboard')
                        return response['Credentials']
                    def get_client(service, creds, region):
                        return boto3.client(service,
                            aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                            aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                            aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                            region_name=region)
                    def handler(event, context):
                        new_account = event['newAccountId']
                        audit = event['auditAccountId']
                        role_name = event['controlTowerRoleName']
                        region = event['region']
                        result = {'Status': 'Success', 'Actions': [], 'AccountId': new_account}
                        creds = assume_role(new_account, role_name, region)
                        sh_new = get_client('securityhub', creds, region)
                        try:
                            sh_new.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=False)
                            result['Actions'].append('Enabled Security Hub in account ' + new_account)
                        except Exception as e:
                            if 'already' in str(e).lower():
                                result['Actions'].append('Security Hub already enabled in account ' + new_account)
                            else:
                                raise
                        creds = assume_role(audit, role_name, region)
                        sh_audit = get_client('securityhub', creds, region)
                        members = sh_audit.list_members()
                        member_ids = [m['AccountId'] for m in members.get('Members', [])]
                        if new_account not in member_ids:
                            sh_audit.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': new_account}])
                            sh_audit.invite_members(AccountIds=[new_account])
                            result['Actions'].append('Created member and invited account ' + new_account)
                        else:
                            result['Actions'].append('Account ' + new_account + ' is already a member')
                        creds = assume_role(new_account, role_name, region)
                        sh_new = get_client('securityhub', creds, region)
                        invitations = sh_new.list_invitations()
                        accepted = False
                        for inv in invitations.get('Invitations', []):
                            if inv['AccountId'] == audit:
                                sh_new.accept_invitation(MasterId=inv['AccountId'], InvitationId=inv['InvitationId'])
                                result['Actions'].append('Accepted invitation in account ' + new_account)
                                accepted = True
                                break
                        if not accepted:
                            result['Actions'].append('No pending invitation found for account ' + new_account)
                        return result
                  Runtime: python3.8
                  Handler: handler
                timeoutSeconds: 180
                outputs:
                  - Name: OnboardResult
                    Selector: $.Payload
                    Type: StringMap
          - RoleName: !Ref SSMAutomationRoleName
            AuditAccountIdPath: !Ref AuditAccountIdPath
            ControlTowerExecutionRoleName: !Ref ControlTowerExecutionRoleName
            SecurityHubRegion: !Ref SecurityHubRegion

  # EventBridge Rule: New account provisioned by Control Tower
  NewAccountProvisionedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn: OnboardNewAccountDocument
    Properties:
      Name: 'SecurityHubNewAccountProvisioned'
      Description: 'Triggered when Control Tower successfully provisions a new account'
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - CreateManagedAccount
          serviceEventDetails:
            createManagedAccountStatus:
              status:
                - SUCCEEDED
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/SecurityHubOnboardNewAccount:$DEFAULT'
          Id: 'OnboardNewAccountTarget'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              accountId: $.detail.serviceEventDetails.createManagedAccountStatus.account.accountId
            InputTemplate: '{"NewAccountId": <accountId>}'

  # EventBridge Rule: Landing zone setup or update completed

          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - SetupLandingZone
            - UpdateLandingZone
          serviceEventDetails:
            message:
              status:
                - SUCCEEDED
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/SecurityHubSetupDelegatedAdmin:$DEFAULT'
          Id: 'SetupDelegatedAdminTarget'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap: {}
            InputTemplate: '{}'

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the IAM role used for SSM automation execution
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by EventBridge to start automations
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
  SetupDelegatedAdminDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM automation document for initial Security Hub setup
    Value: !Ref SetupDelegatedAdminDocument
  OnboardNewAccountDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM automation document for onboarding new accounts

    Value: !GetAtt NewAccountProvisionedRule.Arn
  LandingZoneReadyRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule for landing zone readiness
    Value: !GetAtt LandingZoneReadyRule.Arn
