AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates shared IAM roles, GuardDuty detector, and CloudFormation resource type activations for EKS deployments."

Parameters:
  EnvAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: "dev"
    Description: "Environment alias used as prefix for IAM role names."
  Hash:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional hash suffix appended to role names."
  BastionBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "my-bastion-bucket"
    Description: "Name of the S3 bucket to which the bastion role has GetObject access."
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional ARN of a permissions boundary policy to attach to all roles."
  CreateGuardDutyDetector:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Default: "true"
    Description: "Whether to create a new GuardDuty detector. Set to false if one already exists in the region."

Conditions:
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, ""]]
  ShouldCreateGuardDuty: !Equals [!Ref CreateGuardDutyDetector, "true"]

Resources:
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Condition: ShouldCreateGuardDuty
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-lambda-discovery-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-lambda-caller-identity-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityAndCloudFormationCloudTrail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  EksDescribeNodegroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-eks-describe-nodegroup-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSDescribeNodegroups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-cfn-execution-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BroadEKSCreationPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - s3:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudformation:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-logging-delivery-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationRegistryLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  CodeBuildEksIntegrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-codebuild-eks-integration-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildEksECRIntegration
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:*
                  - s3:*
                  - eks:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  CloudFormationHookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-cfn-hook-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: HookBroadPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - eks:*
                  - s3:*
                  - sts:*
                  - iam:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - ssm:*
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  BastionInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvAlias}-bastion-instance-role${Hash}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BastionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${BastionBucketName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:ListBuilds
                  - codebuild:ListProjects
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource"
      RetentionInDays: 30
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 30
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  EksClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: "cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster"
      RetentionInDays: 30
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

  KubernetesResourceActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:aws:type/resource/AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: !Ref KubernetesResourceLogGroup
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

  KubernetesHelmActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:aws:type/resource/AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: !Ref KubernetesHelmLogGroup
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

  EksClusterActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    Properties:
      PublicTypeArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudformation:${AWS::Region}:aws:type/resource/AWSQS::EKS::Cluster"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: !Ref EksClusterLogGroup
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

Outputs:
  GuardDutyDetectorId:
    Condition: ShouldCreateGuardDuty
    Description: "GuardDuty Detector ID"
    Value: !GetAtt GuardDutyDetector.Id

    Description: "Lambda discovery role ARN"

  LambdaCallerIdentityRoleArn:
    Description: "Lambda caller identity role ARN"

    Description: "CloudFormation execution role ARN"

  LoggingDeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: "Logging delivery role ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn

    Description: "CodeBuild EKS integration role ARN"

    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationHookRole.Arn

    Description: "Bastion instance role ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt BastionInstanceRole.Arn

  FifoQueueNoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-queue-no-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  FifoDLQForFifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-dlq-for-fifo.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  FifoQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-queue-with-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDLQForFifoQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
  StandardDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: standard-dlq
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: standard-queue
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
  SeparateFifoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: separate-fifo-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SeparateFifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: separate-fifo-queue.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-messages-sent-sum
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when sum of messages sent exceeds 1
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
  FifoQueueWithDLQMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-queue-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection on average number of messages sent
      ActionsEnabled: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: AnomalyDetectionBand
          ReturnData: true
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when maximum sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  SeparateFifoQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when maximum sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  StandardDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when visible messages in standard DLQ are greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  SeparateFifoDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when visible messages in separate FIFO DLQ are greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when maximum age of oldest message exceeds 15 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  SeparateFifoQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when maximum age of oldest message exceeds 15 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  StandardQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-messages-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when maximum number of not visible messages exceeds 108000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  SeparateFifoQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: separate-fifo-queue-messages-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when maximum number of not visible messages exceeds 18000
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
  StandardDLQOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when maximum age of oldest message in standard DLQ exceeds 90 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum

Outputs:

  StandardQueueUrl:

    Value: !Ref StandardDLQ
  SeparateFifoDLQUrl:

  SeparateFifoQueueUrl:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for private ROSA cluster networking infrastructure with Transit Gateway and egress VPC"
Parameters:
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "1"
      - "3"
    Default: "3"
    Description: Number of Availability Zones for ROSA private subnets
  RosaVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the ROSA VPC
  RosaPrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.0.0/19"
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 1
  RosaPrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.32.0/19"
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 2 (used only if 3 AZs)
  RosaPrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.1.64.0/19"
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 3 (used only if 3 AZs)
  EgressVpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC
  EgressPublicSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC public subnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC private subnet
  CreateELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Whether to create the AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing service-linked role
  EnableVpcFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Whether to enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs
Conditions:
  IsThreeAZ:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: NumberOfAZs
      - "3"
  CreateFlowLogs:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: EnableVpcFlowLogs
      - "true"
  CreateELBRole:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: CreateELBServiceLinkedRole
      - "true"
Resources:
  RosaVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-VPC
  EgressVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-VPC
  RosaPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - "0"
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-Subnet-1
  RosaPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsThreeAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - "1"
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-Subnet-2
  RosaPrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: IsThreeAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - "2"
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-Subnet-3
  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - "0"
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Public-Subnet
  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - "0"
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Private-Subnet
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-IGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-NAT-EIP
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-NAT-Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Egress-TGW
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Egress-TGW-RT
  RosaVpcTGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
        - !If
          - IsThreeAZ
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - IsThreeAZ
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-VPC-TGW-Attachment
  EgressVpcTGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-VPC-TGW-Attachment
  TGWRouteInternet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressVpcTGWAttachment
  TGWRouteRosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaVpcTGWAttachment
  RosaPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-Private-RT
  RosaPrivateRouteToTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaVpcTGWAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  RosaPrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
  RosaPrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: IsThreeAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
  RosaPrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Condition: IsThreeAZ
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Private-RT
  EgressPrivateRouteToNAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  EgressPrivateRouteToTGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressVpcTGWAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCIDR
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-Public-RT
  EgressPublicRouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Description: "KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs-KMS-Key
  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/vpc-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
  FlowLogsRole:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: VPC-Flow-Logs-Role
  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}"
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status} ${vpc-id} ${subnet-id} ${instance-id} ${tcp-flags} ${type} ${pkt-srcaddr} ${pkt-dstaddr} ${region} ${az-id} ${sublocation-type} ${sublocation-id} ${pkt-src-aws-service} ${pkt-dst-aws-service} ${flow-direction} ${traffic-path}'
      MaxAggregationInterval: 600
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: ROSA-VPC-Flow-Log
  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestination: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${FlowLogsLogGroup}"
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status} ${vpc-id} ${subnet-id} ${instance-id} ${tcp-flags} ${type} ${pkt-srcaddr} ${pkt-dstaddr} ${region} ${az-id} ${sublocation-type} ${sublocation-id} ${pkt-src-aws-service} ${pkt-dst-aws-service} ${flow-direction} ${traffic-path}'
      MaxAggregationInterval: 600
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: Egress-VPC-Flow-Log
  ELBServiceLinkedRole:
    Condition: CreateELBRole
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing
Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: ROSA VPC ID
    Value: !Ref RosaVPC
  RosaPrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: ROSA private subnet IDs (comma-separated)
    Value:
      Fn::If:
        - IsThreeAZ
        - Fn::Join:
            - ","
            - - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
              - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
              - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
        - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
  EgressVpcId:
    Description: Egress VPC ID
    Value: !Ref EgressVPC
  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: Egress VPC public subnet ID
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Egress VPC private subnet ID
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: Internet Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for PCI DSS prerequisite resources and nine SSM Automation documents"
Resources:

      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"

              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"

            Resource: "*"
  PrerequisiteKMSAlias:

      AliasName: "alias/pci-ssm-kms-key"

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "ssm.amazonaws.com"

  CloudTrailLogsRole:

          - Effect: "Allow"

              Service: "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"

      Policies:

            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"

                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"
                  - "logs:CreateLogGroup"
                  - "logs:CreateLogStream"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogGroups"
                  - "logs:DescribeLogStreams"
                Resource: "*"
      RoleName: "pci-cloudtrail-logs-role"
  EncryptCloudTrailWithKMSAndIntegrateCW:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Name: "PCI-EncryptCloudTrailWithKMSAndIntegrateCW"
      Content:

            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",

              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",

                "TrailName": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "Name of the CloudTrail trail"
                },
                "KmsKeyId": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "KMS key ID or ARN"
                },
                "LogGroupArn": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [

                    "Service": "cloudtrail",
                    "Api": "UpdateTrail",
                    "Name": "{{ TrailName }}",
                    "KmsKeyId": "{{ KmsKeyId }}",
                    "CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn": "{{ LogGroupArn }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  EnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document

                    "Api": "EnableKeyRotation",
                    "KeyId": "{{ KeyId }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchLogs:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Name: "PCI-IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchLogs"
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Integrate a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {
                "TrailName": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "Name of the CloudTrail trail"
                },
                "LogGroupArn": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "UpdateTrail",
                  "action": "aws:executeAwsApi",
                  "inputs": {
                    "Service": "cloudtrail",
                    "Api": "UpdateTrail",
                    "Name": "{{ TrailName }}",
                    "CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn": "{{ LogGroupArn }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Name: "PCI-UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy"
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Update the account's IAM password policy to PCI DSS compliant settings",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {},
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "UpdatePasswordPolicy",
                  "action": "aws:executeAwsApi",
                  "inputs": {
                    "Service": "iam",
                    "Api": "UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy",
                    "MinimumPasswordLength": 14,
                    "RequireUppercaseCharacters": true,
                    "RequireLowercaseCharacters": true,
                    "RequireNumbers": true,
                    "RequireSymbols": true,
                    "AllowUsersToChangePassword": true,
                    "HardExpiry": true,
                    "MaxPasswordAge": 90,
                    "PasswordReusePrevention": 24
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  EnableCloudTrailValidationMultiRegionCW:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Name: "PCI-EnableCloudTrailValidationMultiRegionCW"
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Enable log file validation and multi-region for a CloudTrail trail and integrate with CloudWatch Logs",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {
                "TrailName": {

                  "description": "Name of the CloudTrail trail"

                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Name: "PCI-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules"
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Revoke all inbound and outbound rules on a default security group",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {
                "SecurityGroupId": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "ID of the default security group"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "RevokeRules",
                  "action": "aws:executeScript",
                  "inputs": {
                    "Runtime": "python3.12",
                    "InputPayload": {
                      "SecurityGroupId": "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
                    },
                    "Handler": "revoke_rules",
                    "Script": "import boto3\nec2 = boto3.client('ec2')\ndef revoke_rules(events, context):\n    sg_id = events['SecurityGroupId']\n    sg = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[sg_id])['SecurityGroups'][0]\n    for perm in sg['IpPermissions']:\n        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=[perm])\n    for perm in sg['IpPermissionsEgress']:\n        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=sg_id, IpPermissions=[perm])\n    return {'Success': True}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  DeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Name: "PCI-DeleteSecurityGroup"
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |

              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Delete a specified security group",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {
                "SecurityGroupId": {

                    "Api": "DeleteSecurityGroup",
                    "GroupId": "{{ SecurityGroupId }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  ReleaseUnusedElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:

        Fn::Sub:
          - |

              "schemaVersion": "0.3",

              "parameters": {
                "AllocationId": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "Allocation ID of the Elastic IP"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "ReleaseAddress",
                  "action": "aws:executeAwsApi",
                  "inputs": {
                    "Service": "ec2",
                    "Api": "ReleaseAddress",
                    "AllocationId": "{{ AllocationId }}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: "Automation"
      Name: "PCI-RemoveCodeBuildEnvVars"
      Content:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |
            {
              "schemaVersion": "0.3",
              "description": "Update a CodeBuild project to remove environment variables named AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
              "assumeRole": "${RoleArn}",
              "parameters": {
                "ProjectName": {
                  "type": "String",
                  "description": "Name of the CodeBuild project"
                }
              },
              "mainSteps": [
                {
                  "name": "UpdateProject",
                  "action": "aws:executeScript",
                  "inputs": {
                    "Runtime": "python3.12",
                    "InputPayload": {
                      "ProjectName": "{{ ProjectName }}"
                    },
                    "Handler": "remove_env_vars",
                    "Script": "import boto3\nclient = boto3.client('codebuild')\ndef remove_env_vars(events, context):\n    project_name = events['ProjectName']\n    response = client.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name])\n    project = response['projects'][0]\n    env = project.get('environment', {})\n    existing_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])\n    # Remove variables with the specified names\n    filtered_vars = [v for v in existing_vars if v['name'] not in ['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY']]\n    # Update the project with the filtered list\n    client.update_project(\n        name=project_name,\n        environment={\n            'type': env['type'],\n            'image': env['image'],\n            'computeType': env['computeType'],\n            'environmentVariables': filtered_vars\n        }\n    )\n    return {'Success': True}"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for CoWork telemetry monitoring dashboard"
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-desktop/co-work
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group to receive CoWork events
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWorkTelemetryDashboard
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: AWS region where metrics are stored (used for dashboard metric widgets)
Resources:
  CoWorkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30
  MetricFilterInputTokensCamel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.inputTokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.inputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: InputTokens
  MetricFilterInputTokensSnake:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.input_tokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.input_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: InputTokens
  MetricFilterOutputTokensCamel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.outputTokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.outputTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: OutputTokens
  MetricFilterOutputTokensSnake:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.output_tokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.output_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: OutputTokens
  MetricFilterCacheReadCamel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.cacheReadTokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cacheReadTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
  MetricFilterCacheReadSnake:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.cache_read_tokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cache_read_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
  MetricFilterCacheCreationCamel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.cacheCreationTokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cacheCreationTokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
  MetricFilterCacheCreationSnake:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.cache_creation_tokens = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.cache_creation_tokens"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
  MetricFilterEstimatedCostCamel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.estimatedCost = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.estimatedCost"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
  MetricFilterEstimatedCostSnake:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.estimated_cost = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.estimated_cost"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
  MetricFilterSessionTurnCountCamel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.sessionTurnCount = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.sessionTurnCount"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: SessionTurnCount
  MetricFilterSessionTurnCountSnake:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      FilterPattern: "{ $.session_turn_count = * }"
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricValue: "$.session_turn_count"
          DefaultValue: 0
          MetricNamespace: CoWorkTelemetry
          MetricName: SessionTurnCount
  CoWorkDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    DependsOn: CoWorkLogGroup
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody:
        Fn::Sub:
          - |-
            {
              "widgets": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 0,
                  "width": 24,
                  "height": 1,
                  "properties": {
                    "markdown": "# CoWork Telemetry Dashboard"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 1,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "view": "singleValue",
                    "title": "Total Token Usage",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "metrics": [
                      [ { "expression": "SUM(METRICS())", "label": "Total Tokens", "id": "total", "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ],
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "InputTokens", { "id": "in", "visible": false } ],
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "OutputTokens", { "id": "out", "visible": false } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 3600,
                    "stat": "Sum"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 8,
                  "y": 1,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "view": "singleValue",
                    "title": "Total Cost",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "EstimatedCost", { "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 3600,
                    "stat": "Sum"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 16,
                  "y": 1,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "view": "singleValue",
                    "title": "Session Turn Counts",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "SessionTurnCount", { "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 3600,
                    "stat": "Sum"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 7,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "view": "singleValue",
                    "title": "Cache Hit Tokens",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "CacheReadTokens", { "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 3600,
                    "stat": "Sum"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 8,
                  "y": 7,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "view": "timeSeries",
                    "title": "Token Usage Trend",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "InputTokens", { "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ],
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "OutputTokens", { "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 3600,
                    "stat": "Sum"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 16,
                  "y": 7,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "view": "timeSeries",
                    "title": "Cost Trend",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "metrics": [
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "EstimatedCost", { "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 3600,
                    "stat": "Sum"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "metric",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 13,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "view": "singleValue",
                    "title": "Average Cost Per Turn",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "metrics": [
                      [ { "expression": "IF(m1 > 0, m2 / m1, 0)", "label": "Avg Cost/Turn", "id": "avg", "period": 3600, "stat": "Sum" } ],
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "SessionTurnCount", { "id": "m1", "visible": false } ],
                      [ "CoWorkTelemetry", "EstimatedCost", { "id": "m2", "visible": false } ]
                    ],
                    "period": 3600,
                    "stat": "Sum"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "log",
                  "x": 8,
                  "y": 13,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "title": "Per User Token Usage",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | filter ispresent(inputTokens) | stats sum(inputTokens) as totalTokens by userId | sort totalTokens desc | limit 20",
                    "view": "table"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "log",
                  "x": 16,
                  "y": 13,
                  "width": 8,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "title": "Active User Counts",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | stats count_distinct(userId) as activeUsers",
                    "view": "singleValue"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "type": "log",
                  "x": 0,
                  "y": 19,
                  "width": 24,
                  "height": 6,
                  "properties": {
                    "title": "Recent Raw Events",
                    "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                    "query": "SOURCE '${LogGroupName}' | fields @timestamp, @message | sort @timestamp desc | limit 20",
                    "view": "table"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          - LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
            MetricsRegion: !Ref MetricsRegion
Outputs:
  DashboardURL:
    Description: Direct URL to the created CloudWatch dashboard
    Value:
      Fn::Join:
        - ""
        - - "https://"
          - !Ref "AWS::Region"
          - ".console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region="
          - !Ref "AWS::Region"
          - "#dashboards:name="
          - !Ref DashboardName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: cdk
    Description: A short string to uniquely identify bootstrap components in the same account/region.
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: List of AWS account IDs allowed to assume the bootstrap roles. If empty, defaults to the current account.
  ManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: List of IAM managed policy ARNs to attach to the bootstrap roles. If empty, no additional policies are attached.
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "9"
    Description: Version of the CDK bootstrap stack.
  AssetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom name for the asset S3 bucket. If empty, a name will be generated.
  ExistingKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional existing KMS key ID to use for bucket encryption. If empty, a new key is created.
  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: cdk-bootstrap-key
    Description: Alias for the KMS key (used only when no existing key is provided).

Conditions:
  UseExistingKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]]
  UseNewKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, ""]
  UseGeneratedBucketName: !Equals [!Ref AssetBucketName, ""]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  HasManagedPolicyArns: !Not [!Equals [!Join [",", !Ref ManagedPolicyArns], ""]]

Resources:
  # KMS Key (only created when no existing key provided)
  FileAssetsKey:
    Condition: UseNewKmsKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for CDK bootstrap assets (qualifier: ${Qualifier})"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow S3 service to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      MultiRegion: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-bootstrap-key-${Qualifier}"

  FileAssetsKeyAlias:
    Condition: UseNewKmsKey
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${KmsKeyAlias}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsKey

  # Asset S3 Bucket
  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - UseGeneratedBucketName
        - !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
        - !Ref AssetBucketName
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If [UseExistingKmsKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId, !Ref FileAssetsKey]
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-bootstrap-assets-${Qualifier}"

  # Bucket policy to enforce HTTPS-only access
  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                "aws:SecureTransport": false

  # Immutable ECR Repository
  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-bootstrap-ecr-${Qualifier}"

  # IAM Roles
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccounts, !Ref TrustedAccounts, [!Ref AWS::AccountId]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If [HasManagedPolicyArns, !Ref ManagedPolicyArns, []]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role"

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccounts, !Ref TrustedAccounts, [!Ref AWS::AccountId]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If [HasManagedPolicyArns, !Ref ManagedPolicyArns, []]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role"

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccounts, !Ref TrustedAccounts, [!Ref AWS::AccountId]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If [HasManagedPolicyArns, !Ref ManagedPolicyArns, []]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role"

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deployment-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If [HasTrustedAccounts, !Ref TrustedAccounts, [!Ref AWS::AccountId]]
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If [HasManagedPolicyArns, !Ref ManagedPolicyArns, []]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deployment-action-role"

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DependsOn: DeploymentActionRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-deployment-action-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If [HasManagedPolicyArns, !Ref ManagedPolicyArns, []]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role"

  # SSM Parameter for bootstrap version
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap version for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub "cdk-bootstrap-version-${Qualifier}"

Outputs:
  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket for file assets
    Value: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
  FileAssetsBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket for file assets
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
  ContainerAssetsRepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the ECR repository for container assets
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.RepositoryUri
  ContainerAssetsRepositoryArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECR repository for container assets
    Value: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the file publishing role
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the image publishing role
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
  LookupRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the lookup role
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
  DeploymentActionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the deployment action role
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudFormation execution role
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
  BootstrapVersion:
    Description: Version of the bootstrap stack
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
  # Separate outputs for KMS key ID to avoid referencing conditional resource in a single !If
  KmsKeyIdNew:
    Condition: UseNewKmsKey
    Description: KMS key ID (newly created)
    Value: !Ref FileAssetsKey
  KmsKeyIdExisting:
    Condition: UseExistingKmsKey
    Description: KMS key ID (existing)
    Value: !Ref ExistingKmsKeyId
