AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: CloudFormation template for Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment with optional green environment, supporting new or existing applications

Parameters:
  CreateNewApplication:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create a new Elastic Beanstalk application or use an existing one
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application (used when creating new)
  ExistingApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-existing-app
    Description: Name of an existing Elastic Beanstalk application (used when not creating new)
  EnvironmentNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: myapp
    Description: Prefix for environment names (e.g., 'myapp' produces 'myapp-blue' and 'myapp-green')
  SolutionStackKey:
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs18
    AllowedValues:
      - nodejs18
      - nodejs16
      - python311
      - python38
    Description: Simplified key for solution stack (maps to full name and sample app key)
  UseDefaultSampleApp:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to use the default AWS sample application
  CustomSampleAppBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: my-custom-bucket
    Description: S3 bucket for custom sample app (required if UseDefaultSampleApp is false)
  CustomSampleAppKey:
    Type: String
    Default: sample-app.zip
    Description: S3 key for custom sample app (required if UseDefaultSampleApp is false)
  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Whether to also create a green environment
  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - LoadBalanced
      - SingleInstance
    Default: LoadBalanced
    Description: Type of environment

Conditions:
  IsNewApplication: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApplication, 'true']
  IsExistingApplication: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApplication, 'false']
  IsDefaultSampleApp: !Equals [!Ref UseDefaultSampleApp, 'true']
  ShouldCreateGreen: !Equals [!Ref CreateGreenEnvironment, 'true']
  IsLoadBalanced: !Equals [!Ref EnvironmentType, 'LoadBalanced']

Mappings:
  SolutionStackMapping:
    nodejs18:
      FullName: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v4.1.0 running Node.js 18
      SampleKey: nodejs-v18.zip
    nodejs16:
      FullName: 64bit Amazon Linux 2 v5.8.2 running Node.js 16
      SampleKey: nodejs-v16.zip
    python311:
      FullName: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v4.1.0 running Python 3.11
      SampleKey: python-v3.11.zip
    python38:
      FullName: 64bit Amazon Linux 2 v5.8.2 running Python 3.8
      SampleKey: python-v3.8.zip
  RegionToDefaultBucket:
    us-east-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    us-east-2:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    us-west-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    us-west-2:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    eu-west-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    eu-west-2:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    eu-central-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    ap-southeast-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    ap-southeast-2:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    ap-northeast-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    ap-northeast-2:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    ap-south-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps
    sa-east-1:
      BucketName: aws-elasticbeanstalk-sample-apps

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet2'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  EBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkService
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EBResourceCreation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AllocateAddress
                  - ec2:AssociateAddress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DisassociateAddress
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - elasticloadbalancing:*
                  - autoscaling:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'

  EBInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EBServiceRole

  EBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Elastic Beanstalk environment
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  EBApplication:
    Condition: IsNewApplication
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Application created by CloudFormation for Blue-Green deployment

  VersionNewApp:
    Condition: IsNewApplication
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    DependsOn:
      - EBApplication
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - IsDefaultSampleApp
          - !FindInMap [RegionToDefaultBucket, !Ref 'AWS::Region', BucketName]
          - !Ref CustomSampleAppBucket
        S3Key: !If
          - IsDefaultSampleApp
          - !FindInMap [SolutionStackMapping, !Ref SolutionStackKey, SampleKey]
          - !Ref CustomSampleAppKey

  VersionExistingApp:
    Condition: IsExistingApplication
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ExistingApplicationName
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - IsDefaultSampleApp
          - !FindInMap [RegionToDefaultBucket, !Ref 'AWS::Region', BucketName]
          - !Ref CustomSampleAppBucket
        S3Key: !If
          - IsDefaultSampleApp
          - !FindInMap [SolutionStackMapping, !Ref SolutionStackKey, SampleKey]
          - !Ref CustomSampleAppKey

  EBEnvironmentBlue:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - IsNewApplication
        - !Ref ApplicationName
        - !Ref ExistingApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Sub '${EnvironmentNamePrefix}-blue'
      SolutionStackName: !FindInMap [SolutionStackMapping, !Ref SolutionStackKey, FullName]
      VersionLabel: !If
        - IsNewApplication
        - !Ref VersionNewApp
        - !Ref VersionExistingApp
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref EBSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref EBServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
        - !If
          - IsLoadBalanced
          - Namespace: aws:elb:loadbalancer
            OptionName: LoadBalancerHTTPPort
            Value: '80'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  EBEnvironmentGreen:
    Condition: ShouldCreateGreen
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - IsNewApplication
        - !Ref ApplicationName
        - !Ref ExistingApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Sub '${EnvironmentNamePrefix}-green'
      SolutionStackName: !FindInMap [SolutionStackMapping, !Ref SolutionStackKey, FullName]
      VersionLabel: !If
        - IsNewApplication
        - !Ref VersionNewApp
        - !Ref VersionExistingApp
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref EBSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !Ref EBServiceRole
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
        - !If
          - IsLoadBalanced
          - Namespace: aws:elb:loadbalancer
            OptionName: LoadBalancerHTTPPort
            Value: '80'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

Outputs:
  BlueEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint URL for the Blue environment
    Value: !GetAtt EBEnvironmentBlue.EndpointURL
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-BlueEndpoint'
  ApplicationName:
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk Application Name
    Value: !If
      - IsNewApplication
      - !Ref ApplicationName
      - !Ref ExistingApplicationName
  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Description: Blue Environment Name
    Value: !Ref EBEnvironmentBlue
  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Condition: ShouldCreateGreen
    Description: Green Environment Name
    Value: !Ref EBEnvironmentGreen
  GreenEnvironmentEndpoint:
    Condition: ShouldCreateGreen
    Description: Endpoint URL for the Green environment
    Value: !GetAtt EBEnvironmentGreen.EndpointURL
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GreenEndpoint'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: "Provision a dual-stack VPC with public and private subnets, routing, NACLs, placement group, and DHCP options. Environment (staging/production) selects CIDR ranges."
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Description: "Select the environment for which to provision the VPC."
  DeployNATGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Whether to deploy a NAT Gateway for private subnet IPv4 outbound traffic."
  BastionVPNPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1194
    Description: "Port used for bastion VPN (e.g., OpenVPN)."
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: example.local
    Description: "Domain name to assign via DHCP options."
Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: 10.0.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: 10.0.2.0/24
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: 10.0.3.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1CIDR: 10.0.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2CIDR: 10.0.11.0/24
    production:
      VpcCIDR: 10.1.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1CIDR: 10.1.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet2CIDR: 10.1.2.0/24
      PublicSubnet3CIDR: 10.1.3.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1CIDR: 10.1.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2CIDR: 10.1.11.0/24
Conditions:
  CreateNATGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNATGateway, "true"]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-vpc"
  VPCIPv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-igw"
  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-eigw"
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet1"
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet2"
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-subnet3"
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-subnet1"
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIPv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2CIDR]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-private-subnet2"
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${Environment}-public-rt"
  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained serverless movies API with DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway'
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: 'Stage name for API deployment'
Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'Movies-${Environment}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'LambdaExecutionRole-${Environment}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCRUD
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  # CloudWatch Log Groups
  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/CreateMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/ReadMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/UpdateMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/DeleteMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  # Lambda Functions
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'CreateMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  table.put_item(Item=body)
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 201,
                      'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie created'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})
                  }
  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'ReadMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  item = response.get('Item')
                  if not item:
                      return {'statusCode': 404, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Movie not found'})}
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps(item)}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}
  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'UpdateMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  # Assuming body contains title and attributes to update
                  title = body['title']
                  # Remove title from update expression
                  update_expression = "SET " + ", ".join([f"{k}=:{k}" for k in body if k != 'title'])
                  expression_attr_values = {f":{k}": v for k, v in body.items() if k != 'title'}
                  table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression=update_expression,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attr_values
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie updated'})}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}
  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'DeleteMovieFunction-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event['pathParameters']['title']
                  table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Movie deleted'})}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': json.dumps({'error': str(e)})}

  # API Gateway
  MoviesAPI:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MoviesAPI-${Environment}'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesAPI.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
  MovieByTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI

  # POST /Movies
  PostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  # PUT /Movies
  PutMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  # DELETE /Movies
  DeleteMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  # GET /Movies/{title}
  GetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieByTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ReadMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  # CORS preflight (OPTIONS) on /Movies
  OptionsOnMovies:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: false
  # CORS preflight (OPTIONS) on /Movies/{title}
  OptionsOnMovieByTitle:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieByTitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: false
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: false

  # API Deployment and Stage
  MoviesAPIDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostMethod
      - PutMethod
      - DeleteMethod
      - GetMethod
      - OptionsOnMovies
      - OptionsOnMovieByTitle
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
  MoviesAPIStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref Environment
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesAPI
      DeploymentId: !Ref MoviesAPIDeployment

Outputs:
  APIEndpoint:
    Description: 'URL of the Movies API'
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MoviesAPI}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Environment}/Movies'
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: 'Name of the DynamoDB table'
    Value: !Ref MoviesTable

  AppSyncDynamoDBRole:

        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:

          PolicyDocument:

      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: !Ref ApiKeyDescription
  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
          createdAt: AWSDateTime!
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
        }
        input CreateTodoInput {
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }
        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          owner: String
          title: String
          description: String
          completed: Boolean
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          listTodosByOwner(owner: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }
        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }
        type Subscription {
          onTodoCreated: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onTodoUpdated: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onTodoDeleted: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }
        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CreateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util, dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { owner, title, description, completed } = ctx.args.input;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const item = {
            id,
            owner,
            title,
            description: description ?? null,
            completed: completed ?? false,
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now
          };
          return dynamodb.put({ key: { id }, item });
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: UpdateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util, dynamodb } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { id, ...fields } = ctx.args.input;
          const now = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const update = { id, updatedAt: now };
          Object.keys(fields).forEach(key => {
            const value = fields[key];
            if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
              update[key] = value;
            }
          });
          const condition = { id: { eq: id } };
          return dynamodb.update({ key: { id }, update, condition });
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template to create composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover application monitoring."
Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Description: "The name of the existing API Gateway API"
    Default: "my-remittance-api"
  ApiGatewayStage:
    Type: String
    Description: "The stage name for the API Gateway"
    Default: "prod"
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the GetRemittances Lambda function"
    Default: "GetRemittances"
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the CreateRemittance Lambda function"
    Default: "CreateRemittance"
  DbInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Description: "The DB instance identifier for the RDS instance"
    Default: "dbcluster1-instance1"
Resources:
  APIGateway4XXAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "APIGateway4XXAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average 4XX errors > 0 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      MetricName: "4XXError"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: "Stage"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage
  APIGateway5XXAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "APIGateway5XXAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average 5XX errors > 1 over 60 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      MetricName: "5XXError"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: "Stage"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage
  APIGatewayLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "APIGatewayLatencyAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average latency >= 10000ms over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/ApiGateway"
      MetricName: "Latency"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "ApiName"
          Value: !Ref ApiName
        - Name: "Stage"
          Value: !Ref ApiGatewayStage
  LambdaSummedErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "LambdaSummedErrorsAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed errors across both Lambda functions exceed 0 over 60 seconds"
      Metrics:
        - Id: "e1"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
              MetricName: "Errors"
              Dimensions:
                - Name: "FunctionName"
                  Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: "Sum"
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: "e2"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
              MetricName: "Errors"
              Dimensions:
                - Name: "FunctionName"
                  Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: "Sum"
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: "sumErrors"
          Expression: "e1 + e2"
          Label: "SumErrors"
          ReturnData: true
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
  LambdaSummedInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "LambdaSummedInvocationsAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when summed invocations across both Lambda functions exceed 2 over 60 seconds"
      Metrics:
        - Id: "i1"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
              MetricName: "Invocations"
              Dimensions:
                - Name: "FunctionName"
                  Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: "Sum"
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: "i2"
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
              MetricName: "Invocations"
              Dimensions:
                - Name: "FunctionName"
                  Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
            Period: 60
            Stat: "Sum"
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: "sumInvocations"
          Expression: "i1 + i2"
          Label: "SumInvocations"
          ReturnData: true
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
  LambdaDurationGetRemittancesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "LambdaDurationGetRemittancesAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average duration of GetRemittances >= 10000ms over 900 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      MetricName: "Duration"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "missing"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
  LambdaDurationCreateRemittanceAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "LambdaDurationCreateRemittanceAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average duration of CreateRemittance >= 10000ms over 900 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/Lambda"
      MetricName: "Duration"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "missing"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "FunctionName"
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
  RDSCPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSCPUAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average CPU utilization >= 70% over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "CPUUtilization"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSConnectionsAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average database connections >= 100 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "DatabaseConnections"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSDeadlocksAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average deadlocks >= 10 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "Deadlocks"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSNetworkTransmitAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSNetworkTransmitAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average network transmit throughput >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "NetworkTransmitThroughput"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSNetworkReceiveAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSNetworkReceiveAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average network receive throughput >= 10485760 bytes over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "NetworkReceiveThroughput"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSQueriesAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average queries >= 100 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "Queries"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average disk queue depth >= 50 over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "DiskQueueDepth"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSReadLatencyAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average read latency >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "ReadLatency"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  RDSWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDSWriteLatencyAlarm"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when average write latency >= 0.1 seconds over 300 seconds"
      Namespace: "AWS/RDS"
      MetricName: "WriteLatency"
      Statistic: "Average"
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "DBInstanceIdentifier"
          Value: !Ref DbInstanceIdentifier
  CompositeAlarmAPIGatewayHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "API Gateway Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for API Gateway health"
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(${APIGateway4XXAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${APIGateway5XXAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${APIGatewayLatencyAlarm.Arn})"
  CompositeAlarmLambdaHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "Lambda Health"
      AlarmDescription: "Composite alarm for Lambda health (excluding invocations)"
      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(${LambdaSummedErrorsAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${LambdaDurationGetRemittancesAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${LambdaDurationCreateRemittanceAlarm.Arn})"
  CompositeAlarmRDSHealth:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "RDS Health"

      AlarmRule: !Sub "ALARM(${RDSCPUAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSConnectionsAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSDeadlocksAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSNetworkTransmitAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSNetworkReceiveAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSQueriesAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSDiskQueueDepthAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSReadLatencyAlarm.Arn}) OR ALARM(${RDSWriteLatencyAlarm.Arn})"
Outputs:

  ScriptKeyPrefix:

    Default: glue-scripts/

    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation

                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:CreateJob
                  - glue:UpdateJob
                  - glue:DeleteJob
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:ListJobs
                  - glue:CreateTrigger
                  - glue:UpdateTrigger
                  - glue:DeleteTrigger
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:ListTriggers
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:StopTrigger
                  - glue:BatchGetJobs
                  - glue:BatchGetTriggers
                  - glue:GetTags
                  - glue:TagResource
                  - glue:UntagResource
                  - iam:PassRole

              - Effect: Allow

                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:SearchDashboards
                  - quicksight:ListAnalyses
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysis
                  - quicksight:SearchAnalyses

                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet

                  - quicksight:ListIAMPolicyAssignments

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: 2010-09-09
Description: Serverless CRUD API for Kitten service using API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB

Resources:
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  KittenLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: 2012-10-17
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: 2012-10-17
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  KittenLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: KittenFunction
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt KittenLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          KITTEN_TABLE: !Ref KittenTable
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid
          import os
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table_name = os.environ['KITTEN_TABLE']
          table = dynamodb.Table(table_name)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              headers = {
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'
              }
              http_method = event.get('httpMethod', '')
              resource_path = event.get('resource', '')
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters', {}) or {}
              body = {}
              if event.get('body'):
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event['body'])
                  except:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Invalid JSON in request body'})
                      }

              try:
                  if http_method == 'POST' and resource_path == '/kitten':
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing required fields: name and color'})
                          }
                      kitten_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': kitten_id,
                          'name': name,
                          'color': color
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 201,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(item)
                      }

                  elif http_method == 'GET' and resource_path == '/kitten':
                      response = table.scan()
                      items = response.get('Items', [])
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(items)
                      }

                  elif http_method == 'GET' and resource_path == '/kitten/{id}':
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing KittenId'})
                          }
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      item = response.get('Item')
                      if not item:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 404,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                          }
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(item)
                      }

                  elif http_method == 'PUT' and resource_path == '/kitten/{id}':
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing KittenId'})
                          }
                      name = body.get('name')
                      color = body.get('color')
                      if not name or not color:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing required fields: name and color'})
                          }
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      if 'Item' not in response:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 404,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                          }
                      item = {
                          'KittenId': kitten_id,
                          'name': name,
                          'color': color
                      }
                      table.put_item(Item=item)
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps(item)
                      }

                  elif http_method == 'DELETE' and resource_path == '/kitten/{id}':
                      kitten_id = path_params.get('id')
                      if not kitten_id:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 400,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Missing KittenId'})
                          }
                      response = table.get_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      if 'Item' not in response:
                          return {
                              'statusCode': 404,
                              'headers': headers,
                              'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Kitten not found'})
                          }
                      table.delete_item(Key={'KittenId': kitten_id})
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 200,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Kitten deleted'})
                      }

                  else:
                      return {
                          'statusCode': 400,
                          'headers': headers,
                          'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Unsupported operation'})
                      }

              except ClientError as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': headers,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Internal server error'})
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 500,
                      'headers': headers,
                      'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Internal server error'})
                  }

Description: 'CloudFormation template for CAPA bootstrap IAM roles and policies for EKS'

        Version: '2012-10-17'

  NodeRegistrationPolicy:

              - eks:ListFargateProfiles
              - iam:PassRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'General purpose VPC networking foundation with managed NAT gateways, VPC endpoints, and flow logs'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1 in AZ1
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2 in AZ2
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'

  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 in AZ1
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.4.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 in AZ2
    AllowedPattern: '(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}'

  FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Retention period for VPC flow logs in days
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653

  FlowLogsTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ACCEPT
    Description: Traffic type to capture for VPC flow logs
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:

      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Properties:

      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  ElasticIPNat1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  ElasticIPNat2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:

        - Key: Name

        - Key: Name

  PublicRouteTable:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC for KerberosEMRonEKS with Microsoft AD support, NAT Gateways, Flow Logs, KMS, and VPC Endpoints"

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"

    Type: String

    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.64/26"
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet 2"
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.128/26"

  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.192/26"
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet 2"
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "KerberosEMRonEKS"
    Description: "Prefix for resource names and tags"

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1"

  PublicSubnet2:

        - Key: Name

    Properties:

    Properties:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicRT"

  PublicRoute:

    Properties:

      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRT1"

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:

      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NATGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRT2"

    Properties:

      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for VPC flow log encryption"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"

            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow CloudWatch Logs to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt*"
              - "kms:Decrypt*"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias

                  - "logs:PutLogEvents"

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-FlowLogRole"

  FlowLog:

      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup

      TrafficType: ALL

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

  SSMEndpoint:

    Properties:

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template that creates CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for Claude Code application metrics.
Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: The CloudWatch Logs log group containing Claude Code metrics.
Resources:
  QueryTokenAndRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTime-TokenAndRequestRatePerUser
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, user_id, sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as total_tokens, count(*) as request_count
        | filter @timestamp > ago(5m)
        | stats sum(total_tokens) as token_rate, count(request_count) as request_rate by user_id
        | sort request_rate desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCurrentTPMAverage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTime-CurrentTPMAverage
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, tokens_input, tokens_output
        | filter @timestamp > ago(5m)
        | stats avg(tokens_input + tokens_output) as avg_tpm
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCurrentRPMAverage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTime-CurrentRPMAverage
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp
        | filter @timestamp > ago(5m)
        | stats count(*) / 5 as avg_rpm
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: RealTime-RateLimitRisk
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, user_id, request_count
        | filter @timestamp > ago(5m)
        | stats count(*) as request_rate by user_id
        | filter request_rate > 100
        | sort request_rate desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QuerySessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserAnalytics-SessionLevelUsage
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, session_id, user_id, sum(tokens_input + tokens_output) as total_tokens, count(*) as request_count
        | filter @timestamp > ago(1h)
        | stats sum(total_tokens) as tokens, count(request_count) as requests, earliest(@timestamp) as session_start, latest(@timestamp) as session_end by session_id, user_id
        | sort tokens desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserAnalytics-HourlyActivityTimeline
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp
        | filter @timestamp > ago(24h)
        | stats count(*) as request_count by bin(1h)
        | sort bin(1h)
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryErrorDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserAnalytics-ErrorDetection
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, user_id, error
        | filter error is not null
        | stats count(*) as error_count by user_id
        | sort error_count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: UserAnalytics-ThrottlingDetection
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, user_id, throttled
        | filter throttled = 1
        | stats count(*) as throttled_count by user_id
        | sort throttled_count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Cost-CostByUser
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, user_id, cost
        | filter cost is not null
        | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by user_id
        | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Cost-CostByModel
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, model, cost
        | filter cost is not null
        | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by model
        | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCostByOrganization:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Cost-CostByOrganization
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, organization, cost
        | filter organization is not null
        | stats sum(cost) as total_cost by organization
        | sort total_cost desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCostOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Cost-CostOverTime
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, cost
        | filter cost is not null
        | stats sum(cost) as daily_cost by bin(1d)
        | sort bin(1d)
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debug-ModelEfficiency
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, model, tokens_input, tokens_output
        | filter tokens_input is not null
        | stats avg(tokens_input + tokens_output) as avg_tokens_per_request, count(*) as request_count by model
        | sort request_count desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCacheHitMissOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debug-CacheHitMissOverall
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, cache_hit, cache_miss
        | stats sum(cache_hit) as total_hits, sum(cache_miss) as total_misses, (sum(cache_hit) * 100.0 / (sum(cache_hit) + sum(cache_miss))) as hit_rate
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCacheHitMissOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debug-CacheHitMissOverTime
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, cache_hit, cache_miss
        | stats sum(cache_hit) as hits, sum(cache_miss) as misses by bin(1h)
        | sort bin(1h)
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryCacheHitMissBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debug-CacheHitMissBySession
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, session_id, cache_hit, cache_miss
        | stats sum(cache_hit) as hits, sum(cache_miss) as misses by session_id
        | sort hits desc
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debug-PeakUsageWindows
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp
        | filter @timestamp > ago(7d)
        | stats count(*) as request_count by bin(1h)
        | sort request_count desc
        | limit 10
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryDeepDiveSessionLookup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debug-DeepDiveSessionLookup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, session_id, user_id, model, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost, cache_hit, cache_miss, error, throttled
        | filter session_id = 'SESSION_ID_PLACEHOLDER'
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 100
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
  QueryDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: Debug-DailyUsageSummary
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp
        | filter @timestamp > ago(30d)
        | stats count(*) as total_requests, count(distinct user_id) as unique_users, count(distinct session_id) as unique_sessions by bin(1d)
        | sort bin(1d)
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
Outputs:
  QueryDefinitionIds:
    Description: List of QueryDefinition IDs for all created queries.
    Value: !Join
      - ', '
      - - !Ref QueryTokenAndRequestRatePerUser
        - !Ref QueryCurrentTPMAverage
        - !Ref QueryCurrentRPMAverage
        - !Ref QueryRateLimitRisk
        - !Ref QuerySessionLevelUsage
        - !Ref QueryHourlyActivityTimeline
        - !Ref QueryErrorDetection
        - !Ref QueryThrottlingDetection
        - !Ref QueryCostByUser
        - !Ref QueryCostByModel
        - !Ref QueryCostByOrganization
        - !Ref QueryCostOverTime
        - !Ref QueryModelEfficiency
        - !Ref QueryCacheHitMissOverall
        - !Ref QueryCacheHitMissOverTime
        - !Ref QueryCacheHitMissBySession
        - !Ref QueryPeakUsageWindows
        - !Ref QueryDeepDiveSessionLookup
        - !Ref QueryDailyUsageSummary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates an AppSync GraphQL API with DynamoDB data source, IAM auth, and full logging."
Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: SuperCoolAPI
    Description: Name of the AppSync API.
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: Table1
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
  AppSyncLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs
  AppSyncDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${DynamoDBTable.Arn}/index/*"
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLogRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }
        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }
  DataSourceDirect:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSourceDirect
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"
  DataSourceFromArn:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DynamoDBDataSourceFromArn
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Select
          - 1
          - !Split ["/", !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn]
        AwsRegion: !Select
          - 3
          - !Split [":", !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn]
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceDirect.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)
  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DataSourceDirect.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2017-02-28",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)
Outputs:
  GraphQlApiId:
    Description: "AppSync API ID"
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQlApiUrl:
    Description: "AppSync GraphQL endpoint URL"
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Description: "DynamoDB Table ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption

        Version: '2012-10-17'

            Principal:

            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

            Principal:

            Action:

              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs to use key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogsKMSAlias:

          - Effect: Allow

              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKMSKey.Arn
  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:

      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogsTrafficType

    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM roles, policies, and bootstrapper identities for Cluster API Provider for AWS'

    Type: String

              - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups

              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes

              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup

              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags

              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
  ControlPlaneRole:

    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-control-plane-role'
