        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess

            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ElasticLoadBalancingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AutoScalingFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecretsManagerReadWrite
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-controllers-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Fn::If:
              - UseOIDC
              - Effect: Allow
                Principal:
                  Federated: !Ref OIDCProviderArn
                Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    '${OIDCProviderArn}:sub': 'system:serviceaccount:*:*'
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-eks-control-plane-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-control-plane-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-worker-node-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole
  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-controllers-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-bootstrapper-group'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllerPolicy
  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-bootstrapper-user'
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup
Outputs:
  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the control plane IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  WorkerNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the worker node IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the controllers IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control plane IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the control plane instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneInstanceProfile.Arn
  WorkerNodeInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the worker node instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
  ControllersInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the controllers instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersInstanceProfile.Arn
  BootstrapperUserArn:
    Description: ARN of the bootstrapper IAM user
    Value: !GetAtt BootstrapperUser.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience with configurable NAT gateway setup and VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.
  NatGatewayType:
    Type: String
    Default: Single
    AllowedValues:
      - Single
      - HighAvailability
    Description: NAT gateway deployment mode. Single is cost-effective; HighAvailability deploys one NAT per AZ.

Conditions:
  IsSingleNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, Single]
  IsHaNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, HighAvailability]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.103.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'

  # Private Subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'

  # Public Route Table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public Subnet Route Table Associations
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway Resources (Single)
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRouteToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsSingleNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # NAT Gateway Resources (High Availability)
  NatEIPHa1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIPHa2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIPHa3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayHa1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPHa1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-ha-1'

  NatGatewayHa2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPHa2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-ha-2'

  NatGatewayHa3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPHa3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-ha-3'

  PrivateRouteTableHa1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-ha-1'

  PrivateRouteTableHa2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-ha-2'

  PrivateRouteTableHa3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-ha-3'

  PrivateRouteHa1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableHa1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayHa1

  PrivateRouteHa2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableHa2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayHa2

  PrivateRouteHa3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableHa3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayHa3

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociationHa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableHa1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociationHa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableHa2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociationHa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableHa3

  # VPC Flow Logs
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-group'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-id'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1-id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2-id'

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: Public Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3-id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1-id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2-id'

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private Subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3-id'

  NatGatewayId1:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID (Single mode or first HA)
    Value: !If [IsSingleNat, !Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGatewayHa1]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1-id'

  NatGatewayId2:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID (HA mode second)
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayHa2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2-id'

  NatGatewayId3:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID (HA mode third)
    Condition: IsHaNat
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayHa3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-3-id'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Completely isolated private VPC for AI-powered customer support application with VPC endpoints for Bedrock, ECR, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, RDS Data API, Secrets Manager, SSM, KMS, S3, X-Ray, and VPC Flow Logs with customer-managed KMS key encryption. Security groups for Agent Runtime, MCP Runtime, Lambda functions with HTTPS-only egress to interface endpoints and gateway endpoints via prefix lists.
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 in first Availability Zone
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 in second Availability Zone
  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 3 in third Availability Zone
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-support-app
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
    Description: Number of Availability Zones to use (2 or 3). If 2, only subnets 1 and 2 are created.
  DynamoDBPrefixListId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Prefix list ID for DynamoDB in the selected region. If not provided, will be auto-looked up from mapping.
  S3PrefixListId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Prefix list ID for S3 in the selected region. If not provided, will be auto-looked up from mapping.
Mappings:
  PrefixListIds:
    us-east-1:
      DynamoDB: pl-02cd2c6b
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    us-east-2:
      DynamoDB: pl-022a4e27
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    us-west-1:
      DynamoDB: pl-06f5c2c6
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    us-west-2:
      DynamoDB: pl-0382e3f0
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    eu-west-1:
      DynamoDB: pl-02d24e4a
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    eu-west-2:
      DynamoDB: pl-0d09f0c3
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    eu-central-1:
      DynamoDB: pl-0257a467
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    ap-southeast-1:
      DynamoDB: pl-03a39c15
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    ap-southeast-2:
      DynamoDB: pl-0a6377c5
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    ap-northeast-1:
      DynamoDB: pl-0b5f1e5d
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    ap-northeast-2:
      DynamoDB: pl-0d1e1b13
      S3: pl-63a5400a
    sa-east-1:
      DynamoDB: pl-0f75f12b
      S3: pl-63a5400a
Conditions:
  HasThirdAZ:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: NumberOfAZs
      - 3
  DynamoDBPrefixListIdProvided:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: DynamoDBPrefixListId
          - ''
  S3PrefixListIdProvided:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - Ref: S3PrefixListId
          - ''
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-vpc
  FlowLogsKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                Fn::Sub: logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
  FlowLogsKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName:
        Fn::Sub: alias/${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs-key
      TargetKeyId:
        Ref: FlowLogsKMSKey
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName:
        Fn::Sub: /aws/vpc/flow-logs/${EnvironmentName}
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - FlowLogsKMSKey
          - Arn
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt*
                  - kms:Decrypt*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource:
                  Fn::GetAtt:
                    - FlowLogsKMSKey
                    - Arn
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasThirdAZ
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-private-rt
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasThirdAZ
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable
  InterfaceEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-interface-endpoint-sg
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Agent Runtime component
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-agent-runtime-sg
  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for MCP Runtime component
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-mcp-runtime-sg
  LambdaFunctionSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Lambda functions
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: ${EnvironmentName}-lambda-sg
  BedrockEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      ServiceName:
        Fn::Sub: com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        Fn::If:
          - HasThirdAZ
          - - Ref: PrivateSubnet1
            - Ref: PrivateSubnet2
            - Ref: PrivateSubnet3
          - - Ref: PrivateSubnet1
            - Ref: PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - Ref: InterfaceEndpointSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with public and private subnets across 3 AZs for EKS, with NAT gateways, route tables, security groups, and outputs."

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/16"
    Description: "CIDR block for the VPC"
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: "EKS-VPC"
    Description: "Prefix for resource names and tags"
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ1"
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.2.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ2"
  PublicSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.3.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for public subnet in AZ3"
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.4.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ1"
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.5.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ2"
  PrivateSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.6.0/24"
    Description: "CIDR for private subnet in AZ3"
  CustomIngressPort1:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8443
    Description: "First custom TCP port for ingress/service mesh gateway"
  CustomIngressPort2:
    Type: Number
    Default: 15021
    Description: "Second custom TCP port for ingress/service mesh gateway"
  CustomIngressPort3:
    Type: Number
    Default: 15020
    Description: "Third custom TCP port for ingress/service mesh gateway"

Conditions: {}

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-VPC"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-IGW"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Public-Subnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Public-Subnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Public-Subnet-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  # Private subnets
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Private-Subnet-1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Private-Subnet-2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Private-Subnet-3"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  # Public route table
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Public-Route-Table"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Elastic IPs for NAT Gateways
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  # NAT Gateways in each public subnet
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-NAT-GW-1"

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-NAT-GW-2"

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-NAT-GW-3"

  # Private route tables (one per AZ)
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Private-Route-Table-1"

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Private-Route-Table-2"

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-Private-Route-Table-3"

  # Private routes to NAT Gateways
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: "0.0.0.0/0"
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  # Private subnet route table associations
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # Security groups (created without circular dependencies; ingress rules added separately)
  EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for EKS control plane"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-EKS-ControlPlane-SG"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"

  WorkerNodeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for EKS worker nodes"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-WorkerNodes-SG"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"

  # Ingress rules to avoid circular dependency
  EKSControlPlaneIngressFromWorkerNodes:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WorkerNodeSecurityGroup
      Description: "Allow HTTPS from worker nodes"

  EKSControlPlaneIngressFromWorkerNodesKubelet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 10250
      ToPort: 10250
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WorkerNodeSecurityGroup
      Description: "Allow kubelet from worker nodes"

  WorkerNodeIngressFromControlPlane:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref WorkerNodeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      Description: "Allow HTTPS from control plane"

  WorkerNodeIngressFromControlPlaneKubelet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref WorkerNodeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 10250
      ToPort: 10250
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      Description: "Allow kubelet from control plane"

  WorkerNodeIngressSSH:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref WorkerNodeSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 22
      ToPort: 22
      CidrIp: "10.0.0.0/8"
      Description: "Allow SSH from VPC (optional)"

  # Application ingress security group
  ApplicationIngressSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for application ingress (HTTP, HTTPS, custom ports)"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-App-Ingress-SG"
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
          Description: "HTTP from internet"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
          Description: "HTTPS from internet"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref CustomIngressPort1
          ToPort: !Ref CustomIngressPort1
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
          Description: !Sub "Custom port ${CustomIngressPort1} from internet"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref CustomIngressPort2
          ToPort: !Ref CustomIngressPort2
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
          Description: !Sub "Custom port ${CustomIngressPort2} from internet"
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref CustomIngressPort3
          ToPort: !Ref CustomIngressPort3
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"
          Description: !Sub "Custom port ${CustomIngressPort3} from internet"
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: "-1"
          CidrIp: "0.0.0.0/0"

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"

  EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID for EKS Control Plane"
    Value: !Ref EKSControlPlaneSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EKSControlPlaneSGId"

  WorkerNodeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID for Worker Nodes"
    Value: !Ref WorkerNodeSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WorkerNodeSGId"

  ApplicationIngressSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Security Group ID for Application Ingress"
    Value: !Ref ApplicationIngressSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AppIngressSGId"

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of public subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds"

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: "List of private subnet IDs"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template for SageMaker HyperPod execution role with EKS integration.
Parameters:
  Prefix:
    Type: String
    Default: MySageMaker
    Description: Resource name prefix (appended with 'ExecRole' for role name).
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyEKSCluster
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster for eks-auth actions.
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: vpc-12345678
    Description: VPC ID for ENI management scoping.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: sg-12345678,sg-87654321
    Description: List of security group IDs for ENI management scoping.
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: subnet-12345678,subnet-87654321
    Description: List of private subnet IDs for ENI management scoping.
  LifecycleScriptBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: my-lifecycle-bucket
    Description: S3 bucket name for lifecycle scripts.
  RigInputBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for RIG input.
  RigOutputBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket name for RIG output.
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Flag to create RIG resources.
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Flag to enable gated access.

Conditions:
  CreateRigResourcesCondition:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref CreateRigResources
      - 'true'
  EnableGatedAccessCondition:
    Fn::Equals:
      - !Ref EnableGatedAccess
      - 'true'
  HasRigInputBucketCondition:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref RigInputBucket
          - ''
  HasRigOutputBucketCondition:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref RigOutputBucket
          - ''
  HasVpcId:
    Fn::Not:
      - Fn::Equals:
          - !Ref VpcId
          - ''
  HasSubnetsAndSgs:
    Fn::And:
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - !Join [',', !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]
              - ''
      - Fn::Not:
          - Fn::Equals:
              - !Join [',', !Ref SecurityGroupIds]
              - ''

Resources:
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Prefix}ExecRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCniPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: EniManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Fn::If:
                  - HasVpcId
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                      - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                      - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                      - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                      - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                    Resource: arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*
                    Condition:
                      StringEquals:
                        ec2:Vpc: !Ref VpcId
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                      - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                      - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                      - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                      - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                    Resource: arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptBucket}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${LifecycleScriptBucket}/*'
        - Fn::If:
            - HasSubnetsAndSgs
            - PolicyName: SubnetAndSgScopedPolicy
              PolicyDocument:
                Version: '2012-10-17'
                Statement:
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                      - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                      - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                      - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                      - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                    Resource: arn:aws:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*
                    Condition:
                      StringEquals:
                        ec2:Vpc: !Ref VpcId
                        ec2:Subnet: !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
                        ec2:SecurityGroup: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
            - Ref: AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${Prefix}ExecRole'

  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRigResourcesCondition
    Properties:
      PolicyName: RigPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Fn::If:
              - HasRigInputBucketCondition
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigInputBucket}/*'
              - Ref: AWS::NoValue
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
          - Fn::If:
              - EnableGatedAccessCondition
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::SageMaker*'
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::sagemaker*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*'
              - Ref: AWS::NoValue
          - Fn::If:
              - EnableGatedAccessCondition
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:PurgeQueue
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'
              - Ref: AWS::NoValue
          - Fn::If:
              - HasRigOutputBucketCondition
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigOutputBucket}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${RigOutputBucket}/*'
              - Ref: AWS::NoValue

Outputs:
  RoleName:
    Description: Name of the created execution role.
    Value: !Sub '${Prefix}ExecRole'
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the created execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for three private subnets with NAT routes, S3 VPC endpoint, and exports. Requires VPC ID, NAT Gateway IDs, and Network ACL ID as parameters. Resources are created only when all required parameters are provided."
Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the VPC where subnets will be created.
  NatGatewayId1:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for the first availability zone (us-east-1a).
  NatGatewayId2:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for the second availability zone (us-east-1b).
  NatGatewayId3:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for the third availability zone (us-east-1c).
  NetworkAclId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ID of the Network ACL to associate with all subnets.
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1a
    AllowedValues:
      - us-east-1a
      - us-east-1b
      - us-east-1c
    Description: Availability zone for the first subnet.
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1b
    AllowedValues:
      - us-east-1a
      - us-east-1b
      - us-east-1c
    Description: Availability zone for the second subnet.
  AvailabilityZone3:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1c
    AllowedValues:
      - us-east-1a
      - us-east-1b
      - us-east-1c
    Description: Availability zone for the third subnet.
Conditions:
  HasVpcId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, ""]]
  HasNat1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayId1, ""]]
  HasNat2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayId2, ""]]
  HasNat3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayId3, ""]]
  HasAcl: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NetworkAclId, ""]]
  CreateAll: !And
    - !Condition HasVpcId
    - !Condition HasNat1
    - !Condition HasNat2
    - !Condition HasNat3
    - !Condition HasAcl
Resources:
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.24.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1a"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.25.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1b"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.26.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1c"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1a"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1b"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1c"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayId1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayId2
  PrivateRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayId3
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  SubnetRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId
  SubnetNetworkAclAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId
  S3VPCEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateAll
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-s3-gateway-endpoint"
        - Key: Stack
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
Outputs:
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Condition: CreateAll
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-subnetIds"
  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Condition: CreateAll
    Description: Comma-separated list of private route table IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateRouteTable1, !Ref PrivateRouteTable2, !Ref PrivateRouteTable3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-routeTableIds"
  SubnetGroupCidr:
    Condition: CreateAll
    Description: CIDR block covering all private subnets
    Value: "10.24.24.0/21"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-cidr"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "VPC with three tiers (web, app, db) across three Availability Zones, with Internet Gateway for web tier and NAT Gateways for app and db tiers."
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: "Production"
    Description: "Environment name used for resource tagging"
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VPC"
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-IGW"
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-WebSubnet1"
  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-WebSubnet2"
  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.32.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-WebSubnet3"
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.64.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-AppSubnet1"
  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.80.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-AppSubnet2"
  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.96.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-AppSubnet3"
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.128.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-DbSubnet1"
  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.144.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-DbSubnet2"
  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.160.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-DbSubnet3"
  EIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP1"
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP2"
  EIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-EIP3"
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW1"
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW2"
  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt EIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-NAT-GW3"
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Web-RT"
  WebRouteToIGW:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  WebSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
  WebSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
  WebSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-App-RT1"
  AppRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  AppSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-App-RT2"
  AppRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  AppSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-App-RT3"
  AppRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3
  AppSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
  DbRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Db-RT1"
  DbRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  DbSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1
  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Db-RT2"
  DbRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  DbSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
  DbRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-Db-RT3"
  DbRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3
  DbSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable3
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: "VPC ID"
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of Availability Zones used"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Select [0, !GetAZs ""], !Select [1, !GetAZs ""], !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]]]
  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of web subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref WebSubnet1, !Ref WebSubnet2, !Ref WebSubnet3]]
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of application subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: "Comma-separated list of database subnet IDs"
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for Amazon EKS Quick Start stacks"
Parameters:
  StackName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    Description: "Base name used for resource naming and SSM path"
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackName}-lambda-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "EksQuickstartLambdaOperations"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3CopyZipArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CreateVpcRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DeleteBucketContents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CleanUpLoadBalancers
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CleanUpSecurityGroupDependencies
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CleanUpLambdaFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListEventSourceMappings
                  - lambda:DeleteEventSourceMapping
                  - lambda:ListTags
                  - lambda:TagResource
                  - lambda:UntagResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ResolveCallerArn
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: RegisterCustomResourceTypes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ManageNodeSecurityGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroupRules
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CreateFargateProfiles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateFargateProfile
                  - eks:DescribeFargateProfile
                  - eks:DeleteFargateProfile
                  - eks:ListFargateProfiles
                  - eks:TagResource
                  - eks:UntagResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ResolveSsmParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CloudFormationStackOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: EksClusterOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:CreateCluster
                  - eks:DeleteCluster
                  - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
                  - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
                  - eks:TagResource
                  - eks:UntagResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: EksNodegroupOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:CreateNodegroup
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:DeleteNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:TagResource
                  - eks:UntagResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: Ec2DescribeForEks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeKeyPairs
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: IamPassRoleForEks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - eks.amazonaws.com
                      - ec2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: AutoscalingOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
                  - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
                  - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
                  - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
                  - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
                  - autoscaling:AttachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
                  - autoscaling:DetachLoadBalancerTargetGroups
                  - autoscaling:EnterStandby
                  - autoscaling:ExitStandby
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - logs:DeleteLogStream
                Resource: "*"
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackName}-control-plane-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSServicePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "EksQuickstartControlPlaneAdditional"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: DescribeEc2AccountAttributes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeEc2Addresses
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeInternetGateways
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                Resource: "*"
  FargateExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackName}-fargate-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "EksQuickstartFargateAdditional"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:ListImages
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsForFargate
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackName}-managed-node-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "EksQuickstartNodeAdditional"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalCloudFormation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeEc2ForNode
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SsmForNode
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: "*"
  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${StackName}-managed-node-instance-profile"
      Path: "/"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole
  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackName}-unmanaged-node-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "EksQuickstartUnmanagedNodeAdditional"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: SignalCloudFormation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: DescribeEc2ForNode
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SsmForNode
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: "*"
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${StackName}-unmanaged-node-instance-profile"
      Path: "/"
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole
  RoleCreationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${StackName}-role-creation-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "EksQuickstartRoleCreation"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateKubernetesVpcRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC"
              - Sid: AttachPoliciesToKubernetesVpcRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC"
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
              - Sid: PassRoleForLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: lambda.amazonaws.com
  LambdaExecutionRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/lambda-execution-role-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the Lambda execution role for EKS Quick Start operations"
  ControlPlaneRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/control-plane-role-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the EKS control plane role"
  FargateExecutionRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/fargate-execution-role-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the Fargate execution role"
  ManagedNodeRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/managed-node-role-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the managed node role"
  ManagedNodeInstanceProfileArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/managed-node-instance-profile-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the managed node instance profile"
  UnmanagedNodeRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/unmanaged-node-role-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the unmanaged node role"
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfileArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/unmanaged-node-instance-profile-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the unmanaged node instance profile"
  RoleCreationRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/quickstart/amazon-eks/role-creation-role-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt RoleCreationRole.Arn
      Description: "ARN of the role creation role"
Outputs:

    Description: "ARN of the Lambda execution role for EKS Quick Start operations"

  ControlPlaneRoleArn:

  FargateExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Fargate execution role"
    Value: !GetAtt FargateExecutionRole.Arn

  ManagedNodeRoleArn:

    Export:
