  ManagedNodeInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: "ARN of the managed node instance profile"
    Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ManagedNodeInstanceProfileArn"
  UnmanagedNodeRoleArn:
    Description: "ARN of the unmanaged node role"
    Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeRole.Arn
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: "Lab VPC with web and app subnets, S3 gateway endpoint, Kinesis interface endpoints, and web security group."
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.0.0/16'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  WebSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for web subnet 1
  WebSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for web subnet 2
  AppSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for app subnet 1
  AppSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.4.0/24'
    Description: CIDR block for app subnet 2
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabVPC
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet1
  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSubnet2
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AppSubnet2
  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: LabRouteTable
  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for web tier allowing HTTPS from VPC CIDR"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: WebSecurityGroup
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: '*'
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTable
  KinesisFirehoseEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
  KinesisStreamsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: Web Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet1Id"
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: Web Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet2Id"
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: App Subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet1Id"
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: App Subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet2Id"
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Web Security Group ID
    Value: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WebSecurityGroupId"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles for EKS cluster deployments using custom resource Lambda handlers

Parameters:
  CommonNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for all IAM role and resource names (max 20 characters)
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MaxLength: 20
    Default: eks-shared
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores, max 20 characters.
  UniqueSuffix:
    Type: String
    Description: A unique suffix (e.g., environment name or random string) to avoid naming conflicts
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 10
    Default: dev

Resources:
  S3CopyLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-s3-copy-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: s3-copy-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  AwsReaderLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-reader-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: aws-reader-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - s3:List*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                  - lambda:Get*
                  - lambda:List*
                  - ssm:Get*
                  - ssm:List*
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  VpcRoleCreatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-vpcrole-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-role-creator-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  S3EmptyLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-s3empty-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: s3-empty-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  LoadBalancerCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-lbclean-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lb-cleanup-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  LambdaCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-lambdaclean-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-cleanup-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  CallerIdentityLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-callerid-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  ResourceProviderRegistrationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-rpre-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: rp-registration-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:CreateResource
                  - cloudformation:UpdateResource
                  - cloudformation:DeleteResource
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  SsmParameterResolverLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-ssmres-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ssm-resolver-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  CfVpcRoleCreatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-cfvpc-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cf-vpc-role-creator-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource: '*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  EksControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-ekscontrol-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy

  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-fargate-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy

  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-mngnode-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cloudformation-signal-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-mngnode-${UniqueSuffix}
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-umnode-${UniqueSuffix}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonElasticFileSystemReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cloudformation-signal-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:SignalResource
                Resource: '*'

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub ${CommonNamePrefix}-umnode-${UniqueSuffix}
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

Outputs:
  S3CopyLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 Copy Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt S3CopyLambdaRole.Arn
  AwsReaderLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the AWS Resource Reader Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt AwsReaderLambdaRole.Arn
  VpcRoleCreatorLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the VPC IAM Role Creator Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt VpcRoleCreatorLambdaRole.Arn
  S3EmptyLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the S3 Bucket Empty Lambda execution role

  LoadBalancerCleanupLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Load Balancer Cleanup Lambda execution role

  LambdaCleanupLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Cleanup Lambda execution role

  CallerIdentityLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Caller Identity Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt CallerIdentityLambdaRole.Arn
  ResourceProviderRegistrationLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Resource Provider Registration Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ResourceProviderRegistrationLambdaRole.Arn
  SsmParameterResolverLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM Parameter Resolver Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SsmParameterResolverLambdaRole.Arn
  CfVpcRoleCreatorLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudFormation VPC Role Creator Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt CfVpcRoleCreatorLambdaRole.Arn
  EksControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS Control Plane role
    Value: !GetAtt EksControlPlaneRole.Arn

    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - PolicyName: SecretReader
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource:
                  Ref: MinesweeperSecret
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
  SecretResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - LambdaExecutionRole
          - Arn
      Runtime: python3.14
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return
                  secret_arn = event['ResourceProperties']['SecretArn']
                  client = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                  response = client.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret_arn)
                  secret = json.loads(response['SecretString'])
                  username = secret['username']
                  password = secret['password']
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {

                      'Password': password

Description: "Creates an IAM user and group for SES SMTP email sending with automatic SMTP credential conversion and storage in Systems Manager Parameter Store"

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: "The desired IAM username for the SES SMTP user"
  AccessKeyRotationVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: "Version number for access key rotation (increment to rotate)"
  LambdaLogRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: "Retention period in days for Lambda execution logs"
  KMSKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key for encrypting SSM parameters (leave empty for AWS-managed key)"

Conditions:
  UseCustomKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KMSKeyArn, ""]]

Resources:
  SESSendingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "${IAMUsername}-Group"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SESSendPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: "*"

  SMTPUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IAMUsername

  UserToGroupAddition:
    Type: AWS::IAM::UserToGroupAddition
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Ref SESSendingGroup
      Users:
        - !Ref SMTPUser

  SMTPAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SMTPUser
      Status: Active

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaBasePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${IAMUsername}-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn

  LambdaKMSAccessPolicy:
    Condition: UseCustomKmsKey
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LambdaKMSAccessPolicy
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: !Ref KMSKeyArn

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/SMTPPasswordConverter-${IAMUsername}"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LambdaLogRetentionPeriod

  SMTPPasswordConverter:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "SMTPPasswordConverter-${IAMUsername}"
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          IAM_USERNAME: !Ref IAMUsername
          KMS_KEY_ARN: !Ref KMSKeyArn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, hashlib, hmac, base64, datetime, json, urllib.request
          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          def send(event, context, status, data, phys=None):
              body = {'Status': status, 'Reason': 'See logs', 'PhysicalResourceId': phys or context.log_stream_name,
                      'StackId': event['StackId'], 'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                      'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'], 'Data': data}
              req = urllib.request.Request(event['ResponseURL'], json.dumps(body).encode(), method='PUT', headers={'Content-Type': ''})
              urllib.request.urlopen(req)
          def calc_pwd(sak, region, ymd):
              k = hmac.new(('AWS4'+sak).encode(), ymd.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              k = hmac.new(k, region.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
              k = hmac.new(k, b'ses', hashlib.sha256).digest()
              k = hmac.new(k, b'aws4_request', hashlib.sha256).digest()
              return base64.b64encode(k).decode()
          def put_param(name, val, key_arn):
              kwargs = {'Name': name, 'Value': val, 'Type': 'SecureString', 'Overwrite': True}
              if key_arn and key_arn.strip(): kwargs['KeyId'] = key_arn.strip()
              ssm.put_parameter(**kwargs)
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              phys = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'SMTPCreds')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create','Update'):
                      akid = props['AccessKeyId']; sak = props['SecretAccessKey']; r = props['Region']
                      u = props['Username']; ka = props.get('KMSKeyArn','')
                      today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%d')
                      pwd = calc_pwd(sak, r, today)
                      put_param(f"/{u}/SMTPUsername", akid, ka)
                      put_param(f"/{u}/SMTPPassword", pwd, ka)
                      send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {'SMTPUsernameParameter': f"/{u}/SMTPUsername", 'SMTPPasswordParameter': f"/{u}/SMTPPassword", 'SMTPUsername': akid}, phys)
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      u = props.get('Username','SMTPUser')
                      for p in [f"/{u}/SMTPUsername", f"/{u}/SMTPPassword"]:
                          try: ssm.delete_parameter(Name=p)
                          except: pass
                      send(event, context, 'SUCCESS', {}, phys)
              except Exception as e:
                  send(event, context, 'FAILED', {'Error': str(e)}, phys)

  SMTPPasswordCustomResource:
    Type: Custom::SMTPPasswordCustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SMTPPasswordConverter.Arn
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SMTPAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SMTPAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region
      Username: !Ref IAMUsername
      Version: !Ref AccessKeyRotationVersion
      KMSKeyArn: !Ref KMSKeyArn

Outputs:
  SMTPUsernameParameter:
    Description: "SSM Parameter name containing SMTP username"
    Value: !Sub "/${IAMUsername}/SMTPUsername"
  SMTPPasswordParameter:
    Description: "SSM Parameter name containing SMTP password"
    Value: !Sub "/${IAMUsername}/SMTPPassword"
  IAMUser:
    Description: "IAM user created for SES SMTP"
    Value: !Ref SMTPUser
  IAMAccessKeyId:
    Description: "IAM access key ID (for reference)"

              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowExecutionRoleDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
          - !If
            - HasRelatedFunctions
            - Sid: AllowRelatedFunctionsDecrypt
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Split [',', !Ref RelatedFunctionArns]
              Action:
                - kms:Decrypt
                - kms:DescribeKey
                - kms:GenerateDataKey
              Resource: '*'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  LambdaKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${LambdaFunctionName}-env-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaKmsKey
  ApiGatewayLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for API Gateway CloudWatch Logs encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowApiGatewayRoleToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogsRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
  ApiGatewayLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${StageName}-apigw-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ApiGatewayLogsKmsKey
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBConnectionAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsDynamoDBTable.Arn
  LambdaKmsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LambdaKMSDecrypt
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: !GetAtt LambdaKmsKey.Arn
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - LambdaKmsPolicy
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaKmsKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
          API_ENDPOINT: !Sub https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          import os
          from datetime import datetime
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route_key = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('routeKey')
              connection_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('connectionId')
              domain_name = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('domainName')
              stage = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('stage')
              api_id = event.get('requestContext', {}).get('apiId')

              try:
                  if route_key == '$connect':
                      table.put_item(Item={
                          'connectionId': connection_id,
                          'connectedAt': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                          'ttl': int(datetime.utcnow().timestamp()) + 86400
                      })
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}

                  elif route_key == '$disconnect':
                      table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}

                  elif route_key == 'message':
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}'))
                      response = {
                          'connectionId': connection_id,
                          'status': 'received',
                          'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
                      }
                      endpoint = f"https://{domain_name}/{stage}"
                      client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=endpoint)
                      try:
                          client.post_to_connection(
                              ConnectionId=connection_id,
                              Data=json.dumps(response).encode('utf-8')
                          )
                      except ClientError as e:
                          if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'GoneException':
                              table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
                      return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps(response)}

                  else:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Unknown route'}

              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': f'Error: {str(e)}'}
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: GrantStatusWebSocketAPI
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action
  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${ConnectIntegration}
  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DefaultIntegration}
  MessageRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: message
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub integrations/${MessageIntegration}
  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      ConnectionType: INTERNET
  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      ConnectionType: INTERNET
  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      ConnectionType: INTERNET
  MessageIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      ConnectionType: INTERNET
  ConnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$connect
  DisconnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$disconnect
  DefaultPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/$default
  MessagePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/message
  WebSocketDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - MessageRoute
      - ConnectIntegration
      - DisconnectIntegration
      - DefaultIntegration
      - MessageIntegration
      - ConnectPermission
      - DisconnectPermission
      - DefaultPermission
      - MessagePermission
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      Description: Deployment for grant status WebSocket API
  WebSocketApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebSocketDeployment
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
        LoggingLevel: INFO
        DataTraceEnabled: true
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
      RouteSettings:
        "$connect":
          DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
        "$disconnect":
          DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
        "$default":
          DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
        "message":
          DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 1000
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogGroup.Arn
        Format: "$context.identity.sourceIp $context.requestTime $context.httpMethod $context.routeKey $context.protocol $context.responseLatency $context.requestId $context.integrationErrorMessage"
  ApiGatewayLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
  ApiGatewayLogsKmsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: ApiGatewayLogsKMSDecrypt
      Roles:
        - !Ref ApiGatewayLogsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogsKmsKey.Arn
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayLogsKmsPolicy
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogsRole.Arn
  ApiGatewayLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub API-Gateway-Execution-Logs_${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogsKmsKey.Arn
Outputs:
  WebSocketConnectionURL:
    Description: WebSocket API connection URL (wss)
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
  WebSocketApiEndpoint:
    Description: WebSocket API HTTPS endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
  WebSocketApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the WebSocket API
    Value: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates IAM Identity Center permission sets for centralized administrative access control."
Parameters:
  InstanceArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "The ARN of the IAM Identity Center instance. If provided, permission sets are created."
  DefaultSessionDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: "PT12H"
    Description: "Session duration in ISO-8601 format (e.g., PT12H for 12 hours)."
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: "IdentityCenter"
    Description: "Prefix for the permission set names."
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "production"
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
    Description: "Deployment environment tag value."
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "createdby"
    Description: "Custom tag key."
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "aws-cloudformation-templates"
    Description: "Custom tag value."
Conditions:
  CreatePermissionSets:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref InstanceArn, ""]]
Resources:
  AdministratorPermissionSet:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Properties:
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}Administrator"
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue
  PowerUserPermissionSet:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Properties:
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}PowerUser"
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/PowerUserAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue
  OrganizationsFullPermissionSet:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Properties:
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}OrganizationsFull"
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSOrganizationsFullAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue
  ReadOnlyPermissionSet:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Type: AWS::SSO::PermissionSet
    Properties:
      InstanceArn: !Ref InstanceArn
      Name: !Sub "${LogicalName}ReadOnly"
      SessionDuration: !Ref DefaultSessionDuration
      ManagedPolicies:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
      Tags:
        - Key: "Environment"
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: !Ref TagKey
          Value: !Ref TagValue
Outputs:
  AdministratorPermissionSetArn:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Value: !GetAtt AdministratorPermissionSet.PermissionSetArn
    Description: "ARN of the Administrator permission set."
  PowerUserPermissionSetArn:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Value: !GetAtt PowerUserPermissionSet.PermissionSetArn
    Description: "ARN of the PowerUser permission set."
  OrganizationsFullPermissionSetArn:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Value: !GetAtt OrganizationsFullPermissionSet.PermissionSetArn
    Description: "ARN of the OrganizationsFull permission set."
  ReadOnlyPermissionSetArn:
    Condition: CreatePermissionSets
    Value: !GetAtt ReadOnlyPermissionSet.PermissionSetArn
    Description: "ARN of the ReadOnly permission set."

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for serverless webhook handler integrating Stripe, Squarespace, and SNS for Slack notifications. IMPORTANT: Provide values for StripeWebhookSigningSecret and SquarespaceApiToken; default placeholders will cause runtime errors if not overridden."

Parameters:
  StripeWebhookSigningSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: "The signing secret from Stripe used to verify webhook events. Must be provided before production use."
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: "REQUIRED"
    Description: "The API token for the Squarespace Commerce store. Must be provided before production use."

Resources:
  SlackNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: "SlackNotificationTopic"
      DisplayName: "Slack Notifications"

  WebhookLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: "WebhookLambdaRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "WebhookLambdaPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SlackNotificationTopic

  WebhookLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: "StripeSquarespaceWebhookHandler"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              stripe_secret = os.environ['STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET']
              squarespace_token = os.environ['SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN']
              # Placeholder validation; production code must verify signature
              if stripe_secret == "REQUIRED" or squarespace_token == "REQUIRED":
                  raise ValueError("Secrets not configured. Update stack parameters.")
              body = json.loads(event['body'])
              sns = boto3.client('sns')
              message = f"New order from {body.get('data', {}).get('object', {}).get('customer', 'unknown')}"
              sns.publish(
                  TopicArn=os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN'],
                  Message=json.dumps({'text': message})
              )
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps('Webhook processed')
              }
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecret
          SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SlackNotificationTopic
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128

  WebhookLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${WebhookLambdaFunction}"
      RetentionInDays: 7

  WebhookApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: "StripeSquarespaceWebhookApi"
      Description: "REST API for Stripe webhook endpoint"

  ApiGatewayInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref WebhookLambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebhookApi}/prod/POST/webhooks"

  WebhookResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt WebhookApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks

  WebhookPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhookResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub "arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations"
        RequestParameters: {}
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 500

  WebhookDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - WebhookPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      StageName: prod
      StageDescription:
        Description: "Production stage for Stripe webhook"

  WebhookLambdaErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: "WebhookLambdaErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Trigger when Lambda invocation errors exceed 0 in a 1-minute period"
      MetricName: Errors
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref WebhookLambdaFunction
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref SlackNotificationTopic

Outputs:
  WebhookEndpointUrl:
    Description: "URL for the Stripe webhook endpoint"
    Value: !Sub "https://${WebhookApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/webhooks"
  SnsTopicArn:
    Description: "ARN of the SNS topic for Slack notifications"
    Value: !Ref SlackNotificationTopic

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for DynamoDB table with optional DAX cluster and networking infrastructure"
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: "saa-lab-05"
    Description: "Project name used for resource naming"
  EnableDax:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Enable or disable DAX cluster deployment"
  DaxReplicationFactor:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
    Description: "Replication factor for DAX cluster (1 or 3)"
Conditions:
  EnableDaxCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableDax, "true"]
Resources:
  OrdersTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-orders"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "customerId"
          AttributeType: "S"
        - AttributeName: "orderId"
          AttributeType: "S"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "customerId"
          KeyType: "HASH"
        - AttributeName: "orderId"
          KeyType: "RANGE"
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: false
  VPC:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::VPC"
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: "10.50.0.0/16"
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-vpc"
  Subnet1:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.50.10.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-subnet1"
  Subnet2:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::Subnet"
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: "10.50.11.0/24"
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-subnet2"
  ClientSecurityGroup:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for client access to DAX"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-client-sg"
  DaxSecurityGroup:
    Type: "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup"
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: "Security group for DAX cluster"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8111
          ToPort: 8111
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-sg"
  DaxSubnetGroup:
    Type: "AWS::DAX::SubnetGroup"
    Condition: EnableDaxCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetGroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-subnets"
      Description: "Subnet group for DAX cluster"
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
  DaxRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: EnableDaxCondition
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "dax.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "DaxDynamoDBAccess"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:DescribeTable"
                  - "dynamodb:GetItem"
                  - "dynamodb:PutItem"
                  - "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
                  - "dynamodb:DeleteItem"
                  - "dynamodb:Query"
                  - "dynamodb:Scan"
                  - "dynamodb:BatchGetItem"
                  - "dynamodb:BatchWriteItem"
                  - "dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem"
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${OrdersTable.Arn}/index/*"
  DaxCluster:
    Type: "AWS::DAX::Cluster"
    Condition: EnableDaxCondition
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-dax"
      NodeType: "dax.t3.small"
      ReplicationFactor: !Ref DaxReplicationFactor
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      SubnetGroupName: !Ref DaxSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DaxSecurityGroup
      IAMRoleARN: !GetAtt DaxRole.Arn
Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "DynamoDB table name"
    Value: !Ref OrdersTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableName"
  TableArn:
    Description: "DynamoDB table ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt OrdersTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TableArn"
  DaxStatus:
    Description: "DAX cluster status (enabled or disabled)"
    Value: !If [EnableDaxCondition, "enabled", "disabled"]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DaxStatus"
  ClientSecurityGroupId:
    Description: "Client security group ID"
    Value: !Ref ClientSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ClientSecurityGroupId"
  DaxEndpoint:
    Description: "DAX cluster discovery endpoint or disabled"
    Value: !If [EnableDaxCondition, !GetAtt DaxCluster.ClusterDiscoveryEndpoint, "disabled"]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DaxEndpoint"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for a self-contained ElastiCache Redis test environment with cluster mode, Multi-AZ, encryption, SNS topic, and IAM role for SSM automation signals."
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/22"
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  Subnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.0.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
  Subnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: "10.0.1.0/24"
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.
  NumShards:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Number of shards for the Redis cluster (cluster mode enabled).
  NumReplicasPerShard:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Number of replicas per shard.
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VPC"
  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Subnet1"
  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: ""
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Subnet2"
  CacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ElastiCache Redis cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 16379
          ToPort: 16379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet1CIDR
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 16379
          ToPort: 16379
          CidrIp: !Ref Subnet2CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-CacheSG"
  CacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Subnet group for Redis replication group
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for encryption of ElastiCache and SNS
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow SNS Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: Allow ElastiCache Service to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticache.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
  KMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-kms-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SNSEncryptionConfig:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
  SNSTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref SNSEncryptionConfig
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref SNSEncryptionConfig
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SendAutomationSignalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: "*"
  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: Redis cluster with cluster mode enabled for resilience testing
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: "7.0"
      CacheNodeType: cache.r6g.large
      NumNodeGroups: !Ref NumShards
      ReplicasPerNodeGroup: !Ref NumReplicasPerShard
      AutomaticFailoverEnabled: true
      MultiAZEnabled: true
      TransitEncryptionEnabled: true
      AtRestEncryptionEnabled: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      CacheSubnetGroupName: !Ref CacheSubnetGroup
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref CacheSecurityGroup
      ClusterMode: enabled
      SnapshotRetentionLimit: 0
      SnapshotWindow: "02:00-03:00"
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: "sun:03:00-sun:04:00"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-RedisCluster"
Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  Subnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first subnet
    Value: !Ref Subnet1
  Subnet2Id:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API for songs service with IAM auth, tracing, DynamoDB, and pipeline resolver validation

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: SongsApi
    Description: Name of the AppSync GraphQL API
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: Songs
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table

Resources:
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String!
          artist: String!
        }
        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }
        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String!): Song
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  IAMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /

  IAMPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBPolicy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:Scan
            Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMRole

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsDynamoDBDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt IAMRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtistFunction
      DataSourceName: NoneDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { artist } = ctx.arguments;
          if (!artist || !/^[A-Za-z]+$/.test(artist)) {
            util.error('Artist must contain only letters and cannot be missing.');
          }
          return {};
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0

  AddSongFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: AddSongFunction
      DataSourceName: SongsDynamoDBDataSource
      FunctionVersion: "2018-05-29"
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { name, artist } = ctx.arguments;
          const id = util.autoId();
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ name, artist }),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      DataSourceName: SongsDynamoDBDataSource
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Scan"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result.items)

  AddSongResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt AddSongFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29"
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiEndpoint:
    Description: The URL of the GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: The API ID
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: The name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable

            return {
              statusCode: 200,
              headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",

              body: JSON.stringify(body)

        - email

        PasswordPolicy:

          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

          Mutable: true

        Type: AWS_PROXY

  EnableMetricGraphs:

  EnableCodePipelineApproval:
    Type: String

      - 'false'

    Description: Enable approving or rejecting CodePipeline manual approval requests
  MarbotApiBaseUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://api.marbot.io
    Description: Base URL for marbot API endpoints
Conditions:
  AutomaticMonitoringEnabled:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: EnableAutomaticMonitoring
      - 'true'
  FriendlyAliasesEnabled:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: EnableFriendlyAliases
      - 'true'
  MetricGraphsEnabled:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: EnableMetricGraphs
      - 'true'
  CodePipelineApprovalEnabled:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: EnableCodePipelineApproval
      - 'true'
Resources:
  MarbotEventBridgeConnection:
    Type: AWS::Events::Connection
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: marbot-connection-${MarbotEndpointId}
      Description: Connection to marbot.io monitoring service
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: x-api-key
          ApiKeyValue:
            Ref: MarbotEndpointId
  MarbotApiDestination:
    Type: AWS::Events::ApiDestination
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: marbot-destination-${MarbotEndpointId}
      Description: API destination for marbot.io heartbeat
      ConnectionArn:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - MarbotEventBridgeConnection
          - Arn
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint:
        Fn::Sub: ${MarbotApiBaseUrl}/v1/connections/${MarbotEndpointId}/heartbeat
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 10
  EventBridgeInvocationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeApiDestination

                    - MarbotApiDestination

  MarbotHeartbeatRule:

      Name:
        Fn::Sub: marbot-heartbeat-${MarbotEndpointId}

      ScheduleExpression: rate(30 days)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn:

                  "friendly_aliases": "${EnableFriendlyAliases}",
                  "metric_graphs": "${EnableMetricGraphs}",
                  "codepipeline_approval": "${EnableCodePipelineApproval}"
                }

  MarbotPermissionsBoundary:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Condition: AutomaticMonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName:
        Fn::Sub: marbot-boundary-${MarbotEndpointId}
      Description: Permissions boundary for marbot cross-account monitoring role

        Statement:

              - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics

          - Fn::If:

  MarbotCrossAccountRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

        Fn::Sub: marbot-monitoring-${MarbotEndpointId}
      Description: Cross-account role for marbot.io to monitor AWS resources

                      - cloudwatch:GetMetricData

                      - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmHistory
                      - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                      - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarmsForMetric

              - Fn::If:
                  - FriendlyAliasesEnabled
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - iam:ListAccountAliases
                    Resource: '*'
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
              - Fn::If:

                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage

                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
              - Fn::If:
                  - CodePipelineApprovalEnabled
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                      - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                      - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                      - codepipeline:PutApprovalResult
                    Resource: '*'
                  - Ref: AWS::NoValue
  MarbotRegistrationLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CustomResourcePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:DescribeRule
                  - events:ListTargetsByRule
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:PutTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  Fn::GetAtt:
                    - EventBridgeInvocationRole
                    - Arn
  MarbotRegistrationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName:
        Fn::Sub: marbot-registration-${MarbotEndpointId}
      Handler: index.handler
      Runtime: python3.14
      Role:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - MarbotRegistrationLambdaRole
          - Arn
      Timeout: 30
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import os
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  endpoint_id = os.environ['MarbotEndpointId']
                  api_base_url = os.environ['MarbotApiBaseUrl']
                  account_id = os.environ['AWS_ACCOUNT_ID']
                  stack_id = os.environ['STACK_ID']
                  stack_name = os.environ['STACK_NAME']
                  api_key = os.environ['API_KEY']
                  features = json.loads(os.environ.get('FEATURES', '{}'))

                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      url = api_base_url.rstrip('/') + '/v1/connections/' + endpoint_id + '/register'
                      payload = {
                          "account_id": account_id,
                          "stack_id": stack_id,
                          "stack_name": stack_name,
                          "features": features,
                          "action": "register"
                      }
                      data = json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8')
                      req = urllib.request.Request(
                          url,
                          data=data,
                          headers={
                              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                              'x-api-key': api_key
                          },
                          method='POST'
                      )
                      response = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
                      response_body = response.read().decode('utf-8')
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {"Message": "Registration successful", "Response": response_body})
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      url = api_base_url.rstrip('/') + '/v1/connections/' + endpoint_id + '/register'
                      payload = {
                          "account_id": account_id,
                          "stack_id": stack_id,
                          "stack_name": stack_name,
                          "features": features,
                          "action": "unregister"
                      }
                      data = json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8')
                      req = urllib.request.Request(
                          url,
                          data=data,
                          headers={
                              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                              'x-api-key': api_key
                          },
                          method='POST'
                      )
                      response = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {"Message": "Unregistration successful"})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {"Message": str(e)})
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MarbotEndpointId:
            Ref: MarbotEndpointId
          MarbotApiBaseUrl:
            Ref: MarbotApiBaseUrl
          AWS_ACCOUNT_ID:
            Ref: AWS::AccountId
          STACK_ID:
            Ref: AWS::StackId
          STACK_NAME:
            Ref: AWS::StackName
          API_KEY:
            Ref: MarbotEndpointId
          FEATURES:
            Fn::Join:
              - ''
              - - '{"automatic_monitoring":"'
                - Ref: EnableAutomaticMonitoring
                - '","friendly_aliases":"'
                - Ref: EnableFriendlyAliases
                - '","metric_graphs":"'
                - Ref: EnableMetricGraphs
                - '","codepipeline_approval":"'
                - Ref: EnableCodePipelineApproval
                - '"}'
  MarbotRegistration:
    Type: Custom::MarbotRegistration
    DependsOn:
      - MarbotCrossAccountRole
      - MarbotHeartbeatRule
    Properties:
      ServiceToken:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - MarbotRegistrationLambda
          - Arn
      EndpointId:
        Ref: MarbotEndpointId
      AccountId:
        Ref: AWS::AccountId
      StackId:
        Ref: AWS::StackId
      StackName:
        Ref: AWS::StackName
Outputs:
  MarbotCrossAccountRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the cross-account IAM role for marbot to assume
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
        - MarbotCrossAccountRole
        - Arn
  MarbotEventBridgeConnectionName:
