AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation template for Glue Data Catalog database with optional crawler and Spark ETL job"

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "Prefix used for naming all resources"
    Default: "datalake"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: "Environment name (dev, staging, prod)"
    Default: "dev"
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of the existing source S3 bucket to crawl"
    Default: "arn:aws:s3:::example-source-bucket"
    AllowedPattern: "^arn:aws:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+$"
  SourceBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "S3 prefix within the source bucket for crawling"
    Default: ""
  CreateCrawler:
    Type: String
    Description: "Set to Yes to create the Glue crawler"
    Default: "No"
    AllowedValues:
      - "Yes"
      - "No"
  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Description: "Cron schedule for crawler (default: once daily at midnight)"
    Default: "cron(0 0 * * ? *)"
    AllowedPattern: "^cron\\(.*\\)$"
  CreateJob:
    Type: String
    Description: "Set to Yes to create the Glue Spark ETL job"
    Default: "No"
    AllowedValues:
      - "Yes"
      - "No"
  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    Description: "Worker type for the Glue job"
    Default: "G.1X"
    AllowedValues:
      - "G.1X"
      - "G.2X"
      - "Standard"
  WorkerCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Number of workers for the Glue job"
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299
  JobTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Timeout in minutes for the Glue job"
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Maximum concurrent runs for the Glue job"
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  ScriptS3Location:
    Type: String
    Description: "S3 location of the ETL script (e.g., s3://bucket/path/script.py)"
    Default: "s3://example-source-bucket/scripts/etl.py"
    AllowedPattern: "^s3://[a-z0-9.-]+/.*$"
  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: "ARN of the target S3 bucket for job output (optional)"
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^arn:aws:s3:::[a-z0-9.-]+$|^$"
  TargetBucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: "S3 prefix within the target bucket for job output"
    Default: ""
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: "CloudWatch log retention period in days"
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653

Conditions:
  HasCrawler: !Equals [!Ref CreateCrawler, "Yes"]
  HasJob: !Equals [!Ref CreateJob, "Yes"]
  HasTargetBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketArn, ""]]
  HasSourcePrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SourceBucketPrefix, ""]]
  HasTargetPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetBucketPrefix, ""]]

Resources:
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-database"
        Description: !Sub "Glue Data Catalog database for ${NamingPrefix} in ${Environment} environment"

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-glue-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Path: "/"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-glue-source-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Ref SourceBucketArn
                  - !Sub "${SourceBucketArn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:AssociateKmsKey
                Resource: "*"
        - !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - PolicyName: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-glue-target-policy"
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: "2012-10-17"
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:GetObjectVersion
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                  Resource:
                    - !Ref TargetBucketArn
                    - !Sub "${TargetBucketArn}/*"
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: HasCrawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-crawler"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Description: !Sub "Crawler for ${NamingPrefix} in ${Environment} environment"
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: "LOG"
        DeleteBehavior: "LOG"
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: "CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY"
      Configuration: |
        {
          "Version": 1.0,
          "CrawlerOutput": {
            "Partitions": {
              "AddOrUpdateBehavior": "InheritFromTable"
            }
          }
        }
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !If
              - HasSourcePrefix
              - !Join
                - ""
                - - "s3://"
                  - !Select [2, !Split [":::", !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
                  - "/"
                  - !Ref SourceBucketPrefix
              - !Join
                - ""
                - - "s3://"
                  - !Select [2, !Split [":::", !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
            Exclusions: []

  GlueJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: HasJob
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws-glue/jobs/${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-job"
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  GlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: HasJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${NamingPrefix}-${Environment}-job"
      Description: !Sub "Spark ETL job for ${NamingPrefix} in ${Environment} environment"
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: "glueetl"
        ScriptLocation: !Ref ScriptS3Location
        PythonVersion: "3"
      DefaultArguments:
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-continuous-log-filter": "true"
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--continuous-log-logGroup": !Ref GlueJobLogGroup
        "--TempDir": !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - !Join
            - ""
            - - "s3://"
              - !Select [2, !Split [":::", !Ref TargetBucketArn]]
              - "/tmp/"
          - !Join
            - ""
            - - "s3://"
              - !Select [2, !Split [":::", !Ref SourceBucketArn]]
              - "/tmp/"
        "--extra-py-files": ""
        "--extra-jars": ""
        "--extra-files": ""
        "--class": "GlueApp"
        "--job-language": "python"
        "--target-bucket-arn": !If [HasTargetBucket, !Ref TargetBucketArn, ""]
        "--target-prefix": !If [HasTargetPrefix, !Ref TargetBucketPrefix, ""]
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeout
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref WorkerCount
      GlueVersion: "3.0"

Outputs:
  DatabaseName:
    Description: "Glue Data Catalog database name"
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: "IAM role ARN for Glue services"
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
  CrawlerName:
    Description: "Glue crawler name (if created)"
    Condition: HasCrawler
    Value: !Ref GlueCrawler
  JobName:
    Description: "Glue Spark ETL job name (if created)"
    Condition: HasJob
    Value: !Ref GlueJob
  JobLogGroupName:
    Description: "CloudWatch log group for the Glue job (if created)"
    Condition: HasJob
    Value: !Ref GlueJobLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: "codex-user-keys"
    Description: "Name of the DynamoDB table for user-to-key mapping"
Resources:
  UserKeyMappingKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: "KMS key for encrypting the JWT user-to-key mapping table"
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: "Allow DynamoDB to use the key"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: "dynamodb.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      Tags:
        - Key: "project"
          Value: "codex-bedrock"
        - Key: "component"
          Value: "jwt-middleware"
        - Key: "managed-by"
          Value: "cloudformation"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  UserKeyMappingKMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}-user-key-mapping"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UserKeyMappingKMSKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: "user_id"
          AttributeType: "S"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: "user_id"
          KeyType: "HASH"
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: "ttl"
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: "KMS"
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref UserKeyMappingKMSKey
      Tags:
        - Key: "project"
          Value: "codex-bedrock"
        - Key: "component"
          Value: "jwt-middleware"
        - Key: "managed-by"
          Value: "cloudformation"
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
  StackRootAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-root-access"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "DynamoDBAccess"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "dynamodb:GetItem"
              - "dynamodb:PutItem"
              - "dynamodb:UpdateItem"
              - "dynamodb:DeleteItem"
              - "dynamodb:Query"
              - "dynamodb:Scan"
              - "dynamodb:DescribeTable"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable.Arn
          - Sid: "KMSAccess"
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt UserKeyMappingKMSKey.Arn
      Description: "Stack-level root IAM access policy for JWT user-key mapping resources"
Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: "DynamoDB table name"
    Value: !Ref UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-table-name"
  TableArn:
    Description: "DynamoDB table ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt UserKeyMappingDynamoDBTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-table-arn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "CloudFormation macro to dynamically generate Datadog integration IAM policies"
Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction
    Description: Name of the Lambda function backing the macro
  MacroName:
    Type: String
    Default: DatadogPolicy
    Description: Name of the CloudFormation macro
Resources:
  DatadogPolicyMacroExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-MacroRole"
  DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref FunctionName
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  fragment = event.get('fragment', {})
                  params = event.get('params', {})
                  policy_type = params.get('PolicyType', '')

                  if policy_type == 'LogArchive':
                      result = {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                              {
                                  "Effect": "Allow",
                                  "Action": [
                                      "s3:GetObject",
                                      "s3:PutObject",
                                      "s3:ListBucket"
                                  ],
                                  "Resource": "*"
                              }
                          ]
                      }
                  elif policy_type == 'CloudTrail':
                      result = {
                          "Version": "2012-10-17",
                          "Statement": [
                              {
                                  "Effect": "Allow",
                                  "Action": [
                                      "s3:ListBucket",
                                      "s3:GetObject",
                                      "s3:GetBucketLocation"
                                  ],
                                  "Resource": "*"
                              }
                          ]
                      }
                  else:
                      result = fragment

                  return {
                      "requestId": event['requestId'],
                      "status": "success",
                      "fragment": result
                  }
              except Exception as e:
                  return {
                      "requestId": event['requestId'],
                      "status": "failure",
                      "errorMessage": str(e)
                  }
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
  DatadogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::Macro
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref MacroName
      FunctionName: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn
    DependsOn:
      - LambdaInvokePermission
Outputs:
  MacroName:
    Description: "Name of the CloudFormation macro"
    Value: !Ref MacroName
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: "ARN of the Lambda function backing the macro"
    Value: !GetAtt DatadogPolicyMacroMacroFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Creates a customer-managed KMS key with key rotation, alias, and optional EventBridge alert on deletion/disable."

Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Name of a stack that exports an SNS topic ARN as 'AlertTopicArn'. Leave empty to skip alert rule."
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: "ALL_SERVICES"
    AllowedValues:
      - "ALL_SERVICES"
      - "S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS"
      - connect
      - dms
      - ssm
      - ec2
      - elasticfilesystem
      - es
      - kinesis
      - kinesisvideo
      - lambda
      - lex
      - redshift
      - rds
      - secretsmanager
      - ses
      - s3
      - importexport
      - sqs
      - workmail
      - workspaces
    Description: "Service to restrict cryptographic operations. Use ALL_SERVICES for no restriction, S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS for public S3 decryption."

Conditions:
  HasParentAlertStack: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, ""]]
  IsAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, "ALL_SERVICES"]
  IsS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, "S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS"]
  IsSpecificService: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Service, "ALL_SERVICES"]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Service, "S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS"]]

Resources:
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: "Enable IAM User Permissions"
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - !If
            - IsAllServices
            - Sid: "AllowCryptographicOperationsAllServices"
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
              Action:
                - "kms:Encrypt"
                - "kms:Decrypt"
                - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                - "kms:DescribeKey"
              Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !If
            - IsS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: "AllowPublicS3Decryption"
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: "s3.amazonaws.com"
              Action: "kms:Decrypt"
              Resource: "*"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          - !If
            - IsSpecificService
            - Sid: "AllowCryptographicOperationsForSpecificService"
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
              Action:
                - "kms:Encrypt"
                - "kms:Decrypt"
                - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
                - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
                - "kms:DescribeKey"
              Resource: "*"
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  "kms:ViaService": !Sub "${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  EventBridgeRule:
    Condition: HasParentAlertStack
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KeyDeletionAlert"
      Description: "Alert on ScheduleKeyDeletion and DisableKey events for the KMS key"
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.kms"
        detail-type:
          - "AWS API Call via CloudTrail"
        detail:
          eventSource:
            - "kms.amazonaws.com"
          eventName:
            - "ScheduleKeyDeletion"
            - "DisableKey"
          requestParameters:
            keyId:
              - !Ref KMSKey
      Targets:
        - Arn:
            Fn::ImportValue:
              Fn::Sub: "${ParentAlertStack}-AlertTopicArn"
          Id: "AlertTopic"

Outputs:
  KeyId:
    Description: "KMS Key ID"
    Value: !Ref KMSKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-KeyId"
  KeyArn:
    Description: "KMS Key ARN"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) lifecycle policy for automated EBS snapshot management'
Parameters:
  DailySnapshotScheduledAt:
    Type: String
    Default: '17:00'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-1][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be a valid time in HH:MM format (00:00-23:59).'
  SnapshotInterval:
    Type: Number
    Default: 24
    AllowedValues:
      - 2
      - 3
      - 4
      - 6
      - 8
      - 12
      - 24
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be one of 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, or 24 hours.'
  SnapshotRetainRule:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be at least 1.'
  LogicalName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebServers
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - test
      - development
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be production, test, or development.'
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: createdby
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-cloudformation-templates
Resources:
  DLMServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalName}-DataLifecycleManager-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DLMLifecyclePolicyPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                Resource: '*'
  DLMLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'DLM lifecycle policy for ${LogicalName}'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DLMServiceRole.Arn
      State: ENABLED
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'policy-${LogicalName}-${AWS::Region}'
      PolicyDetails:
        PolicyType: EBS_SNAPSHOT_MANAGEMENT
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: !Ref Environment
          - Key: !Ref TagKey
            Value: !Ref TagValue
        Schedules:
          - Name: Daily Snapshots
            CopyTags: true
            CreateRule:
              Interval: !Ref SnapshotInterval
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - !Ref DailySnapshotScheduledAt
            RetainRule:
              Count: !Ref SnapshotRetainRule
Outputs:
  PolicyId:
    Description: The ID of the DLM lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref DLMLifecyclePolicy
  PolicyArn:
    Description: The ARN of the DLM lifecycle policy
    Value: !GetAtt DLMLifecyclePolicy.Arn
  RoleArn:
    Description: The ARN of the DLM service role
    Value: !GetAtt DLMServiceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Enforces S3 Block Public Access at account level using SSM Automation and EventBridge"
Resources:
  SsmExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3BlockPublicAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: "*"
  EventBridgeExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: "*"
  S3BlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enforces S3 Block Public Access at the account level"
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmExecutionRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: "EnforceS3BlockPublicAccess"
            action: "aws:executeAwsApi"
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
                PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                  BlockPublicAcls: true
                  BlockPublicPolicy: true
                  IgnorePublicAcls: true
                  RestrictPublicBuckets: true
  DailyScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: "rate(1 day)"
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3BlockPublicAccessDocument}"
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeExecutionRole.Arn
          Id: "TargetS3Automation"
          Input: "{}"
Outputs:
  AutomationDocumentName:
    Description: "SSM Automation Document name"
    Value: !Ref S3BlockPublicAccessDocument
  AutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: "SSM Automation Document ARN"
    Value: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3BlockPublicAccessDocument}"
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: "EventBridge Rule ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt DailyScheduledRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "Cognito authentication layer for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway"

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: "protein-engineering"
    Description: "Project name used to build resource names"

  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: "Whether password policy requires symbols"

Conditions:
  RequireSymbolsTrue: !Equals [!Ref RequireSymbols, "true"]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: "agentcore-gateway-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !If [RequireSymbolsTrue, true, false]

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Join
        - "-"
        - - !Ref "AWS::Region"
          - !Select
            - 1
            - !Split
              - "/"
              - !Select
                - 5
                - !Split
                  - ":"
                  - !Ref "AWS::StackId"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: "agentcore-gateway"
      Name: "agentcore-gateway-resource-server"
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: "read"
          ScopeDescription: "Read access"
        - ScopeName: "write"
          ScopeDescription: "Write access"
        - ScopeName: "admin"
          ScopeDescription: "Admin access"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: "agentcore-gateway-client"
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - "agentcore-gateway/read"
        - "agentcore-gateway/write"
        - "agentcore-gateway/admin"
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolResourceServer

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "CognitoSecretManagerPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${UserPool}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              physical_resource_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'CustomResourcePhysicalId')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Create':
                      client_id = event['ResourceProperties']['ClientId']
                      user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
                      project_name = event['ResourceProperties']['ProjectName']
                      secret_name = f"{project_name}/cognito/client-secret"
                      cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
                      response = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(UserPoolId=user_pool_id, ClientId=client_id)
                      client_secret = response['UserPoolClient'].get('ClientSecret', '')
                      if not client_secret:
                          raise Exception("Client secret not found")
                      secret_data = {"clientId": client_id, "clientSecret": client_secret, "userPoolId": user_pool_id}
                      sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                      sm.create_secret(Name=secret_name, SecretString=json.dumps(secret_data))
                      physical_resource_id = secret_name
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"SecretName": secret_name}, physical_resource_id)
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Update':
                      client_id = event['ResourceProperties']['ClientId']
                      user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']
                      project_name = event['ResourceProperties']['ProjectName']
                      secret_name = f"{project_name}/cognito/client-secret"
                      cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
                      response = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(UserPoolId=user_pool_id, ClientId=client_id)
                      client_secret = response['UserPoolClient'].get('ClientSecret', '')
                      if not client_secret:
                          raise Exception("Client secret not found")
                      secret_data = {"clientId": client_id, "clientSecret": client_secret, "userPoolId": user_pool_id}
                      sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                      try:
                          sm.update_secret(SecretId=secret_name, SecretString=json.dumps(secret_data))
                      except sm.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          sm.create_secret(Name=secret_name, SecretString=json.dumps(secret_data))
                      physical_resource_id = secret_name
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"SecretName": secret_name}, physical_resource_id)
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      project_name = event['ResourceProperties']['ProjectName']
                      secret_name = f"{project_name}/cognito/client-secret"
                      sm = boto3.client('secretsmanager')
                      try:
                          sm.delete_secret(SecretId=secret_name, ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True)
                      except sm.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_resource_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(e)}, physical_resource_id)
      Timeout: 30
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"

  CustomResource:
    Type: Custom::CognitoSecret
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName

  SSMParameterDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/oidc-discovery-url"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
      Description: "OIDC discovery URL for the Cognito user pool"

  SSMParameterClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/client-id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Description: "Client ID for the agentcore-gateway client"

  SSMParameterUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: "User pool ID"

  SSMParameterUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Description: "User pool ARN"

  SSMParameterHostedDomainUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: "/protein-agent/cognito/hosted-domain-url"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: "Hosted domain URL for the Cognito user pool"

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ID"
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: "Cognito User Pool ARN"
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ClientId:
    Description: "Client ID for agentcore-gateway-client"
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  ClientSecretSecretName:
    Description: "Secrets Manager secret name containing client ID, secret, and user pool ID"
    Value: !GetAtt CustomResource.SecretName
  OIDCDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: "OIDC discovery URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  HostedDomainUrl:
    Description: "Cognito hosted domain URL"
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: "Token endpoint for client credentials flow"
    Value: !Sub "https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/oauth2/token"
  ScopeList:
    Description: "Custom scopes defined on the resource server"
    Value: "agentcore-gateway/read, agentcore-gateway/write, agentcore-gateway/admin"
  ParameterOIDCDiscoveryUrl:
    Description: "SSM parameter name for OIDC discovery URL"
    Value: !Ref SSMParameterDiscoveryUrl
  ParameterClientId:
    Description: "SSM parameter name for client ID"
    Value: !Ref SSMParameterClientId
  ParameterUserPoolId:
    Description: "SSM parameter name for user pool ID"
    Value: !Ref SSMParameterUserPoolId
  ParameterUserPoolArn:
    Description: "SSM parameter name for user pool ARN"
    Value: !Ref SSMParameterUserPoolArn
  ParameterHostedDomainUrl:
    Description: "SSM parameter name for hosted domain URL"
    Value: !Ref SSMParameterHostedDomainUrl
  SecretName:
    Description: "Secrets Manager secret name for client credentials"
    Value: !GetAtt CustomResource.SecretName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: "DynamoDB table with configurable capacity, backup, monitoring, and encryption."
Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Name of the partition key."
    Default: "pk"
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+"
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: "Data type of the partition key."
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Optional table name. Defaults to stack name."
    Default: ""
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: "Optional sort key name."
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: "Data type of the sort key."
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  ExtraAttr1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: "First extra attribute name."
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
  ExtraAttr1Type:
    Type: String
    Description: "First extra attribute type."
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  ExtraAttr2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: "Second extra attribute name."
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
  ExtraAttr2Type:
    Type: String
    Description: "Second extra attribute type."
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  ExtraAttr3Name:
    Type: String
    Description: "Third extra attribute name."
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
  ExtraAttr3Type:
    Type: String
    Description: "Third extra attribute type."
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  GSISortKey1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: "Sort key for first GSI. Leave empty to use only partition key."
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
  GSISortKey1Type:
    Type: String
    Description: "Data type of first GSI sort key."
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  GSISortKey2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: "Sort key for second GSI. Leave empty to use only partition key."
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
  GSISortKey2Type:
    Type: String
    Description: "Data type of second GSI sort key."
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  TimeToLiveAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Description: "TTL attribute name. Leave empty to disable."
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*"
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Description: "Stream view type. Leave empty to disable."
    Default: ""
    AllowedValues: ["", "KEYS_ONLY", "NEW_IMAGE", "OLD_IMAGE", "NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES"]
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: "PROVISIONED or PAY_PER_REQUEST."
    Default: "PROVISIONED"
    AllowedValues: ["PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Provisioned read capacity."
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Provisioned write capacity."
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  ReadScalingMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Minimum read capacity for auto scaling."
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  ReadScalingMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Maximum read capacity for auto scaling."
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteScalingMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Minimum write capacity for auto scaling."
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteScalingMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Maximum write capacity for auto scaling."
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  TargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Target utilization percentage."
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: "Enable point-in-time recovery."
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
  SSESpecification:
    Type: String
    Description: "Enable SSE with AWS managed KMS key."
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: "Backup retention days. 0 disables backups."
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: "SNS topic ARN for alarms and notifications. Leave empty to disable."
    Default: ""
Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, ""]]
  HasStreams: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, ""]]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  EnableBackup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  EnableSSE: !Equals [!Ref SSESpecification, "true"]
  HasAlertTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, ""]]
  HasExtraAttr1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttr1Name, ""]]
  HasExtraAttr2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttr2Name, ""]]
  HasExtraAttr3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttr3Name, ""]]
  HasGSISortKey1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSISortKey1Name, ""]]
  HasGSISortKey2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSISortKey2Name, ""]]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttributeName, ""]]
  UseDefaultTableName: !Equals [!Ref TableName, ""]
  PointInTimeRecoveryCondition: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, "true"]
  BackupAndAlert: !And
    - !Condition EnableBackup
    - !Condition HasAlertTopic
Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: "AWS::DynamoDB::Table"
    Properties:
      TableName: !If
        - UseDefaultTableName
        - !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        - !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttr1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttr1Type
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttr2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttr2Type
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttr3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttr3Type
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasGSISortKey1
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSISortKey1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref GSISortKey1Type
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - !If
          - HasGSISortKey2
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSISortKey2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref GSISortKey2Type
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: "HASH"
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: "RANGE"
          - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: "GSI1"
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
              KeyType: "HASH"
            - !If
              - HasGSISortKey1
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSISortKey1Name
                KeyType: "RANGE"
              - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: "ALL"
          ProvisionedThroughput: !If
            - IsProvisioned
            - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
              WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
        - IndexName: "GSI2"
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
              KeyType: "HASH"
            - !If
              - HasGSISortKey2
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSISortKey2Name
                KeyType: "RANGE"
              - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: "ALL"
          ProvisionedThroughput: !If
            - IsProvisioned
            - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
              WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      BillingMode: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - "PROVISIONED"
        - "PAY_PER_REQUEST"
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: "KMS"
          KMSMasterKeyId: "alias/aws/dynamodb"
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If
          - PointInTimeRecoveryCondition
          - true
          - false
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStreams
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  ScalingRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDBScalingRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: "DynamoDBScalingPolicy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: "Allow"
                Action:
                  - "dynamodb:DescribeTable"
                  - "dynamodb:UpdateTable"
                  - "application-autoscaling:*"
                  - "cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms"
                  - "cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm"
                Resource: "*"
  ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget"
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ReadScalingMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref ReadScalingMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: "dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits"
      ServiceNamespace: "dynamodb"
  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy"
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReadScalingPolicy"
      PolicyType: "TargetTrackingScaling"
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: "DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization"
  WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget"
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref WriteScalingMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref WriteScalingMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: "dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits"
      ServiceNamespace: "dynamodb"
  WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: "AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy"
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteScalingPolicy"
      PolicyType: "TargetTrackingScaling"
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: "DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization"
  BackupVault:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupVault"
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
      Notifications: !If
        - HasAlertTopic
        - BackupVaultEvents:
            - "BACKUP_JOB_STARTED"
            - "BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED"
            - "RESTORE_JOB_STARTED"
            - "RESTORE_JOB_COMPLETED"
          SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
  BackupPlan:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupPlan"
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Ref "AWS::StackName"
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: "DailyBackup"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 5 ? * * *)"
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays
  BackupSelection:
    Type: "AWS::Backup::BackupSelection"
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-BackupSelection"
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${DynamoDBTable}"
  BackupRole:
    Type: "AWS::IAM::Role"
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-BackupRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: "Allow"
            Principal:
              Service: "backup.amazonaws.com"
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup"
  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReadThrottleEvents"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when read throttle events exceed threshold."
      MetricName: "ReadThrottleEvents"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "TableName"
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when write throttle events exceed threshold."
      MetricName: "WriteThrottleEvents"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "TableName"
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ThrottledRequests"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when throttled requests exceed threshold."
      MetricName: "ThrottledRequests"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "TableName"
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when user errors exceed threshold."
      MetricName: "UserErrors"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "TableName"
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm when system errors exceed threshold."
      MetricName: "SystemErrors"
      Namespace: "AWS/DynamoDB"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "TableName"
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  BackupVaultNotificationsAlarm:
    Type: "AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm"
    Condition: BackupAndAlert
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-BackupVaultNotifications"
      AlarmDescription: "Alarm for backup vault notification events."
      MetricName: "NumberOfBackupJobsCompleted"
      Namespace: "AWS/Backup"
      Statistic: "Sum"
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: "GreaterThanThreshold"
      TreatMissingData: "notBreaching"
      Dimensions:
        - Name: "BackupVaultName"
          Value: !Ref BackupVault
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
Outputs:

    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
    Export:

  StreamArn:
    Description: "ARN of the DynamoDB stream (if enabled)."
    Condition: HasStreams
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.StreamArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-StreamArn"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in first AZ
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in second AZ
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in first AZ
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in second AZ
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitVPC
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: StreamlitIGW
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicRouteTable
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PublicSubnet2
  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGateway-AZ1
  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: NATGateway-AZ2
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable-AZ1
  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateRouteTable-AZ2
  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1
  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PrivateSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs/streamlit
      RetentionInDays: 7
  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: StreamlitCluster
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
